**Job Summary**

Practiceleague is seeking an experienced Product Implementation Manager to lead the successful deployment and adoption of our SaaS solutions for business & legal enterprise clients. The role combines project management, stakeholder engagement, process transformation, and change management to ensure smooth implementation, user adoption, and realization of business value.

The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between customers, product teams, and internal stakeholders, driving implementation projects from planning through go-live while managing organizational change and user readiness.

* Conduct requirement gathering, solution design, workshops and implementation planning sessions.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and escalations, ensuring proactive resolution.
* Manage data migration, configuration, testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and go-live activities.
* Track implementation KPIs and ensure adherence to project schedules and budgets.

**Change Management**

* Gather and analyse client requirements, prepare requirement specifications, and develop proposals, effort estimates, and project plans.
* Collaborate with Product, Technology, Support, and other cross-functional teams to define project scope, milestones, deliverables, and implementation strategies.
* Drive end-to-end project execution, including task management, resource coordination, progress tracking, risk mitigation, and budget monitoring.
* Serve as the primary client interface for project updates, approvals, status reviews, release communications, and demonstrations.
* Coordinate deployments, releases, and go-live activities while ensuring proper documentation and reporting throughout the project lifecycle.
* Track commercial milestones, including proposal approvals, purchase orders, and project-related payment follow-ups.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in SaaS implementation, project management, consulting, or customer onboarding.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise software implementation projects.
* Strong understanding of Change Management principles and methodologies.
* Experience in stakeholder management across multiple organizational levels.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

**Success Metrics**

* On-time and on-budget project delivery.
* Customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS).
* User adoption and utilization rates.
* Successful go-live without critical issues.
* Reduction in implementation escalations.
* Achievement of customer business outcomes and ROI objectives.

We are looking for a Mainframe Modernization Expert to lead the technical delivery of complex, enterprise-wide programs that modernize legacy systems. You will bring deep mainframe expertise, modern architecture skills and GenAI-enabled engineering to take clients from assessment through cutover onto modern platforms. You will also lead global teams and work with senior stakeholders to shape solution strategy.

description:
**ZS**

**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
**About ZS Manufacturing Team**
At ZS, our Manufacturing, Engineering and Quality practice helps global organizations transform how they design, operate and optimize their manufacturing environments. We work at the intersection of business strategy and technology, combining AI, Agentic systems, advanced analytics, and digital twin technology to drive manufacturing efficiency, engineering precision, and quality compliance at scale.
  
  
Our teams work hands-on with clients to connect shop floor data with enterprise decision-making, integrate with legacy systems, and embed intelligent, outcome-driven solutions across manufacturing execution, maintenance, and quality workflows. Whether the challenge is improving yield, ensuring compliance, reducing operational risk, or accelerating the shift to smart manufacturing, we bring deep expertise and purpose-built technology approached to make it real.
  
  
***What You'll Do :
  
  
Engagement & client leadership -***

* Lead multiple technology engagements simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery across the lifecycle — discovery, requirements, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing operations.
* Build and manage client relationships across assigned accounts, serving as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for technology initiatives and strategic discussions.
* Partner with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, identify technology-enabled solutions, and develop roadmaps that support long-term transformation.
* Drive account expansion — identify opportunities, shape proposals, facilitate client discussions and collaborate with internal teams on solutions.
* Coordinate cross-functional, geographically distributed teams across India and the US, ensuring collaboration, delivery excellence and alignment across workstreams.

***Subject matter (OT & industrial data) -***

* Act as the OT subject-matter expert — shape and drive manufacturing and Industry 4.0 use cases across sites and enterprise programs (process monitoring, predictive maintenance, OEE, yield, energy, asset reliability).
* Apply deep knowledge of plant-floor OT and industrial data: sensors and instrumentation, PLC / DCS / SCADA, historians (e.g. OSIsoft / AVEVA PI), industrial IoT and edge, and manufacturing data platforms.
* Design and govern OT/IT data layers and Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures; define semantic models / ontology and contextualization of time-series and equipment data.
* Apply industrial standards and connectivity — ISA-95, ISA-88, OPC-UA and MQTT / UNS — and translate operational needs into scalable data products and analytics.

***Delivery & technology (SDLC) -***

* Lead end-to-end delivery and the full SDLC, guiding solution architecture, integration patterns, data models and the team’s technical approach while staying hands-on as and when required.
* Own estimation, planning, risk, dependency and delivery governance; ensure quality, non-functional requirements and, for validated systems, GxP / CSV validation (IQ/OQ/PQ, RVM traceability) and data integrity.

***Change Management & Value Delivery -***

* Drive organizational change management, ensuring adoption of new technologies and digital ways of working.
* Build business cases with clear ROI, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, quality, and time-to-market.
* Lead workshops, training, and stakeholder engagement to foster a culture of innovation and data-driven decision-making.

**What You'll Bring :**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Life Sciences or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10–12 years leading client-facing technology, digital transformation or consulting initiatives within a professional-services or technology-consulting environment in the Manufacturing functional area.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements and workstreams concurrently while balancing client expectations, delivery commitments and business priorities.
* Ability to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions and guide initiatives from strategy through execution.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment across multiple locations (India and US).
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to communicate with executive stakeholders; fluency in English.
* Client-first mentality, intense work ethic, collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach.
* Deep OT / industrial data expertise: sensors, PLC/DCS/SCADA, historians (PI), IIoT/edge, Unified Namespace, ontology / semantic models; ISA-95, ISA-88, OPC-UA, MQTT.
* Strong technology background: solution architecture, data engineering, Python / SQL, cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP) and integration.
* Life-sciences / pharma manufacturing domain experience.

**Nice to have :**

* Exposure to Smart Factory, Connected Worker, Digital Twin and Industrial AI initiatives.
* Familiarity with cloud industrial data platforms (e.g. Cognite, Snowflake) and streaming (Kafka); OT cybersecurity and data governance.
* Broad exposure across multiple technology domains — enterprise applications, cloud, analytics, data platforms or digital products.
* Demonstrated success identifying, shaping and expanding opportunities within existing client accounts.

title: Tax Consultant II-TTC-SAP FICO AMS-Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services –**
**Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP MM/FICO/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting practice is seeking a Manager, Tax Services professional to help clients modernize and improve their tax operations. In this role, you will lead SAP tax transformation and application managed services efforts, guide teams through complex delivery requirements, and help translate tax and business needs into technology-enabled solutions. You will work across tax, process, and technology teams to support scalable, compliant, and efficient tax functions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services professional on the Tax Transformation Consulting team, you will be responsible for...
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk
* AMS Delivery & Operations Management: Own end-to-end delivery of SAP FICO/MM/SD tax AMS engagements, including SLA governance, ticket triage and escalation across L1/L2/L3, incident and problem management, and driving continuous improvement in support processes and tooling
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals
* People Development: Perform the role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology, and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
How you’ll grow At Deloitte - We’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**
Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

title: Technical Lead - OpenBlue CUPO Systems Specialist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Johnson Controls is shaping a future that is more productive, secure, and sustainable by applying cloud, data analytics, the Internet of Things, and Design Thinking to intelligent buildings.
  
  
In this role, you will help deliver OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions that support reliable, efficient central utilities for critical environments such as universities, hospitals, airports, office towers, and data centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**

* Based in Pune, this position leads the engineering, integration, commissioning, and optimization of OpenBlue CUP solutions for district energy and chiller plants globally. You will serve as the technical lead for project execution, aligning delivery with customer objectives, schedules, and performance goals while helping drive energy savings, reduced water use, and lower carbon impact.
* Key Responsibilities
* Lead the engineering and project execution of OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions from design through closeout.
* Analyze site and operational data to build accurate energy models using CUPO software and identify optimization opportunities.
* Prepare drawings, scopes of work, and recommissioning requirements for sensors, meters, and controls needed to make a plant CUP-ready.
* Oversee system design, programming, installation coordination, commissioning, performance validation, and project closeout activities.
* Create and execute integration test plans with controls service contractors to verify bidirectional data and command flow between CPO and the plant automation system.
* Oversee point mapping and local plant automation programming to support smooth transitions between operating modes.
* Validate system functionality, analyze command dispatch results, and resolve issues throughout commissioning and startup.
* Collaborate with customers, plant operators, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-performance outcomes.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineering team members, and train operators and end users on OpenBlue CUP solutions.
* Maintain strong ethics, quality, safety, and compliance with Johnson Controls policies and applicable regulations.
* How You Will Do It
* Own project outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity while keeping delivery aligned to scope, schedule, and customer expectations.
* Stay close to the work by reviewing plant data, point maps, and field results to identify practical optimization actions and remove obstacles quickly.
* Improve every day through structured test plans, candid troubleshooting, and continuous refinement of engineering standards and methods.
* Win as one team by working closely with controls contractors, project managers, operators, and other engineering disciplines.
* Lead regular progress meetings, document decisions clearly, and keep stakeholders informed of risks, changes, and commissioning status.
* Use Microsoft Project or similar tools to support planning, coordination, and milestone tracking.
* Translate technical findings into clear training and support so plant teams can confidently operate the CUP solution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in building automation controls engineering, programming, and commissioning.
* Strong expertise in integrating building systems using industry-standard protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, and LonWorks.
* Proven experience designing, implementing, and commissioning central utility plant control systems, including automation startup and commissioning for at least five live critical facility projects.
* Hands-on experience in energy modeling, chiller plant optimization, data analytics, and performance assessment using software tools.
* Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards and provide technical leadership to engineering teams.
* Strong project management and stakeholder communication skills, with experience using Microsoft Project or similar tools.
* Prior experience supervising and mentoring technical or engineering staff.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail.
* Willingness to travel up to 50%, including international assignments.

**Nice to Have**

* Master’s degree or Professional Engineer registration.
* Strong understanding of energy modeling and data analytics.
* Strong background in the Metasys suite of tools.
* Programming capability for multiple makes and models of building automation systems and PLC systems.

**Why Join Us**
You will contribute to meaningful work that helps customers reduce operating costs, lower energy consumption, and improve the performance of critical central plants. This is an opportunity to apply your technical leadership in a collaborative environment focused on intelligent buildings, sustainability, and reliable outcomes.
  
  
If this sounds like the right next step for you, we invite you to apply and help shape the future of OpenBlue CUP solutions.

title: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC) Lead
description:
**Job Title**
: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC) Lead
  
  
**Location:**
Pune, India (VE3 Pune office; hybrid)
  
  
**Position Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience Level:**
10-14 years
  
  
**Working Pattern:**
Offshore delivery with overlap into UK business hours to align with the onshore team and client
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC) Lead to own the EC solution on a large-scale SuccessFactors and Employee Central Payroll (ECP) transformation. The programme migrates a complex UK public sector payroll and HR estate from SAP HCM on S/4HANA into the SAP SuccessFactors landscape, covering approximately 65,000 employee and pensioner records, 17 payrolls, multiple public sector pension schemes (LGPS, Teachers, NHS), external employers paid on the client's payroll, and a significant multiple-employment population.
  
  
This role is based in VE3's Pune office as part of an onshore-offshore delivery model, working with a daily overlap into UK business hours alongside the onshore team. Employee Central is the system of record for the programme. It goes live first, alongside Recruiting and Onboarding, and then becomes the source of employee data for Employee Central Payroll. For several months between those go-lives EC runs alongside the existing SAP payroll, so the EC design has to work for both. The EC Lead owns the EC design and build, leads the offshore EC configuration team, and runs remote design sessions with client stakeholders, covering the organisation structure, position management, job and pay data, employee lifecycle events, custom data objects, role-based permissions and data retention.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**
**EC solution ownership**
. Own the Employee Central solution end to end, from fit-to-standard and detailed design through configuration workbooks, build, testing and go-live, and take accountability for EC design sign-off at each programme milestone.
  
  
**Client design leadership.**
Lead EC design workshops with HR, payroll, finance and IT stakeholders, present options with a clear recommendation, record decisions, and drive open questions to closure with named owners and dates.
  
  
**Foundation and organisation structure**
. Design legal entities, business units, divisions, departments, locations, cost centres, pay groups and pay structures, including the UK legal entity fields (for example PAYE reference and Accounts Office reference) that SAP does not deliver as standard. The client is redesigning its organisation in parallel, so the structure must absorb change without rework.
  
  
**Position management.**
Design position management and the reporting hierarchy, including how the hierarchy is built during migration where the legacy system holds little position-to-position reporting.
  
  
**Employee data and lifecycle**
. Design job information, compensation and pay components, and the employee lifecycle (hire, rehire, transfer, job and pay change, termination), with event reasons, workflows and business rules.
  
  
**Complex populations**
. Design how EC handles:
  
  

* Multiple and concurrent employments
* External employers paid on the client's payroll
* Pensioner populations held in EC without an active position
* Employees moving between payrolls and employers

**Extensibility**
. Design custom MDF objects for client-specific data held today in custom infotypes (for example teacher qualifications and status), and agree with the client what is carried forward and what is retired.
  
  
**Permissions and data protection**
. Design role-based permissions with the client, and the data retention and purge approach (DRTM) that meets UK GDPR and the client's statutory retention rules.
  
  
**Payroll and integration alignment.**
Agree with the ECP Lead and the integration team the EC data that payroll depends on, and the EC to payroll replication approach, including the period when EC is live but payroll still runs on the existing SAP system.
  
  
**Data migration.**
Work with the data migration team on EC load templates, field mapping, transformation rules and reconciliation across each data cycle, and confirm EC data quality before each load.
  
  
**Recruiting and Onboarding fit**
. Make sure the EC design supports the Recruiting and Onboarding modules going live alongside it, including position, job and new hire data flowing into EC.
  
  
**Testing, cutover and hypercare.**
Support system integration testing and UAT, own EC defect resolution, prepare and run the EC cutover activities, and lead EC through hypercare and stabilisation.
  
  
**Team leadership.**
Lead and quality-assure the work of the EC configuration consultants, set configuration and documentation standards, and review all EC build before it goes into test.
  
  
**Onshore-offshore collaboration**
. Work closely with the onshore UK-based programme, functional and client leads, maintaining a daily overlap with UK business hours and joining client design sessions remotely throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Technical Skills & Experience**

* Deep hands-on Employee Central configuration: foundation objects, Corporate and Succession data models, country-specific fields, picklists, MDF and generic objects, Business Rules and workflows
* Position management, including position hierarchy design, Position Org Chart, and the rules that keep positions and employee job data in step.
* Role-based permissions design, including permission groups, target populations and field-level access.
* EC data loads and validation using Import Employee Data, MDF import and export, Integration Center and the OData API.
* Data Retention Management (DRTM) and UK GDPR design in SuccessFactors.
* Understanding of how EC feeds Employee Central Payroll, and the EC data payroll relies on (pay components, cost assignment, multiple employments).
* Working knowledge of SAP HCM (PA and OM infotypes) to map the legacy design and data into EC.
* SAP Activate, configuration workbooks, and managing the twice-yearly SuccessFactors release cycle.

**Essential Experience**

* At least two full-lifecycle Employee Central implementations in a lead or solution architect role
* Leading client-facing design workshops and owning design sign-off
* Position management and complex organisation structure design
* Role-based permissions and data protection design
* Migration from SAP HCM on-premise to Employee Central
* Leading and reviewing the work of a configuration team

**Desirable Experience**

* UK public sector or local government HR (for example councils, schools and academies, pension funds)
* Employee Central integrated with Employee Central Payroll
* Multiple and concurrent employment design
* Recruiting and Onboarding integration with EC
* People Analytics (Stories) reporting on EC data
* Organisation redesign delivered during a live implementation

**Certifications**

* Essential: Current SAP certification in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Core, kept up to date through SAP Learning Hub.
* Desirable: SAP SuccessFactors certification in a second module, for example Recruiting, Onboarding or Employee Central Payroll.

**Soft Skills**

* Confident with senior client stakeholders, and able to challenge and hold a design position
* Clear decision-making and the ability to explain trade-offs in plain language
* Strong written communication for design documents and decision records
* Coaching and quality review of less experienced consultants
* Attention to detail appropriate to data that drives payroll
* Ability to manage competing priorities across parallel workstreams

title: Cyber Threat Exposure Management Lead
description:
**About Gruve**
Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are looking for an experienced CTEM (Continuous Threat Exposure Management) Expert to lead the design, implementation, and continuous operation of exposure management programs for our clients. This role sits at the intersection of vulnerability management, attack surface management, threat intelligence, and risk-based remediation helping clients move from periodic point-in-time assessments to a continuous, adversary-informed exposure reduction program aligned with 5-stage CTEM framework (Scoping, Discovery, Prioritization, Validation, and Mobilization).
  
  
You will work directly with client CISOs, security operations teams, and IT owners to build programs that identify, prioritize, validate, and reduce cyber exposure across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments and demonstrate measurable reduction in exploitable risk over time.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of CTEM engagements across the five stages: Scoping, Discovery, Prioritization, Validation, and Mobilization
* Design and operationalize continuous exposure management programs tailored to client risk appetite, industry, and regulatory context
* Integrate and correlate data across vulnerability management, attack surface management (ASM), cloud security posture management (CSPM), threat intelligence, and breach & attack simulation (BAS) tools to build a unified exposure view
* Translate technical findings (CVEs, misconfigurations, exposed assets, identity risks) into business-risk-prioritized remediation plans using exploitability, asset criticality, and threat context (e.g., KEV, EPSS, active exploitation campaigns)
* Drive adversarial validation of exposures through coordination with red/purple teams, pentesters, or automated validation platforms to confirm real-world exploitability
* Own exposure reduction metrics and reporting and present progress to client stakeholders and leadership
* Coordinate remediation and patch/mitigation execution with client asset owners, IT, and SOC teams; manage emergency response for zero-days and actively exploited vulnerabilities
* Build and refine CTEM playbooks, runbooks, and governance frameworks; establish exception and risk-acceptance processes
* Support pre-sales activities — scoping calls, proposals, PoCs, and CTEM maturity assessments for prospective clients
* Mentor junior consultants/analysts and contribute to practice capability building, including tool evaluation and methodology development
* Stay current on the threat landscape, emerging attack techniques, and CTEM tooling ecosystem.

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* BE/BTech (CS/IT/E&TC) or equivalent.
* 5–10 years of overall cybersecurity experience, with 3+ years in exposure management, vulnerability management, attack surface management, or red team/adversary simulation
* Strong hands-on experience with CTEM/exposure management platforms such as Tenable (Exposure Management/One), Qualys VMDR/ETM, CrowdStrike Falcon Exposure Management, or similar
* Practical experience with attack surface management (ASM) tools and breach & attack simulation (BAS) platforms
* Solid understanding of vulnerability prioritization frameworks: CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit maturity, and asset-criticality-based risk scoring

title: ME - New Product Introduction Lead
description:
* SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the New Product Manufacturing industrialization and readiness of all new products from concept/design stage through pilot build, Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR), production launch, ramp-up and final handover to Operations.
  
  
The role ensures that every new product is manufacturable and can be launched safely and consistently while meeting quality, delivery, cost, capacity and productivity objectives. The position leads and coordinates Manufacturing Engineering (ME) and Industrial Engineering (IE) deliverables across the NPI process and supports VAVE industrialization activities.
  
  

* PRIMARY DUTIES

**Compliance, Quality & EHS:**
Ensure compliance with company policies, Code of Ethics, quality systems, and EHS requirements, including identification and mitigation of manufacturing safety and environmental risks.
  
  
**New Product & VAVE Industrialization:**
Lead the manufacturing industrialization of
**all new products and projects**
from early product development through production launch, ensuring Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Capacity, and Productivity targets are achieved.
  
  
**Manufacturing Feasibility & DFMA:**
Drive early manufacturing feasibility and DFMA reviews covering process capability, equipment, tooling, fixtures, testing, utilities, material flow, manpower, floor space, ergonomics, and capacity requirements.
  
  
**Manufacturing Process Development:**
Define and validate the complete manufacturing process, including process flow, routing, workstation design, assembly methods, tooling, fixtures, testing, inspection requirements, Standard Work, Work Instructions, and process parameters.
  
  
**Industrial Engineering & Capacity Planning:**
Lead cycle-time studies, takt-time analysis, capacity planning, manpower optimization, line balancing, layout, material flow, and bottleneck elimination to ensure efficient and scalable production.
  
  
**Process Quality & Risk Management:**
Lead/review Process Flow, PFMEA, PTPR, Control Plan, process capability, part qualification, and manufacturing risk mitigation to ensure robust processes and product quality before production release.
  
  
**Equipment, Tooling & Supplier Readiness:**
Ensure timely readiness, qualification, and commissioning of manufacturing equipment, tooling, fixtures, gauges, test equipment, and supplier processes required for successful product launch.
  
  
**Prototype, Pilot Build & Manufacturing Readiness:**
Lead manufacturing activities for prototype, pilot, and pre-production builds; validate process, quality, cycle time, equipment, manpower, material, documentation, and training readiness prior to
**Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR)**
and production release.
  
  
**NPI Gate Approval, Launch & Ramp-Up:**
Represent Manufacturing in NPI gate reviews, approve manufacturing readiness, and drive production launch, ramp-up, and stabilization until required safety, quality, delivery, cost, capacity, and productivity targets are consistently achieved.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Operations Handover:**
Drive VAVE, Lean, productivity, automation, cycle-time and cost improvements; capture lessons learned and ensure structured handover to Operations, including documentation, training, process validation, capacity confirmation, and closure of launch actions.
  
  
**Performance Focus**
On-time manufacturing readiness and product launch
  
  
Safety and EHS compliance at launch
  
  
First-pass yield / quality performance during launch and ramp-up
  
  
Achievement of target cycle time, capacity and productivity
  
  
Closure of manufacturing risks and launch actions
  
  
Tooling/equipment readiness to project timing
  
  
Scrap, rework and manufacturing cost performance
  
  
Stable handover to Operations and sustained process capability
  
  

* EDUCATION

Engineering degree/diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline with relevant Experience of 6-8 Years in HVAC Domain
  
  

* Technical Skills, knowledge and experience

Strong working knowledge of manufacturing industrialization, NPI, process development and production ramp-up.
  
  
Practical knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, process flow, standard work, cycle-time study, capacity planning, line balancing, layout and Lean manufacturing.
  
  
Ability to lead cross-functional problem solving, risk closure and manufacturing readiness reviews.
  
  
Strong communication, project coordination, data analysis and structured problem-solving skills.
  
  
Experience with chiller/HVAC, fabrication, assembly, brazing/welding, testing, supplier industrialization or similar manufacturing environments is preferred.

* Strong leadership, coaching, stakeholder management, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Process-oriented mindset with experience in performance monitoring, data analytics, and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools.

* Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.

title: Engineering Manager ETO - LVA & Busway
description:
**What You’ll Do**
Engineering Operations Leadership
  
  

* Lead a multi-disciplinary organization of engineers, designers, technical leads, and specialists supporting ETO, COE, COD, wiring diagrams, application engineering, layout and design, and manufacturing support for LVA and Busway.
* Own engineering execution from customer specification and order configuration through customer-approval drawings, detailed electrical and mechanical design, bills of material, manufacturing release, as-built updates, and engineering-change closure.
* Deliver on-time engineering releases, first-time-right quality, productivity, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction while maintaining compliance with product standards and plant processes.
* Establish capacity, workload, outsourcing, and cross-training plans that provide flexible support across low-voltage assembly and busway demand.
* Drive operating rhythms for backlog, engineering completion, order complexity, quality defects, change notices, risk escalation, recovery plans, and plant support.

Product-Line and Technical Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the technical and organizational leader for Low Voltage Assembly and Busway engineering. Ensure leaders and teams understand product architecture, application boundaries, configuration rules, electrical and mechanical interfaces, manufacturing constraints, installation dependencies, and test requirements.
* For LVA, guide engineering for Magnum PXR and Magnum DS low-voltage switchgear, including rear-access, front-access, arc-resistant, arc-quenching, NRX, OEM, indoor, and outdoor configurations supported by the product line.
* Ensure strong LVA knowledge of UL 1558 and UL 891 applications; main, tie, feeder, transition, auxiliary, metering, and control sections; breaker selection and application; horizontal and vertical bus; risers, runbacks, stabs, bracing, grounding and neutral systems; cable and conduit entry; control power; current and voltage transformers; protection, metering, communications, interlocks, automatic-transfer and power-control schemes; one-lines, three-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, and customer-connection requirements.

Engineering Systems, Digital Thread, and Continuous Improvement
  
  
Business, Plant, and Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  
Talent and Organizational Development
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelors/Masters in Electrical engineering or equivalent
* 15+ years of engineering experience in low-voltage power distribution, switchgear, busway, or related electromechanical products, with substantial experience in Engineer-to-Order, Customer Order Engineering, Customer Order Design, application engineering, detailed design, or requisition engineering. Minimum 5 years of people-leadership experience leading multi-disciplinary electrical and mechanical engineering teams; experience leading leaders or multiple product-line teams is preferred.

**Skills**

* Extensive knowledge of ETO order engineering, including specification and drawing review, configuration, feasibility assessment, customer-approval drawings, detailed design, bills of material, manufacturing release, change management, as-built documentation, and plant support.
* Demonstrated product knowledge in both Low Voltage Assembly and Busway engineering, or deep expertise in one product line with proven ability to build capability in the other.
* LVA knowledge: Magnum PXR and Magnum DS switchgear; front- and rear-access arrangements; arc-resistant and arc-quenching configurations; UL 1558 and UL 891 applications; breakers, bus, risers, runbacks, stabs, bracing, neutral and grounding systems; protection, metering, communication, interlocks, control power, automatic-transfer and power-control schemes; one-lines, three-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, and mechanical layouts.
* Busway knowledge: Pow-R-Way III, Pow-R-Way II, and supported busway offerings; feeder and plug-in busway; straight lengths and fittings; elbows, offsets, tees, crosses, flanges, joints, expansion and phase-transposition sections; transformer taps and throat connections; reducers, adapters, end feeds, end closers, hangers, power takeoffs, plug-in devices, layout drawings, final-field-fit requirements, and equipment coordination.
* Working knowledge of copper and aluminum conductor application, bus ampacity, voltage and short-circuit ratings, phasing, orientation, grounding, neutral arrangements, insulation, voltage drop, environmental ratings, clearances, supports, seismic requirements, installation constraints, and field coordination.
* Strong understanding of applicable ANSI, IEEE, UL, NEMA, NEC, NFPA, CSA, and IEC requirements, including low-voltage switchgear, busway, arc-resistant, testing, and installation requirements applicable to the supported portfolios.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, structure and compartment assembly, breaker and device fitment, bus fabrication and jointing, wiring, inspection, testing, packaging and shipping splits, quality systems, engineering changes, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience with BidManager or comparable configuration tools; AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical; Inventor or comparable 3D CAD; ENOVIA/3DX or comparable PLM; Design Automation; BIM; MAPICS/AS400; and manufacturing-release or order-management systems.
* Proven ability to lead design automation, BIM and digital-thread initiatives, reusable product definition, configuration validation, drawing and BOM automation, busway engineering automation, workflow optimization, and engineering-quality improvement.
* Demonstrated application of Lean, DMAIC, Design for Six Sigma, Agile, and continuous-improvement methods; Green Belt or Black Belt certification is preferred.
* Ability to evaluate competitor offerings, customer and market trends, product standards, installation practices, and technology developments relevant to low-voltage assemblies and busway.

title: Project Manager
description:
**About the Company**

Kirloskar Solar is propelled by a leading multi-engineering conglomerate, backed by 133 years of glorious legacy and undisputed leadership in giving cutting edge technology – The Kirloskar Group. We offer turn-key solar solutions, products, and services to all segments, from residential to large scale commercial and industries. We have an extensive portfolio of customers in all segments like Residential, Commercial, Industries, SMEs across sectors like Health care, Hospitality, Automotive, Commercial, Education, Agriculture and Manufacturing. We provide sustainable energy efficient solution to serve the entire spectrum of electricity consumers from those who have zero power cuts to those who have frequent power cuts. Product basket consists of solar PV modules, On-Grid String Inverters, On-Grid Central Inverters, Off-Grid Inverters, Off-Grid and On-Grid Power Packs.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly experienced, result-oriented, and dynamic AGM/DGM – Project Management to lead the execution of multiple rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects across India. The ideal candidate must have strong experience in a Solar EPC organization, with proven capabilities in project planning, execution, resource management, cost control, quality assurance, safety, and timely project delivery. The role requires strong leadership, excellent stakeholder management, and the ability to manage multiple projects and geographically distributed site teams simultaneously, ensuring compliance with contractual commitments, technical specifications, quality standards, and project timelines.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Project Planning and Management:**
Lead end-to-end execution of multiple rooftop and ground-mounted solar EPC projects across various locations. Develop and monitor detailed project schedules, milestones, critical-path activities, and resource plans. Establish project baselines and track progress against approved schedules, budgets, and contractual deliverables. Identify project risks, anticipate execution bottlenecks, and implement timely corrective and preventive actions. Ensure effective coordination between design, engineering, procurement, SCM, construction, testing, commissioning, and O&M teams.

**B. Solar Project Execution:**
Manage simultaneous execution of multiple solar projects, including rooftop installations and ground-mounted solar power plants. Drive site mobilization, civil works, MMS installation, module mounting, DC/AC electrical works, inverter installation, cabling, earthing, lightning protection, and associated infrastructure. Oversee grid connectivity, statutory approvals, inspections, synchronization, testing, commissioning, and project handover. Ensure timely resolution of technical issues, site constraints, material shortages, contractor performance issues, and client-related challenges. Monitor project progress through regular site reviews, field visits, and performance reports.

**C. Project Scheduling and Software:**
Prepare, review, and update detailed project schedules using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project. Develop WBS, Gantt charts, critical-path analysis, resource loading, progress curves, and look ahead schedules. Establish project monitoring dashboards, MIS reports, and early-warning systems for schedule deviations. Conduct periodic project review meetings and ensure timely reporting of progress, risks, delays, and recovery plans. Use project management software to drive accountability, coordination, and data-based decision-making.

**D. Cost, Budget and Commercial Control:**
Monitor project budgets, cost-to-complete, resource utilization, productivity, and overall project profitability. Control project costs while maintaining quality, safety, and contractual compliance. Review BOQs, subcontractor work orders, billing milestones, variations, and extra-work requirements in coordination with commercial and finance teams. Identify opportunities for value engineering, productivity improvement, and cost optimization. Support contractual correspondence, claims management, extension-of-time submissions, and resolution of project-related commercial issues.

**E. Resource and Contractor Management: Plan**
and deploy project managers, site engineers, supervisors, skilled and unskilled manpower, equipment, and subcontractors. Ensure adequate manpower and material availability in line with project schedules. Monitor contractor performance, site productivity, work quality, and adherence to execution plans. Coordinate with procurement, SCM, logistics, design, and central engineering teams to eliminate execution bottlenecks. Build a strong project execution team with clear responsibilities, performance targets, and accountability.
**F. Quality, Safety and Compliance: Ensure**
adherence to approved drawings, technical specifications, quality plans, inspection and test plans, and applicable standards. Enforce stringent EHS requirements, safe working practices, and statutory compliance across all project sites. Conduct project audits, site inspections, quality reviews, and safety assessments. Ensure timely closure of non-conformities, punch points, and commissioning observations. Promote a zero-accident culture and continuous improvement in execution practices.

**G. Client and Stakeholder Management:**
Act as the key project interface with clients, consultants, project management consultants, utilities, DISCOMs, subcontractors, and internal management. Conduct periodic project review meetings and provide transparent updates on progress, risks, and recovery actions. • Resolve project escalations proactively and maintain strong client relationships. Coordinate for approvals, inspections, grid connectivity, statutory clearances, and project acceptance. Ensure timely completion of contractual milestones, performance testing, documentation, and final handover.

**H. Leadership and Performance Management: Lead**
, mentor, and develop project managers and multidisciplinary site execution teams. Establish project-wise KPIs for schedule adherence, cost performance, quality, safety, and productivity. Drive accountability, disciplined reporting, and timely decision-making across project teams. Provide regular updates to senior management on project status, resource requirements, critical issues, and business risks. Implement standardized project management systems and best practices across the organization.

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

• B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution.

• 10–15 years of relevant experience, with strong hands-on experience in a Solar EPC company.

• Demonstrated experience in executing both rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects.

• Proven capability to manage multiple projects and geographically dispersed sites simultaneously. • Mandatory working knowledge of Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project, including project scheduling, monitoring, critical-path analysis, and progress tracking.

• Strong understanding of solar EPC engineering, construction, testing, commissioning, grid connectivity, and project handover.

• Experience in managing project teams, subcontractors, vendors, budgets, and client interfaces.

• Willingness to travel extensively across India, approximately 50–60% of working time.

**Preferred Skills and Competencies**

• PMP certification will be an added advantage.

• Strong leadership, team building, delegation, and conflict-resolution capabilities.

• Excellent planning, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project cost and profitability.

• Effective communication, negotiation, client management, and escalation-handling skills.

• Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver results within committed timelines.

• Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, project MIS, dashboards, and progress reporting

• A proactive, ownership-driven approach with a strong focus on execution excellence.

**Description**
Join Amazon Financials Foundation Services and lead transformative projects that power hundreds of billions of dollars in transactions across multiple currencies and countries. As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you'll collaborate with product, engineering, accounting, and finance teams to build scalable financial systems that fuel Amazon's global growth while shaping the future of financial accounting at Amazon scale.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Principal Technical Program Manager
  
  
Mastercard Networks Exchange is an intelligent and scalable offering that enables transaction originators and receivers to link to different
  
  
networks in the end-to-end transaction flow with just a single connection.
  
  
This one connection to global and regional payment rails reduces the cost and complications of managing individual connections to
  
  
multiple networks. As a trusted connectivity partner, Mastercard Networks Exchange presents a unified approach to help customers achieve economics of scale.
  
  
NEX is on a transformational modernization journey, building a next-generation platform that is highly scalable, resilient, and configurable to meet the evolving needs of our growing customer base. This modern foundation will enable faster innovation, improved reliability, and greater operational efficiency as we continue to expand our capabilities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Drives execution of an outcome from inception through successful delivery of the services or domains, or an outcome that spans multiple teams and integrations across the enterprise
  
  
Works with multiple scrum/delivery teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan
  
  
Conducts meaningful retrospectives, creates action plans to implement changes at the team level; coordinates with other TPMs in the program to align and plan potential actions to be implemented across the program
  
  
Looks across the program to identify potential system efficiencies or process improvements, and suggests proactive strategies for consideration by program leadership
  
  
Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program
  
  
Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus

At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
**Summary**
The Supply Chain Network Modeling Manager is responsible for leading the development and application of advanced supply chain network models that support operational decision-making across the enterprise. This role combines hands-on modeling expertise with people leadership responsibilities, managing a team of supply chain modelers and analysts while ensuring delivery of high-quality network design, transportation optimization, capacity planning, inventory optimization, and business continuity initiatives.
  
  
The Manager translates business challenges into analytical solutions that optimize cost, service, capacity, inventory, risk, and growth objectives. The role is accountable for developing team capabilities, establishing modeling standards and best practices, and ensuring successful execution of a portfolio of modeling projects aligned with organizational priorities.
  
  
**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Supply Chain Modelers and Analysts.
* Conduct performance management, career development planning, and succession planning activities.
* Support hiring, onboarding, training, and capability development of modeling resources.
* Establish technical competency standards and promote continuous learning across the team.
* Foster collaboration, innovation, and a high-performance culture.

**Project & Portfolio Leadership**

* Manage a portfolio of network modeling, transportation optimization, simulation, and supply chain strategy projects.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, resource availability, and organizational objectives.
* Provide project oversight, quality assurance, and governance throughout project lifecycles.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed on schedule and align with stakeholder expectations.
* Present recommendations and business cases to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Supply Chain Modeling & Optimization**

* Lead the design, development, maintenance, and enhancement of end-to-end supply chain network models.
* Evaluate scenarios including network expansion, consolidation, facility location, inventory positioning, manufacturing footprint changes, transportation strategies, and capacity investments.
* Analyze tradeoffs between cost, service levels, inventory, risk, resilience, sustainability, and growth.
* Develop transportation optimization and cost-to-serve models.
* Support long-range planning, annual operating planning, and capital investment decisions through scenario analysis.
* Drive adoption of advanced analytics, optimization, simulation, AI, and emerging technologies.

**Stakeholder Management & Consulting**

* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for analytics-driven decision making.
* Translate complex business problems into quantitative analyses and actionable recommendations.
* Facilitate workshops to define objectives, assumptions, constraints, and decision criteria.
* Communicate findings through executive presentations, dashboards, visualizations, and storytelling.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**Process & Capability Development**

* Establish and maintain modeling methodologies, governance processes, and best practices.
* Improve data quality, model documentation standards, and model validation procedures.
* Develop reusable templates, tools, and frameworks to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Support the evolution of Network Modeling as a Service (NMaaS) and consulting capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.

**Work Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics & Optimization.
* 2+ years of team management/leadership experience.
* Expertise translating business rules into modeling requirements and scenarios
* Expertise in network modeling, optimization, transportation, and operations research.
* Experience with supply chain network modeling tools, data analytics and visualization.
* Hands-on with network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, PowerBI, Alteryx, Databricks).
* Strong knowledge of supply chain design, inventory, warehousing, and capacity planning.
* Exposure to Operations and different supply chain strategies (store, crossdock, import, buy/lease, etc)
* Experience coaching and training modelers

**Education Qualification**
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or any other related discipline or equivalent related experience.
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  

* Network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, or similar)
* Supply chain simulation and modeling tools
* Advanced Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, and analytics platforms
* Statistical analysis, optimization, and scenario planning
* Supply chain design, inventory, transportation, warehousing, and capacity planning

Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Strategic thinking
* Influencing without authority
* Executive communication
* Coaching and talent development
* Project and portfolio management
* Change leadership
* Analytical problem-solving

Success Measures (KPIs)
  
  

* On-time delivery of modeling projects
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Team engagement and capability growth
* Business value from recommendations
* Cost savings, service improvements, and capacity optimization
* Adoption of modeling tools and best practices
* Reduced analysis cycle time through automation and standardization

Join a people-first culture that values your well-being, empowers your growth, and amplifies your impact. At Verdantas, your career goes beyond the expected, and your work helps build a better world.

**Ready to shape the future of resilient communities?**

We are seeking a
**Senior Project Scheduler**
to support a multi-billion-dollar electric transmission capital project. This position is
**in office**
and must be local to our Pune, Maharashtra office.

The Senior Scheduler owns the integrated master schedule and the scheduling function across a large transmission capital portfolio. This role sets the program's scheduling standard, including the schedule specification, coding structure, quality metrics, and reporting framework, and applies it across concurrent projects and multiple EPC contractors so portfolio-level performance is visible, comparable, and defensible.

**What You'll Do:**

* Portfolio Performance Monitoring & Schedule Management
* Own the integrated master schedule across the portfolio, establishing the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), activity coding, calendar, and milestone conventions that allow concurrent projects to be rolled up and compared
* Develop and baseline complex Critical Path Management (CPM) schedules in Primavera P6 and MS Project for the most technically demanding projects, including multi-contractor, multi-front, and outage-constrained work
* Lead critical path, float, variance, earned value, what-if, time-impact, and recovery analysis at both project and portfolio level
* Manage float as a program resource, monitoring consumption across projects and identifying where surplus on one project can release constrained resources to another
* Identify systemic schedule risk across the portfolio, distinguishing a recurring pattern from an isolated project problem
* Design the schedule reporting framework, determining what is measured, how it is presented, and what triggers action, and produce portfolio dashboards and executive reporting
* Coordinate schedule interfaces between projects, including shared corridors, shared outage windows, common long-lead equipment, and adjacent utility dependencies

**Schedule Governance & Standards**

* Author and maintain the program schedule specification, scheduling procedures, schedule quality criteria, and schedule KPI definitions, in collaboration with client governance teams
* Establish the contractor schedule review and acceptance process, and the thresholds at which schedule movement requires narrative justification, impact analysis, or escalation
* Lead review and acceptance of EPC contractor baseline and update schedules across multiple contractors, holding a consistent standard across the portfolio
* Own schedule change control, assessing impacts of scope change, evaluating delay claims and time extension requests, and supporting mitigation and recovery planning
* Drive continuous improvement of scheduling practice, feeding lessons learned back into procedures, templates, and training

**Client & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the senior scheduling point of contact for owner program leadership, presenting portfolio schedule performance, forecast confidence, and recovery options in program and executive reviews
* Lead schedule discussions with EPC contractors, holding them to the specification while keeping the working relationship productive
* Present at milestone-readiness reviews and support stage-gate decisions with schedule evidence
* Work on site at the client's downtown Houston offices on a regular basis as an embedded member of the internal project team

**Risk Identification & Escalation**

* Surface emerging portfolio-level schedule risk early, with quantified impact, alternatives, and a recommended course of action
* Define and apply escalation thresholds and response times for schedule exposure, and hold the program to them
* Maintain the record of schedule assumptions, mitigation commitments, and recovery actions, and drive them to verified closure

**People & Team Development**

* Mentor and develop project-level schedulers and project controls staff; raise consistency of P6 practice across the program team
* Support recruitment, technical assessment, and onboarding of scheduling staff as the program scales
* Serve as the firm's senior scheduling resource on this program and a technical reference for the wider project controls community

**What You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management, Business, or a related field
* 10+ years of project scheduling and/or project controls experience
* 10+ years of hands-on experience using Primavera P6 and MS Project
* 5+ years of experience leading projects and scheduling large infrastructure projects
* Proven experience developing, maintaining, and owning integrated master schedules for large, multi-project capital programs
* Direct experience supporting major energy infrastructure projects
* Demonstrated ability to review, challenge, and approve EPC contractor schedules
* Experience developing and implementing schedule specifications, procedures, and governance standards
* Strong knowledge of Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling, float management, earned value management, and time impact analysis
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Procore, or similar software
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience delivering schedule performance updates to senior client stakeholders

**Preferred:**

* Experience serving as an Owner's Engineer, Owner's Representative, or utility owner-side program team member
* Experience establishing project controls or scheduling frameworks for new programs
* Experience coordinating schedule interfaces across adjacent utilities, shared corridors, or interconnected infrastructure projects
* Prior experience mentoring, leading, or supervising scheduling professionals
* Experience developing dashboards and reporting tools using Power BI or similar platforms
* Working knowledge of SAP, Oracle Unifier, or comparable ERP and project management systems
* Experience with Copilot tool development
* Professional certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP), or AACE Planning & Scheduling Professional (PSP)
* Experience performing delay analysis and construction claims support activities

**What We Offer**

We believe in supporting our employees both professionally and personally. Our benefits and programs are designed to promote well-being, flexibility, development, and long-term financial security.

* Flexible Work Environment
* Medical Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Gratuity, as applicable
* Paid Time Off & Holidays

* Learning & Development Opportunities
* Employee Recognition Programs
* Other benefits as per company policy

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Business Title: Engineering Manager**
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model,
**2-3 days in the office**
. You will be required to interview in person.

**About SailPoint**
SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.
  
Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.
  
  
**About the Role**
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and empower a high-performing team of software engineers responsible for owning the technical development of SailPoint’s core product capabilities. In this role, you will champion technical excellence, write and review quality code, debug complex distributed systems issues, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous delivery. You will work in an Agile environment, collaborating closely with US-based teams and stakeholders to build and maintain cloud-native, event-driven microservices on AWS.
  
  
**About the Team**
At SailPoint, our Engineering team is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. We are a results-driven crew built on innovation, collaboration, and mutual trust. Our team designs and deploys scalable, enterprise-grade identity security products powered by mature cloud architecture and cutting-edge technologies.
  
  

**Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* **15+ years of experience in software engineering**
  , with demonstrated experience building, leading, and managing teams of software engineers
* Strong foundational understanding of
  **software development, particularly in Java,**
  as well as modern front-end architectures.
* Proven track record of success delivering complex software solutions in an Agile development environment
* Solid foundation in software engineering principles, distributed systems, and cloud architecture (AWS preferred)
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills with a passion for continuous improvement
* Strong project management abilities with experience scoping, prioritizing, tracking, and delivering engineering milestones
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones
* Willingness to maintain at least 4 overlapping working hours with US time zones

**AI-assisted engineering:**
Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.
  
  
**AI related Technology:**

* Cursor, Claude Code
* Python-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, and numpy
* Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch
* LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar

**Roadmap for Success**

**30 Days:**

* Complete SailPoint onboarding, understand our identity security product suite, and get familiar with the cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture hosted on AWS.
* Establish relationships with your engineering team, Product Management partners, and US-based counterparts.
* Understand the current sprint commitments, team workflows, and active technical priorities.

**60 Days:**

* Assume day-to-day leadership of the engineering team and run Agile ceremonies effectively.
* Actively partner with Product Management to review roadmaps, scope incoming projects, and allocate engineering resources.
* Begin coaching and setting clear performance objectives for direct reports through regular 1:1 mentorship sessions.

**90 Days:**

* Own end-to-end project planning, tracking, and risk management for your team's deliverables and key milestones.
* Maintain a seamless communication cadence with global stakeholders, ensuring overlapping collaboration with the US team.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process or architectural improvements to raise code quality and team velocity.

**6 Months:**

* Drive the successful release of high-impact features and architectural enhancements to production on AWS.
* Foster a strong culture of career development, mentoring engineers toward their next career milestones.
* Proactively manage technical risk, system reliability, and resource allocation across multiple simultaneous initiatives.

**1 Year:**

* Establish a proven track record of predictable, high-quality product delivery that advances SailPoint’s identity security platform.
* Scale team capabilities, mentor emerging leaders, and contribute strategic engineering input toward long-term product roadmaps.
