Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions.
  
  
Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role purpose**
Lead the planning, execution and delivery of vegetable-seed trials
*(includes PLC 6.1, agronomy trials, satellite demos, demo day fields)*
across India to generate robust, high-quality data that supports product advancement, positioning and successful commercial launch. The role connects breeding, product specialists, agronomy and commercial teams, ensuring trials reflect diverse Indian growing environments and customer needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute annual trialing plans for assigned vegetable crops, including varietal evaluation, product placement and agronomic practices
* Identify and manage trial locations across key agro-climatic zones, ensuring representative testing for season, disease pressure, soil type and grower practice.
* Lead trial protocol development & execution, plot design, data standards and timely execution through internal teams, external partners and contract growers.
* Ensure accurate collection, validation and analysis of trial data covering yield, quality, maturity, disease tolerance, plant habit, shelf life and marketable traits as per the product profile. Effective use of the internal tools like Ez Capture
* Translate trial results into clear recommendations on advancement, positioning, target geographies and product claims.
* Work closely with Product specialist, Breeding & TPP teams to support pipeline decisions and hybrid advancement with trial execution, PAT execution, data collection and data consolidation for proposal to the product meetings
* Partner with commercial, Product specialist, customer experience teams to establish satellite demo & demo days field demonstrations and build compelling evidence for launches and demand generation activities around CPIs with CX and Commercial team
* Manage trialing budgets, seasonal resource plans, vendors and compliance requirements.
* Lead, coach and develop the trialing team, setting clear objectives, managing performance, building technical and operational capability, and ensuring effective deployment of people and resources across trial locations and seasons.
* Ensure adherence to company stewardship, safety, quality, phytosanitary and data-integrity standards.
* Support to the commercial team for the mass scale customer complaints validation and RCA process

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications and experience**

* Master’s degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Plant Breeding, Agronomy or a related discipline
* Around 15 years of relevant experience in vegetable-seed trialing, product development, agronomy or field trial management
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-location trials in India, preferably across multiple vegetable crops and seasons.
* Strong understanding of vegetable production systems, crop agronomy, hybrid evaluation and market requirements.
* Experience in experimental design, statistical analysis and digital trial-data systems.
* Proven ability to lead field teams and external partners across geographically dispersed locations.
* Fluency in English; working proficiency in Hindi and/or regional languages is preferred.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India during key trialing periods.

**Key competencies**

* Strong scientific and agronomic judgement
* Rigorous data quality and attention to detail
* Planning and execution discipline
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration
* Commercial awareness and customer orientation
* People leadership and capability building
* Clear, evidence-based communication

**Success measures**

* Timely completion and quality of planned trials
* Reliable, decision-ready data for pipeline and launch decisions
* Effective product recommendations by crop and region
* Trial budget and resource efficiency
* Strong adoption of trialing standards, stewardship and data governance
* Successful support for priority product launches in India

**Additional Information**
Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:

* Excellent consultative approach to customer engagements

* Ability to work in a cross-functional team environment and collaborate with key partners to drive customer engagement and experience

**Requirements**

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
**Job Title:**
**Implementation Specialist**
**Locations:**
**London, Pune (Hybrid)**
**Full Time, Permanent**
**Application Deadline: Sunday 8th November 2026**
**About Springer Nature**
Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.
  
  
At Springer Nature, we recognise that great talent develops through many different paths. We encourage applications from individuals with strong transferable skills, provided they are supported by relevant experience that shows how those skills have been successfully applied in practice. Our hiring approach balances skills, experience, and potential to ensure each role is fulfilled with both short term effectiveness and long term growth in mind.
  
  
**About The Team**
Springer Nature’s Group Publishing Operations team (GPO) performs and oversees manuscript screening operations across Springer Nature's journals portfolio. GPO also manages the various peer-review systems used by authors, editors and reviewers as part of submit-to-accept processes.
  
  
Our 'article-level' activities are largely supported by 400+ BPO staff across multiple locations. Our 'journal-level' activities are largely supported by :50 Springer Nature staff across multiple locations, who also contribute to projects in one of three main areas: technology, transformation and quality.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Implementation Specialist will manage their own portfolio of journals and partner with Publishing teams to run their journals in a ‘Production-ready’ way, while facilitating submit-to-accept workflows and compliance with policies.
  
  
In collaboration with the Manager, Quality Assurance (as well as the rest of the Quality Assurance team and the wider GPO team), the Implementation Specialist will also contribute to GPO’s quality assurance programme (proactively and reactively addressing quality issues), with the aim of delivering best-in-class quality levels across GPO.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities:**
*Journal care*

* Gather system requirements from publishers, editors and service providers.
* Set up, maintain and administrate peer review systems.
* Conduct presentations and training sessions for internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure quality of article-level activities and act as an escalation point for individual journals.
* Develop and maintain relationships with stakeholders (Publishing, Editorial, Production, Technology & Operations staff, as well as external editors, reviewers, authors and service providers).
* Maintain journal-specific records and documentation.

*Quality Assurance*

* Collaborate with GPO’s Automation & Analysis team to gather meaningful and reliable quality-related insights.
* Proactively monitor quality across journals and investigate issues surfaced by the monitoring, as well as ones reported by stakeholders.
* Collaborate with GPO service providers, other Implementation Specialists, as well as GPO’s Workflow Solutions and Training Programmes teams, to ensure the underlying causes of quality issues are addressed.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Be an advocate for continuous improvement, quality and efficiency. Foster a culture of openness, transparency and collaboration within the team and with our stakeholders.

**Experience, Skills & Qualifications:**
**Essential**

* Contributing to (sometimes interconnected) business projects.
* Working with a wide range of global stakeholders.
* Excellent organisation skills to contribute to multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate with individuals at all levels and on a global scale.
* Excellent numeracy skills with proven attention to detail.
* Excel and PowerPoint proficiency.
* Good problem solving/logic/analytical skills.
* Proactive and able to lead projects alone as well as part of a large group.
* Degree or equivalent work experience.

*Desirable*

* Previous experience in a publishing and/or support role.
* Understanding of publishing workflows.
* Business analysis and data analysis.
* Formal project management qualification such as PRINCE2

At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodation. Find out more about our DEI work here https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/taking-responsibility/diversity-equity-inclusion
  
  
For more information about career opportunities in Springer Nature please visit https://springernature.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/SpringerNatureCareers/

title: Associate Director - Product Engineering
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production.
  
  
We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s).
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
* Identify and work to eliminate blockers
* Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
* e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production
* You will generally be responsible for 2 squads of between 5-9 people
* You will have an Enterprise mind-set able to foster collaboration, break down silos, identify and work to remove blockers
* You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
* You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
* Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
* Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment
* Pods support the full lifecycle of a product, and we operate on the philosophy that the work comes to the team. You will need to consider tech debt, obsolescence, security and modernization
* Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
* Plan product releases
* You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
* Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices
* Own the Continuous Improvement backlog for your squad. This is the key mechanism by which we deliver improvements for the following; time to market, efficiency and quality
* You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
* You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
* In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline.
* 12+ years of total experience
* Experience and track record of successful delivery in a regulated, complex, multi-product technological landscape. We also have significant security processes and legislative requirements to protect our customers and their data
* You will be expected to have a broad technical understanding to support your Agile credentials from software architecture through test, DevOps practices, security and operational run
* A metrics driven approach to delivery evaluation and drive out systems and processes that help define and report on the metrics we believe to be important
* Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile
* Ideally familiarity with managing AI model developments into existing and new applications
* Pods and squads are distributed globally and utilise a mix of permanent and partner staff who work largely remotely so experience of working with and motivating distributed teams is vital
* You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices
* Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
* Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent

**What makes you stand out:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

This role drives delivery across a team spanning cloud and platform infrastructure, model serving, gateway software, design and field engineering, against milestone commitments that involve both a hardware vendor and enterprise customers. You need enough technical depth to understand what a cluster upgrade, a Helm release, a gateway metering change or a model bundle rollout involves, so that plans are realistic, and blockers are recognized early. You are not expected to be hands-on in every area, but you are expected to know when an estimate is fiction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive projects end to end in an Agile manner: requirement gathering, backlog shaping, sprint planning, estimation, sequencing, dependency management, execution and delivery.
* Own milestone plans and gate criteria, and track progress against them with evidence rather than status assertions.
* Manage workload, capacity, dependencies, blockers, and parallel workstreams across infrastructure, platform, software, design and field teams.
* Run daily stand-ups, sprint ceremonies, status tracking, and delivery governance.
* Coordinate enterprise AI deployments across engineering, QA, infrastructure, platform, operations and support teams.
* Understand and manage the flow from engineering preparation and QA through infrastructure handover, operational validation, deployment, release, and upgrade management.
* Manage the interfaces with the hardware vendor and the customer, including the boundary where operational responsibility changes hands.
* Understand the platform and product capability well enough to plan solution work credibly and to challenge scope that does not fit.
* Track technical debt as a managed item with owners and target dates rather than background noise.
* Maintain RAID logs, dependency maps and decision records, and keep them current enough to be useful in a review.
* Track progress, quality, defects, risks and dependencies through dashboards and reports stakeholders can read without translation.
* Prepare and present weekly status reports and milestone updates to senior internal stakeholders and customers.
* Own release and upgrade planning and change governance for production platform changes, and support incident and problem management follow-through.
* Work closely with customer product managers and technical leads to understanding priorities and translating them into engineering work, managing expectations on scope and timelines, and surfacing bad news early with options attached.
* Support onboarding of new team members, set clear expectations on roles and interfaces between roles, and maintain delivery performance inputs for reviews.
* Use agentic AI tooling to automate status collation, backlog hygiene, report generation and meeting follow-up.

**Tools and Technologies**

**Category**

**Tools and technologies**

**Agile and delivery**

Jira including boards, workflows and Advanced Roadmaps, Confluence, Azure DevOps or Linear, Miro for planning and mapping, story-point and capacity-based estimation

**Reporting and dashboards**

Jira dashboards and filters, Power BI or Tableau, burndown, velocity and cumulative flow analysis, executive and customer status reporting

**ITSM and operations**

Incident, problem and change management, ServiceNow or Freshservice, release and upgrade planning, change advisory process, runbook governance, on-call rota management

**Technical literacy at a functional level**

Kubernetes and RKE2 concepts, Helm-based releases and upgrade sequencing, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure and hybrid connectivity, inference gateway components covering authentication, metering, quotas and billing, observability stacks, model bundle deployment

**Source control and release**

GitHub or GitLab, branching and release strategies, environment promotion, release notes and versioning

**Risk and governance**

RAID logs, dependency mapping, RACI matrices, milestone and gate reviews, decision records, capacity planning

**Customer and commercial**

Salesforce, statement-of-work and milestone tracking, customer governance cadence, escalation management

**AI-assisted delivery**

Agentic AI tooling for status collation, backlog hygiene, report generation and meeting follow-up

**Minimum Requirements**

* Strong command of Agile delivery practice, including requirement gathering, sprint planning, estimation, sequencing, and dependency management.
* Demonstrated delivery of technical infrastructure or platform projects, not application feature delivery alone.
* Working understanding of Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and enterprise deployment processes at a functional level.
* Familiarity with SRE and operations practice: release and upgrade management, incident, problem and change management, and production readiness.
* Ability to understand the responsibilities and technical blockers of different engineering disciplines and to plan around them.
* Strong dashboard, reporting, and stakeholder-management capability.
* Experience managing delivery across organizational boundaries such as vendors, partners, or customer teams.
* Excellent customer and stakeholder communication, including under escalation, strong coordination without formal authority, and the willingness to challenge a plan that does not hold up.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Experience delivering AI, ML or data platform programmes.
* Experience in a managed-services or partner-delivery model with contractual milestones.
* Certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM or SAFe.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or cloud administration at a hands-on level earlier in your career.
* Experience managing on-call and operational readiness transitions from project delivery into a steady state.

title: Technical Project Manager & System Engineer
description:
We are hiring an experienced and technically proficient Technical Project Manager & System Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize mission-critical hosting infrastructure, server environments, virtualization platforms, and Network Operations Centre (NOC) operations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Linux and Windows server administration, web hosting technologies, virtualization, networking, monitoring tools, and automation. The role requires hands-on technical capabilities combined with project coordination, team leadership, client communication, and service delivery management.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, security, reliability, and performance of the university's hosting and IT infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Server Management and Administration**

- Manage, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual servers running Linux and Windows operating systems.

- Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, server applications, and essential infrastructure services.

- Manage remote server administration using IPMI, Dell iDRAC, KVM, and similar out-of-band management tools.

- Monitor server health, performance, availability, resource utilization, and hardware status.

- Diagnose and resolve server-related incidents, system failures, and performance issues.

**B. Virtualization and Infrastructure Management**

- Configure, administer, and maintain virtualization platforms such as Proxmox, SolusVM, Virtualizor, and Microsoft Hyper-V.

- Support the implementation, deployment, and administration of the Virtuozzo virtualization platform.

- Manage virtual machines, resource allocation, provisioning, migration, backups, and recovery.

- Optimize infrastructure utilization, scalability, availability, and performance.

- Support capacity planning and infrastructure expansion initiatives.

**C. Web Hosting and Control Panel Administration**

- Administer web hosting control panels, including cPanel/WHM and Plesk.

- Manage hosting environments, websites, domains, accounts, and server resources.

- Maintain and troubleshoot Apache, DNS, email services, MySQL/MariaDB, IIS, and Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL).

- Diagnose website availability, hosting performance, database connectivity, and email delivery issues.

- Implement appropriate security measures, updates, backups, and recovery procedures.

**D. Network Operations and Infrastructure Monitoring**

- Monitor server, application, hardware, and network availability to ensure reliable service delivery.

- Configure and manage monitoring solutions such as LibreNMS, Zabbix, Icinga 2, and Grafana.

- Work with Prometheus and Alertmanager for infrastructure metrics, alerting, and observability.

- Troubleshoot network connectivity, DNS resolution, and infrastructure communication issues.

- Work with SNMP, Redfish APIs, and hardware management interfaces, including iLO, iDRAC, and IPMI.

- Develop and improve monitoring practices, escalation procedures, and incident response processes.

**E. Automation and Scripting**

- Develop and maintain automation workflows for server provisioning, configuration, deployment, and routine maintenance.

- Use Ansible and other appropriate scripting or automation tools to streamline infrastructure operations.

- Support automation deployment using NOC-PS and related tools, where applicable.

- Identify repetitive operational activities and implement solutions to improve efficiency and consistency.

- Contribute to the development and scaling of infrastructure monitoring and automation capabilities.

**F. Technical Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution**

- Diagnose and resolve complex Linux and Windows operating system issues.

- Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and infrastructure failures.

- Manage incident escalation, service restoration, and preventive maintenance.

- Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks.

- Ensure adherence to established service levels, security practices, and operational standards.

**G. Technical Project Management**

- Plan and coordinate infrastructure deployment, virtualization implementation, server migration, and automation projects.

- Define project activities, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.

- Coordinate with internal IT teams, external service providers, vendors, and stakeholders.

- Track project progress, identify risks, and ensure timely completion of assigned activities.

- Support capacity planning, infrastructure upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**H. Team Leadership and Client Coordination**

- Lead and coordinate technical operations within server management and NOC environments.

- Guide technical team members in troubleshooting, incident resolution, and infrastructure maintenance.

- Coordinate with clients and stakeholders to understand technical requirements and resolve service issues.

- Maintain effective communication during incidents, escalations, and infrastructure changes.

- Promote collaboration, accountability, knowledge sharing, and high-quality service delivery.

**Educational Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

- Relevant postgraduate qualifications or industry certifications will be an advantage.

- Relevant certifications in Linux administration, Microsoft technologies, virtualization, networking, or infrastructure automation are desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

- 5–7 years of relevant experience in web hosting, server administration, IT infrastructure, or NOC operations.

- Demonstrated hands-on experience with Linux and Windows server environments.

- Practical experience with cPanel/WHM, Plesk, and server hosting technologies.

- Experience with virtualization platforms such as Proxmox, SolusVM, Virtualizor, or Hyper-V.

- Experience with automation tools such as Ansible and infrastructure monitoring solutions.

- Prior experience in technical team coordination, project execution, or client-facing technical support is preferred.

**Essential Technical Skills**

- Linux and Windows Server Administration

- Physical and Virtual Server Management

- cPanel/WHM and Plesk

- Proxmox, SolusVM, Virtualizor, and Hyper-V

- Virtuozzo implementation and administration

- DNS, Apache, IIS, email servers, MySQL/MariaDB, and MSSQL

- Networking fundamentals and troubleshooting

- IPMI, iDRAC, KVM, iLO, SNMP, and Redfish APIs

- LibreNMS, Zabbix, Icinga 2, Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager

- Ansible and infrastructure automation

- Incident management and root-cause analysis

- Technical project coordination and team leadership

**Key Competencies**

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

- Effective team leadership and coordination.

- Strong project planning and execution skills.

- Customer-focused approach to technical support and service delivery.

- Ability to manage priorities and resolve issues in mission-critical environments.

- Excellent communication skills in English, Hindi, and Marathi.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance may be evaluated against the following parameters:

- Server and infrastructure availability.

- Incident response and resolution time.

- Compliance with agreed service levels.

- Effectiveness of monitoring and alerting.

- Successful implementation of virtualization and automation projects.

- Reduction in recurring incidents and manual operational effort.

- Backup, recovery, security, and maintenance compliance.

- Project delivery within agreed timelines.

- Team productivity and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Application Process**

Interested and eligible candidates are invited to apply by sharing their updated resume with the recruitment team.

Compensation will be commensurate with qualifications, relevant experience, and organizational norms.

http://career.sspu.ac.in/ProjectFolders/Candidate/Joblisting.aspx

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) -**
**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD integration and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) capabilities supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital compliance requirements. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience.
* 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with design and implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions that support global e-invoicing, statutory reporting, and digital compliance requirements. Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. Ability to translate country-specific statutory and e-invoicing requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, and testing scenarios.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.
* Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos
* Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.
* Experience with Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, Open Text, Read soft Integration with ERP.

description:
**Job Description:**
TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
  
  

* Location: PAN India
* Number of Positions: 2
* Experience Required: 8–14 Years
* Work Mode: Hybrid

**Job Summary: (P3/P4)**
We are seeking an experienced TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead to own and drive the endtoend delivery and operational support of Körber PASX solutions on Azure AKS, ensuring timely, and highquality MES services within a regulated manufacturing environment. The role combines strong technical depth and functional understanding of MES processes to coordinate crossfunctional teams, manage integrations and dependencies, proactively resolve issues, and ensure validated, compliant, and reliable MES solutions that meet business, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the MES PASX tower (v3.3.x) across programs, ensuring platform stability, scalability and compliance in cloudbased AKS (Azure Kubernetes Services) environments.
* Define and govern MES architecture standards, integration patterns, deployment models and operational best practices for PASX on Azure.
* Ensure alignment of MES tower strategy with manufacturing IT, Digital Manufacturing roadmaps, ISA88/95 standards and enterprise IT governance.
* Act as the single point of accountability for MES PASX delivery, operations, quality and compliance.
* Lead endtoend MES PASX implementations and upgrades, from requirement gathering through configuration, qualification and final delivery.
* Ensure to Coordinate on rollouts and system upgrades for PASX application.
* Own MES Service Delivery Operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and adherence to SLAs.
* Govern 2ndlevel support operations for PASX, Azure, Kubernetes, and MES integrations.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change and Release Management processes in line with ITIL.
* Proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide technical leadership for PASX deployment and lifecycle management on AKS, including service pack installations and platform upgrades.
* Govern OS, application and platform patching (Windows/Linux) and ensure timely vulnerability remediation.
* Oversee Kubernetes, Linux and databaserelated activities, ensuring performance, resilience and availability of MES environments.
* Collaborate closely with enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Network teams.
* Own and govern MES integrations with Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 systems including SAP ERP, OSI PI, LIMS & Kepware/OPC.
* Ensure robust design, monitoring and support of DCS adapters, services and interfaces.
* Drive troubleshooting for complex crosssystem issues spanning MES, DCS, ERP, and shopfloor automation.
* Establish governance for MES PASX Users & Rights, Control Data & Profiles, Terminals, Printing, and Reporting, Production Units, WMS Master Data, Service & system configurations.
* Ensure data consistency, audit readiness, and alignment with validated system requirements.
* Ensure MES solutions comply with CSV, SDLC, 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP and GAMP requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with vendors such as Körber, Microsoft and system integrators.
* Manage vendor delivery, escalations and roadmap alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, plant teams, QA, infrastructure and enterprise IT leadership.
* Provide technical and functional leadership to MES engineers and support teams.

title: NPD & Procurement Specialist
company: CITTA (Lexicon Lifestyle - A Lexicon Group Enterprise)
description:
* **About CITTA**
* CITTA is a growing Indian skincare and personal care brand built on the philosophy of combining modern science with the wisdom of Indian traditions. We develop thoughtful, quality-driven products across skincare, bath and body, and personal care, with a focus on product efficacy, ingredient transparency, and consumer needs.
* We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented
  **NPD & Procurement Specialist**
  to manage the end-to-end new product development process while ensuring timely, cost-effective, and quality-driven sourcing of raw materials, packaging components, and finished products.
* **About the Role**
* The NPD & Procurement Specialist will be responsible for coordinating new product development from concept to commercialisation, working closely with product development teams, third-party manufacturers, vendors, quality assurance, regulatory teams, and internal stakeholders.
* The role will involve identifying suitable suppliers, sourcing ingredients and packaging, coordinating sampling and product trials, negotiating commercial terms, tracking development timelines, and ensuring that products meet CITTA’s quality, cost, and launch requirements.
* Key Responsibilities
* **1. New Product Development (NPD)**
* Coordinate the end-to-end development of new skincare, bath and body, and personal care products from concept to launch.
* Work with internal teams and third-party manufacturers to develop product briefs, specifications, formulations, and packaging requirements.
* Research market trends, competitor products, emerging ingredients, consumer preferences, and new product opportunities in the skincare and beauty industry.
* Coordinate product sampling, formulation trials, stability testing, compatibility testing, and product performance evaluations with relevant technical teams.
* Track product development milestones, sample approvals, revisions, and launch timelines.
* Coordinate with marketing, packaging, quality, and regulatory teams to ensure product readiness before launch.
* Maintain comprehensive records of product specifications, approved samples, costing sheets, development status, and supplier documentation.
* **2. Procurement & Vendor Management**
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard suppliers and vendors for skincare ingredients, raw materials, packaging materials, labels, cartons, and other product components.
* Source suitable third-party manufacturers and contract manufacturing partners based on product requirements, quality standards, production capabilities, and commercial terms.
* Obtain and compare quotations, negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities (MOQs), lead times, and delivery schedules.
* Raise purchase orders and coordinate with vendors to ensure timely delivery of materials as per approved requirements.
* Develop and maintain a reliable vendor database, including supplier credentials, pricing, lead times, and performance records.
* Build strong vendor relationships to ensure consistent supply, competitive pricing, and timely resolution of procurement issues.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising product quality, safety, or brand standards.
* **3. Costing & Budget Management**
* Prepare product costing sheets covering raw materials, packaging, manufacturing, testing, and other applicable development costs.
* Evaluate vendor quotations and support cost negotiations to achieve target product costs and margins.
* Track actual costs against approved budgets and highlight significant cost variations.
* Support management in evaluating product feasibility based on target pricing, minimum order quantities, and expected commercial viability.
* Maintain updated records of product costs, supplier pricing, and procurement commitments.
* **4. Quality & Regulatory Coordination**
* Coordinate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure that ingredients, packaging materials, formulations, and finished products meet applicable quality and compliance requirements.
* Obtain and maintain relevant supplier documentation, including specifications, Certificates of Analysis (CoAs), Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and other applicable technical documents.
* Ensure that required product testing, stability assessments, packaging compatibility checks, and approvals are completed before commercial production, in coordination with the responsible technical teams.
* Support documentation and compliance requirements applicable to cosmetics and personal care products in India.
* Coordinate the resolution of quality issues, rejected samples, material discrepancies, and supplier non-conformities.
* **5. Production Planning & Coordination**
* Coordinate with manufacturers and suppliers to align procurement schedules with product development and launch timelines.
* Monitor material availability, production schedules, order status, and delivery commitments.
* Follow up on pending samples, purchase orders, packaging approvals, and manufacturing requirements to avoid delays.
* Identify potential supply chain risks and escalate issues affecting product development, cost, quality, or launch dates.
* Work closely with inventory and operations teams to support material planning and avoid excess inventory or stock shortages.
* **6. Documentation & Reporting**
* Maintain an NPD tracker covering product concepts, sampling stages, approvals, costs, testing status, and expected launch dates.
* Maintain procurement trackers for purchase orders, vendor quotations, delivery schedules, and outstanding materials.
* Prepare regular reports on product development progress, procurement savings, vendor performance, and pending activities.
* Ensure proper documentation of product development decisions, supplier agreements, commercial terms, and approvals.
* **Requirements**
* 3–6 years of experience in new product development, procurement, sourcing, or product operations, preferably within skincare, cosmetics, beauty, personal care, or FMCG.
* Experience coordinating with third-party manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, and packaging vendors.
* Understanding of skincare product development, including formulations, ingredients, packaging components, sampling, and testing processes.
* Working knowledge of procurement processes, vendor negotiations, purchase orders, costing, and supplier management.
* Ability to evaluate quotations, compare commercial terms, and identify cost optimisation opportunities.
* Strong coordination and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple product development projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and documentation or procurement tracking tools.
* Strong communication, negotiation, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage deadlines across multiple stakeholders.
* **Good to Have**
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and private-label skincare or cosmetic brands.
* Familiarity with cosmetic ingredients, INCI nomenclature, formulation briefs, and packaging compatibility.
* Understanding of cosmetic quality documentation, stability testing, and Indian cosmetics regulatory requirements.
* Experience with ERP, inventory management, or procurement management systems.
* Exposure to product launches across e-commerce, D2C, retail, or modern trade channels.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Timely completion of NPD milestones and product launches.
* Reduction in product development lead times and sample approval cycles.
* Achievement of target product costs and measurable procurement savings.
* Timely sourcing and delivery of raw materials and packaging components.
* Vendor performance in terms of quality, pricing, responsiveness, and delivery adherence.
* Accuracy and completeness of product development and procurement documentation.
* Compliance with approved quality standards and completion of required testing and approvals before launch.
* **What Success Looks Like in the First 6–12 Months**
* Establish a structured NPD pipeline with clear timelines, responsibilities, and approval stages.
* Build a dependable vendor network for ingredients, packaging, and contract manufacturing.
* Improve development turnaround time and procurement efficiency.
* Deliver new products within approved cost, quality, and launch timelines.
* Create a well-maintained database of product specifications, supplier quotations, costing sheets, and development records.

title: Senior Consultant – Oracle Fusion Payroll
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Fusion Payroll Consultant with strong functional expertise in payroll concepts, Oracle Fusion Payroll implementation, configuration, and troubleshooting. The role involves delivering end-to-end payroll implementations, enhancements, testing, and production support for clients in the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

The consultant will work offshore in close collaboration with onsite teams to configure payroll solutions, develop and debug Fast Formulas, execute parallel payroll runs, resolve complex payroll issues, and ensure accurate payroll processing and successful go-live.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Payroll Configuration:**
  Configure payroll definitions, elements, eligibility rules, balances, payment methods, costing, and General Ledger (GL) transfer.
* **Payroll Concepts:**
  Apply a strong understanding of gross-to-net calculations, earnings and deductions, retroactive processing, proration, arrears, balances and dimensions, costing, and payroll period close.
* **Fast Formula Development:**
  Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot payroll Fast Formulas to support complex payroll calculations and business requirements.
* **Implementation:**
  Lead and execute end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, including requirements analysis, configuration, testing, data migration, go-live, and hypercare.
* **Testing and Parallel Runs:**
  Prepare test scenarios, conduct system integration testing (SIT), execute parallel payroll cycles, and reconcile results against legacy payroll systems.
* **Troubleshooting and Support:**
  Diagnose failed payroll flows, incorrect calculations, retroactive processing issues, balance discrepancies, and costing errors using logs, element entries, and balance views.
* **Data Migration:**
  Perform payroll balance and element entry migrations using HCM Data Loader (HDL), validate migrated data, and support payroll readiness for go-live.
* **UAE Payroll Localization:**
  Support UAE payroll requirements, including Wage Protection System (WPS), applicable pension and social security rules, gratuity, and leave salary calculations, as relevant to client requirements.
* **Enhancements and Updates:**
  Implement payroll policy changes, assess quarterly Oracle updates, conduct regression testing, and maintain existing payroll configurations.
* **Reporting:**
  Develop and maintain payroll and costing reports to support payroll validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
* **Oracle Support:**
  Raise, manage, and follow up on Oracle service requests to resolve product-related issues.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Work closely with onsite leads, HR, Finance, technical teams, and client stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver payroll solutions.
* **Documentation:**
  Maintain functional specifications, configuration documents, test scripts, reconciliation reports, and implementation documentation.

**Role Requirements and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in Oracle Payroll, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Payroll.
* Minimum of 2 end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, covering configuration, parallel runs, and go-live.
* Strong understanding of payroll concepts, gross-to-net calculations, earnings, deductions, balances, retroactive processing, proration, arrears, and costing.
* Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Payroll configuration and payroll processing.
* Proficiency in developing, debugging, and troubleshooting Oracle Payroll Fast Formulas.
* Experience with payroll testing, parallel runs, payroll reconciliation, data migration, and production support.
* Hands-on experience with HCM Data Loader (HDL) for payroll balance and element entry migration.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across payroll flows, calculation errors, balance discrepancies, and costing issues.
* Ability to work independently with onsite teams and manage implementation activities effectively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document and explain technical and functional issues clearly in English.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with UAE and Gulf payroll localization, including Wage Protection System (WPS), General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA) requirements, gratuity, and leave salary.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Absence Management and Time and Labor.
* Previous experience with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Payroll.
* Experience developing payroll and costing reports using Oracle BI Publisher.
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion quarterly updates, regression testing, and Oracle Support service requests.
* Oracle Fusion Global Payroll certification is preferred.

**Why Join Us:**

* Opportunity to work on Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations and enhancements for clients in the UAE.
* Exposure to enterprise payroll transformation and complex functional requirements.
* Collaborative working environment with onsite and offshore implementation teams.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, technical development, and career growth.
* A culture that encourages ownership, problem-solving, and professional development.

description:

description:

**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Senior Engineer - ATS (Automatic Train Supervision) for Railway Infrastructure
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant international team.
  
  
**We are looking for a Senior Engineer - ATS (Automatic Train Supervision) for Railway Infrastructure, meeting the need for smart-mobility solutions.**
**You’ll make a difference by:**

* Work assignments : Responsibility for the management of mass roll-outs of ATS Systems as part of large-scale railway infrastructure projects within time, budget and quality framework: Ensuring economic success and (internal) customer satisfaction for ATS application projects. Carrying responsibility for the application scope, both technical and commercial. Representation of the application scope within the project towards the PM and customer, whilst reporting to the line management (group lead).
* Application planning, controlling and reporting : For ATS projects: determination of the comprehensive project objectives from the Project Management and provided documents. Preparation of the project planning and the required project documents. Ensuring compliance with defined procedures/processes for project controlling and reporting.
* Application implementation : Coordination of the complex application implementation with international partners. Ensuring that the application goals defined with the project management and all project participants are achieved.
* Exploration of further business opportunities : Identification and exploitation of additional business opportunities during project implementation, e.g. identifying Change Requests or extending the scope towards generic application work packages.
* Leadership: Technical leadership of the Application team including staff resource planning and coordination with the organizational units involved. Managing following team setup:

+ Projects Support functions and Quality Management
+ System Engineering and Hardware and Software Engineering for Interlocking and Diagnostic Systems
+ Test Management
+ RAMS Management
+ Validation

**You’ll win us over by:**

* Degree in electrical engineering or systems engineering preferably with railway specific specialization
* Professional experience of minimum 5 years in railway transportation systems, ideally in the rail systems business, with the focus on Engineering in ATS domain
* Knowledge of project management principles for project realization and execution
* Fluent English essential both written and oral, knowledge of German an asset
* Independent and structured approach to work
* Team leadership and mediation skills between teams.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
This role is based in Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.
  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

**www.siemens.com/careers**
**& more about mobility at**
**https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html**

title: Engineering Manager - Consumer Intelligence & Engagement
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**

* About the Organisation & Role:

You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence & Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership & loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data-driven interactions across the consumer journey.
  
  
The Engineering Manager is accountable for engineering delivery, roadmap execution, operational excellence, and engineering team development. Partnering with Product Owners, Data Engineering & Analytics, Tech Leads, and peer engineering teams, you will enable predictable delivery, grow engineering talent, and build a high-performing culture focused on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  
  

* Enable delivery of scalable, reliable, and reusable services that power personalisation, recommendations, and consumer engagement experiences.
* Drive adoption of experimentation and data-driven decision making to continuously improve consumer experiences.
* Drive planning and execution against team objectives and key results (OKRs), ensuring alignment, accountability and transparent reporting.
* Own sprint execution, delivery planning, capacity management, dependency management, and risk management.
* Partner with Product Owners, Data Engineering and Tech Leads to deliver business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through strong development practices, quality standards, operational discipline and continuous improvement.
* Coach engineers through regular feedback, mentoring, performance management, and career development.
* Build a high-performing engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and learning.
* Establish effective engineering metrics and use data to improve team productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI across software development, testing, documentation, knowledge management and onboarding.
* Collaborate with engineering leadership on hiring, staffing, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
* Manage delivery partners and vendors where applicable and ensure alignment with team objectives.

**YOUR TALENT:**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with experience leading engineering teams in an agile delivery environment.
* 3+ years of people leadership experience.
* Strong experience leading roadmap execution, delivery planning, dependency management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Experience working with consumer data, behavioural signals, and event-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, search, or decisioning platforms.
* Strong people leadership skills with experience in hiring, mentoring, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices including software architecture & engineering principles, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development.
* Strong communication, collaboration, decision-making, and organisational leadership skills.
* Experience driving engineering quality, operational excellence, reliability, security, and continuous improvement.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira & Confluence or equivalent.
* A data-driven mindset with the ability to use engineering, delivery, and operational metrics to improve team effectiveness and predictability.
* Experience leveraging coding agents, LLMs, and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and team productivity will be a strong advantage.

Experience working with personalisation, recommendation, experimentation, search, or AI-powered consumer products will be a strong advantage
  
  
PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
  
  
PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Key User - Planning - D365
description:
**Job Title - Key User – Planning – D365**
Alfa Laval in Pune, we are looking for a Key User Planning to deliver insights on existing processes in the Planning function of the Factory / Function and bridge the knowledge gap towards end-users.
  
  
**About The Company**
In Alfa Laval, we are every single day contributing to a more sustainable future for our planet through engineering innovation. Our global team designs and implements the refining, recycling and purifying process that allow our customers to be better themselves. You will find our work in leading applications for water purification, clean energy, food production, waste processing, pharmaceutical development and much more. The people of Alfa Laval enjoy the freedom to pursue ideas and the resources to see those ideas to become reality, in an environment that welcomes drive, courage and diversity. The result is a company where we all can be very proud of what we do.
  
  
Our core competencies are in the areas of heat transfer separation, and fluid handling. We are dedicated to optimizing the performance of our customers' processes. our world-class technologies, our systems, equipment and services must create solutions that help our customers stay ahead. Please feel free to peruse our website www.alfalaval.com.
  
  
**The Position / About The Job**
**Key User - Planning**

* Participating in process reviews
* Provide input for potential process improvements
* Support in change management
* Will be hands-on in the site roll-out
* Ensures that local processes fit the global processes
* Understands how to track the processes
* Defines and tests business scenarios in their track(s)
* Supports and trains local users in D365
* Will become the factory’s experts in D365 for various functions.

**Data Migration**

* Drives the local data cleansing in the legacy system (Movex)
* Ensures all items in scope are marked and categorized in the legacy system
* Extracts data in scope from the legacy system
* Ensures coherence in the data extracts

**After Go Live**

* Coordinates activities across sites.
* Governs and implements new processes after deployment
* Super-user/point of contact for the processes after the site has gone live

**As**
**a Local Process Owner**

* Interface group to the Local Steering Committee
* Owners of the business /delivery process scenarios and responsible for the business scenario scope
* Responsible for testing that the solution is acceptable
* Responsible for local processes to fit OneERP Standard and local legal requirements
* Responsible for securing that locally owned gaps are closed
* Support end users in the change management
* Responsible for the process/function benefit realization post roll-out.

**Skills**

* Domain Knowledge: - Have a deep understanding of the business processes and best practice in the sourcing and procurement functional area
* Communication & Collaboration Skills: - Be able to train and guide others and bridge gaps between D365 experts and end-users
* Leadership & Influence: - Advocate for D365 within their teams and influence colleagues positively, analyze problems, identify root causes, and propose solutions
* Technical Proficiency: - Become proficient in using D365. They will be the first support level and need to be fairly IT proficient
* Continuous Learning: - Role continues after go-live, thus a desire to continuous improvement the solution locally is needed
* Attention to detail: - Key users will configure system settings, define security roles and test functionality
* Program Management: Exposure to small / medium / large scale program implementation is preferred.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, evaluate options, and implement effective solutions.
* Change Management: Experience and understanding of how to drive and manage organizational changes related to IT transformation, with a focus on minimizing resistance and maximizing adoption.

**Attitude And Motivation**

* Positive attitude
* Execution of critical thinking and problem-solving mindset
* Good Presentation and communication skills.
* Teamwork and team motivation (able to manage and develop relationships even in difficult circumstances).
* Decisiveness
* Be stress-tolerant
* Customer service orientation (be service-minded)
* Management control (multi-tasking)

**Experience**
  
  

* Strong knowledge of

+ Various functions, sourcing and procurement
+ Budgeting
+ Knowledge of Alfa Laval / Operations concepts and strategies

**Education**

* B.E / B. Tech (Mechanical) with 5+ years of experience.
* Awareness of or exposure to D365 / ERP implementation will be preferred.

**What’s in it for you?**

* We offer a challenging position in an open and friendly environment where we help each other to develop and create value. Your work will have a true impact on Alfa Laval’s future success.
* It is an exciting place to build a global network with different nationalities.
* Your work will have a true impact on Alfa Laval’s future success; you will be learning new things every day.
