title: Business Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
Business Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Identify opportunities to deliver tangible business value by assessing the current state, capturing high-level requirements, and defining business solutions. Translate business needs into technology-enabled solutions and operating models. Support transformation by developing business cases and guiding implementation of key initiatives.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
SAP Document and Reporting Compliance
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Business Architect, a typical day involves identifying opportunities that can bring measurable value to the business by thoroughly evaluating the existing environment. This role requires capturing high-level requirements and shaping effective business solutions that align with organizational goals. The Business Architect translates complex business needs into technology-driven solutions and operational frameworks. Additionally, the role supports transformational efforts by preparing detailed business cases and steering the execution of critical initiatives, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and fostering continuous improvement.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* 1. Deep business process functional expertise. Developing E2E business process ,understanding the country specific statutory requirement, flow documentation based on discussion with business and requirement analysis.
* Good team player and be able to lead a team to deliver activities efficiently and effectively.
* Able to handle cross functional team s communication / co-ordination.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* 1. Minimum 1 E2E implementation projects exp in S/4HANA Accounting and good Finance functional expertise with 5-6 years of functional experience.
* Should have understanding of E2E Finance business processes, Business process analysis and study Gap Identification, Business Blueprint, Process Mapping, Configuration, Functional and Technical Specifications Document, Test Case Document, Training Presentation, Conf Guide and User Manual
* Good understanding of Document & Reporting Compliance (DRC) and hands on experience in E2E implementation of DRC Statutory Reports /E-Invoicing.
* Exposure to Localization or Country Specific Solutions-E-Invoicing/Taxation and well versed with taxation scenarios
* Experience in DRC Report extensibility is added advantage.
* Testing the system and its extensions or modifications
* Experience and knowledge in Taxes on Sales/Purchases Withholding taxation, Month end process is must.
* SAP S/4 HANA certified will be an added advantage.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in SAP Document and Reporting Compliance.
* This position is based at our Pune office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

description:

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

**Project Engineer**
is responsible for execution of customer projects & standard platform products from order receipt through design, manufacturing, testing, documentation, and shipment. This position is part of the Custom Engineering organization located in
**Pune**
and will be an on-site role. At Cytiva, our vision is, to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery.

* Review of customer specifications and project requirements.
* Lead technical execution from kick-off through shipment.
* Coordinate engineering deliverables, schedules & inventories

* Knowledge of CAD tools such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or Inventor.
* Knowledge of ERP systems such as Oracle or SAP.

title: Senior Planner
description:
At
**Ecolab**
we are the world’s largest sustainability services company focused on industrial water, energy and air applications; delivering significant environmental, social and economic performance benefits to our customers.
  
  
Join our growing team as Sr Planner – Supply Network Design within our Global Supply Chain Operations organization!
  
  
We help our customers reduce energy, water, and other natural resource consumption, enhance air quality, minimize environmental releases, and improve productivity and end products while boosting the bottom line. We’re about safety.
  
  
We’re about sustainability. We’re more than innovative solutions for water, energy, and air. We earn customers for life and enhance the lives of our employees while protecting the planet. Be part of our culture, where you can make a difference in a company that makes a difference.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments
* The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
* The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best

**What You Will Do**

* Work with the Global Supply Chain organization and lead the Global Supply Chain Design Team.
* Lead supply chain network optimization modeling projects using Coupa Supply Chain Modeler software to perform network, transportation, and inventory optimization and/or simulation projects across Ecolab businesses.
* Collaborate with business leaders to define the network problem statement, establish scope, and align on the project plan.
* Drive cost savings through network optimization and supply network design projects across the globe.
* Strategize the collection of data from various standard systems and ERPs, and cleanse it into structured inputs for models using Data Guru, SQL, or other tools.
* Improve, build, and validate baseline models, and ensure modeling accuracy meets desired levels.
* Guide the team in developing scenarios that identify optimization opportunities across planning, manufacturing, and logistics while assessing service and cost trade-offs.
* Independently collaborate with global stakeholders to build and validate network models in line with business constraints and rules.
* Identify and implement network design best practices and build a Supply Chain Design center of excellence globally.
* Develop presentations and data visualizations, calculate the financial impact of various scenarios, and present recommendations to leadership.
* Provide expert thought leadership and work effectively with limited direction.

**Position Details**

* Location: Kharadi office, Pune, India.
* Ability to travel when required.

title: Manager, Technology - Network Engineering Operations
description:
**Job Description**
**Manager, Network Engineering Operations**
**About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.**
Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer.Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play.We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond.Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.
  
  
With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.
  
  
Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Manager, Network Engineering Operations will lead the India-based network engineering teams responsible for enterprise routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, load balancing, wireless infrastructure, store network operations, and network reliability engineering. This role combines strong technical leadership, operational governance, engineering execution, automation enablement, and people management. The ideal candidate is an experienced network engineering leader who brings deep enterprise networking expertise together with strong operational judgment, incident leadership capability, and a passion for developing high-performing engineering teams. This role requires a technically strong leader capable of actively participating in engineering escalations, architecture reviews, project governance, budgeting, network reliability initiatives, automation discussions, and major incident management while also driving team development and operational maturity. This role reports to the Director, Technology Solutions Infrastructure.
  
  
**Impact of the Role**

* Lead and scale high-performing network engineering operations teams supporting critical enterprise infrastructure and store network environments.
* Drive operational excellence across enterprise network platforms by improving reliability, responsiveness, monitoring effectiveness, scalability, automation, and engineering consistency.
* Establish a strong culture of operational ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Lead operational readiness activities supporting peak retail periods, store operations, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives.
* Partner with global engineering teams to ensure seamless operational coordination and support continuity.
* Leverage AI-assisted operational engineering practices to improve troubleshooting, monitoring analysis, operational reporting, and engineering productivity.

**Technology Platforms You Will Work On**

* Enterprise routing and switching
* Firewalls and network security
* VPNs
* Wireless infrastructure
* Load balancing
* Enterprise network monitoring and observability platforms
* Network configuration management and operational tooling
* Automation and scripting practices within network operations environments
* Store network infrastructure

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and scale high-performing network engineering operations teams supporting critical enterprise infrastructure and store network environments.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across enterprise routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, wireless, load balancing, and network reliability operations.
* Conduct technical discussions involving operational risk, incident management, network reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness.
* Drive operational excellence across enterprise network platforms by improving reliability, responsiveness, monitoring effectiveness, scalability, automation, and engineering consistency.
* Lead operational governance processes including incident management, change management, escalation management, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Partner closely with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure engineering, architecture, and platform teams to improve operational reliability and engineering collaboration.
* Mentor engineers through technical coaching, operational leadership, and engineering best practices.
* Establish a strong culture of operational ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Lead operational readiness activities supporting peak retail periods, store operations, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives.
* Partner with global engineering teams to ensure seamless operational coordination and support continuity.
* Leverage AI-assisted operational engineering practices to improve troubleshooting, monitoring analysis, operational reporting, and engineering productivity.

**Qualifications**

* Strong experience leading enterprise network engineering or network operations teams in large-scale production environments.
* Strong technical depth across enterprise networking technologies, operational engineering, automation, and network reliability practices.
* Ability to engage deeply in technical troubleshooting, operational escalation management, network reviews, and engineering decision-making.
* Proven experience leading technically strong engineering teams within enterprise-scale production environments.
* Strong balance of technical credibility, operational discipline, and people leadership.
* Demonstrated success building an engineering culture centered around accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, wireless, load balancing, and network security concepts.
* Experience managing complex incident response, operational governance, and major incident management processes.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, and network management platforms.
* Familiarity with automation and scripting practices within network operations environments.
* Demonstrated interest in AI-assisted operational engineering practices and automation-driven infrastructure operations.
* Strong communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, highly collaborative enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 10+ years of enterprise network engineering or network operations experience.
* 4+ years of technical leadership and people management experience leading network engineering or operations teams.

* Strong understanding of incident management, change management, and operational governance processes.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and operational decision-making skills.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and business audiences.
* Experience supporting retail, eCommerce, store network infrastructure, or other large-scale customer-facing enterprise environments preferred.
* Experience supporting highly seasonal or peak-event operational environments is a plus.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

title: Senior Specialist, Provider Data Operations (US Healthcare Insurance)
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
As an Insurance Senior Specialist, you will serve as the subject matter expert for Zocdoc's insurance taxonomy and related systems. You will own the policies, processes, and quality standards that ensure our insurance data is accurate, scalable, and aligned with product strategy. This role combines deep expertise in the U.S. health insurance landscape with strong analytical thinking to improve the patient search experience and strengthen the integrity of our insurance database.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to define insurance policies, monitor database health, and drive continuous improvements. Your work will directly influence how patients find in-network care by ensuring that our insurance taxonomies, carrier and plan coverage, and provider matching systems remain accurate, scalable, and responsive to changes in the healthcare market.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Product Operations Specialist:**

* Define Insurance Policies & Standards: Own the policies governing insurance carriers and plans across the Zocdoc marketplace. Define and maintain rules for adding, modifying, and removing insurance carriers and plans, as well as thresholds for performance-based retention or removal.
* Monitor Insurance Market Trends: Stay informed about developments in the U.S. health insurance landscape, including new carrier launches, plan introductions, mergers, and regulatory changes. Evaluate their impact on Zocdoc's insurance database and recommend proactive updates.
* Drive Cross-functional Strategy: Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data & Analytics teams to ensure insurance taxonomies support product strategy and accurate patient search experiences. Translate complex insurance policies into clear product requirements, data models, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Advise senior Product and Engineering leaders on recommendations and tradeoffs, influence roadmap priorities, and shape taxonomy architecture, validation logic, tooling, and system controls. Define reporting and monitor performance, while leading incident reviews and escalations involving inaccurate insurance availability or provider matching to identify root causes and mitigate future risk.
* Own Insurance Database Health: Define, monitor, and report on key insurance database health metrics. Conduct regular reviews with Product, Operations, and Data partners to identify trends, prioritize improvements, and maintain high data quality.
* Improve Processes & Quality: Identify systemic issues affecting insurance data quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives. Refine policies and operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase accuracy across workflows.
* Perform Quality Assurance & Expert Reviews: Act as the organization's expert on U.S. health insurance, review and validate outputs from operational teams for new insurance plan additions and complex taxonomy decisions. Serve as the final escalation point for policy interpretation and insurance-related quality questions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* 5+ years of experience in the U.S. healthcare industry, with deep expertise in Insurance Payor Management, Payor Analytics, Database
* Management or related functions at payor or plan level.
* Strong understanding of U.S. commercial insurance plans, carriers, provider networks.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using metrics and data to drive strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Analytics, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic thinking and operational execution.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to influence stakeholders across functions.
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Looker or other analytical tools is a must.
* Familiarity and proven usage of AI-driven tools and workflow automation is a must.

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -
*Together, Not Alone*
, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: SAP S/4HANA IS-Retail Data Migration Lead
description:
Job Description

SAP S/4HANA IS-Retail Data Migration Lead

Role Purpose:

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA IS-Retail Data Migration Lead to take ownership of end-to-end master data migration for a Greenfield SAP S/4HANA 2023 Private Cloud Edition implementation for a hypermarket retail business.

The role will lead a team of seven data migration resources and coordinate with business data owners, SAP functional leads, technical teams, and the project management team. The primary focus is the migration of retail master data from the legacy Oracle environment into SAP, including Article Master, Merchandise Categories and Hierarchy, Sales Condition Records, Purchasing Info Records, and related master data. The lead will be accountable for migration planning, source data assessment, mapping, cleansing coordination, load execution, reconciliation, issue resolution, cutover readiness, and business sign-off. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong SAP Retail knowledge and the ability to take over an ongoing workstream with minimal disruption.

Role Details – Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Migration Leadership and Planning

 Own the end-to-end master data migration strategy, object inventory, schedule, dependencies, execution tracker, and cutover plan for the SAP S/4HANA IS-Retail implementation.

 Lead, allocate, and monitor work for a team of seven migration resources; establish clear ownership, backup coverage, daily progress reviews, and quality checkpoints.

 Take over current migration activities by reviewing existing templates, mapping rules, load files, defects, decisions, dependencies, and committed milestones; maintain continuity and avoid unnecessary rework.

 Report progress, risks, blockers, data readiness, and decisions required to the SAP Project Manager / Delivery Lead.

SAP IS-Retail Master Data

 Lead migration of Single Articles, Generic Articles, Variant Articles, Sales Set Articles, Reference Articles, and Non-Trading Articles, including relevant descriptions, UoMs, barcodes/EANs, classification, purchasing, sales, valuation, logistics, and site-specific views.

 Manage Merchandise Category and hierarchy mapping, validation of hierarchy levels, article assignments, and alignment with procurement, assortment, store operations, and reporting requirements.

 Coordinate article extensions to stores, distribution centres, plants, and other relevant sites; validate site- specific data and dependencies.

 Lead Sales Condition Record migration, including relevant pricing and promotional conditions in scope; validate condition types, key combinations, sales area, article/site/customer combinations where applicable, validity dates, currency, units, and values with the SD/Pricing team.

 Lead Purchasing Info Record migration and related purchasing data; validate supplier/article relationships, purchasing organization, plant/site, purchasing group, order unit, planned delivery time, and purchasing conditions.

 Coordinate related objects within the approved scope, such as supplier/customer Business Partners, purchase condition records, source lists, storage bins, and other finance or logistics master data.

 Support Fresh Business and catch-weight article attributes, POS/e-commerce-specific fields, and custom retail attributes where applicable to the approved design.

Source Assessment, Mapping and Data Cleansing

 Assess Oracle source extracts and profile data to identify duplicates, missing mandatory fields, invalid values, inconsistent units, obsolete records, and broken relationships.

 Own source-to-target mapping, transformation rules, value mapping, data dictionaries, templates, and field-level validation specifications in coordination with functional consultants and business owners.

 Drive business-led data cleansing and enrichment; track ownership, due dates, approval status, and readiness by object. Do not rely on technical workarounds for unresolved business data issues.

 Validate dependencies such as article-to-merchandise-category, article-to-site, supplier-to-PIR, and article- to-pricing relationships before each load.

Migration Build, Load Execution and Reconciliation

 Plan and execute migration cycles using SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and available standard migration objects/templates; coordinate approved custom programs, APIs, staging, or other utilities where standard capabilities do not meet requirements.

 Manage extraction, transformation, staging, simulation, load execution, error analysis, reprocessing, delta loads, and repeat loads.

 Determine the appropriate migration approach for each object and document technical dependencies, risks, and approvals for objects requiring an alternative approach.

 Execute mock loads and reconcile source and target record counts, key fields, values, and relationships; retain evidence and obtain functional/business sign-off.

 Maintain a central defect log with root cause, severity, owner, target date, corrective action, retest result, and closure evidence.

Testing, Cutover and Go-Live Readiness

 Ensure required master data is available and validated ahead of SIT, UAT, business process testing, and cutover milestones.

 Prepare the detailed migration cutover runbook covering load sequence, dependencies, owners, timing, data freeze, final extracts, delta handling, validation, contingency steps, and sign-offs.

 Track critical data readiness and unresolved defects, assess business impact, and escalate decisions that may affect store/DC operations or go-live.

 Support final migration execution, reconciliation, business acceptance, and post-go-live data issue resolution during hypercare.

Governance and Stakeholder Collaboration

 Act as the primary point of contact for master data migration across business data owners, Oracle/source-

system teams, SAP Retail, MM, SD/Pricing, FI, EWM, integration, ABAP, and project management teams.

 Conduct data readiness and validation workshops; clarify data ownership, acceptance criteria, cleansing responsibilities, and approval timelines.

 Maintain controlled documentation for mapping, templates, load logs, reconciliation, decisions, risks, and sign-offs in the project repository.

 Ensure migration activities comply with project governance, change control, data confidentiality, and audit requirements.

Functional/Technical Competencies

Education:

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Management, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience:

 Typically 8+ years of SAP experience, including at least 4–5 years in data migration/master data migration and proven experience leading a migration workstream or team.

 Experience in at least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Greenfield implementation; multiple implementations or retail rollouts are preferred.

 Strong practical experience with SAP IS-Retail / SAP S/4HANA Retail master data, preferably in a

hypermarket, supermarket, or multi-site retail environment.

 Oracle-to-SAP migration experience and experience managing a team of approximately seven resources are strongly preferred.

Functional Skills:

 Strong knowledge of Article Master, Generic/Variant Articles, Sales Set/Reference/Non-Trading Articles, Merchandise Categories and Hierarchy, article-site extensions, Sales Condition Records, and Purchasing Info Records.

 Understanding of retail store/DC structures, assortment and procurement dependencies,

supplier/customer master data, pricing conditions, and site-specific master data.

 Working knowledge of SAP MM and SD master data dependencies and collaboration with pricing, procurement, finance, logistics, and retail business teams.

Technical Skills:

 Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, migration templates, mapping/value mapping, simulation, load execution, error handling, and reconciliation.

 Experience with source-to-target mapping, data profiling, data cleansing, transformation rules, SQL and advanced Excel for analysis and reconciliation.

 Ability to coordinate with ABAP/BTP/integration teams for approved custom migration solutions where standard migration objects are insufficient.

 Familiarity with SAP Business Partner approach and relevant S/4HANA Retail data models; DMC, LSMW, or other ETL tools are advantageous.

Leadership and Soft Skills:

 Demonstrated ability to lead, prioritize, review, and coach a migration team; strong ownership of timelines, quality, and deliverables.

 Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to drive business data cleansing and secure timely sign-offs.

 Structured problem-solving, risk management, attention to detail, and ability to work under fixed SIT/UAT and go-live deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:

 SAP S/4HANA Data Migration or SAP Data Services certification.

 Experience with high-volume retail master data and multi-store / multi-DC deployment.

 Familiarity with Agile or hybrid project delivery methods and formal data governance.

Key Deliverables and Success Measures:

 Approved migration strategy, object inventory, ownership matrix, source-to-target mappings, cleansing tracker, migration templates, and dependency/sequencing matrix.

title: Vice President, Software Engineering
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Vice President, Software Engineering
  
  
**What does a successful Senior Delivery leader, Core Banking Platforms do?**
As the Senior Delivery leader, Core Banking Platforms, you will lead modernization of one of the most risk-sensitive layers of the technology estate across core banking platforms and client environments. You will work with product, client delivery, security, compliance, infrastructure, and data teams to guide migrations, integration architecture, release controls, and operational stability. Your work will improve platform resiliency, reduce transformation risk, and help convert core banking capabilities into modern APIs and governed data products.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead a team of senior core banking engineers across migration, payments integration, APIs, deployment automation, and data and reporting initiatives
* Define modernization strategy for multi-version, multi-client core banking platforms while protecting uptime, data integrity, client commitments, and regulatory obligations
* Review architecture and code-level decisions across Temenos Transact, Oracle Flexcube, Finastra Fusion, Finacle, MultiValue databases, integration middleware, and payment modules
* Establish standards for version governance, cutover planning, regression automation, parallel runs, data reconciliation, release evidence, and operational controls
* Partner with product, client delivery, security, compliance, infrastructure, and data teams to convert core banking capabilities into modern APIs and governed data products
* Manage and develop teams through technical coaching, performance management, staffing decisions, and execution oversight across high-risk modernization workstreams
* Lead transformation planning and risk management for migration and deployment activities to improve repeatability, auditability, and delivery control

**What You Will Need To Have**

* 10+ years of experience in core banking engineering, modernization, implementation, platform transformation, or related technical leadership in banking, fintech, processing, or vendor environments
* 8+ years of experience defining and delivering migration, upgrade, consolidation, or cloud-hosted transformation programs for core banking platforms
* 5+ years of experience managing and developing teams
* 8+ years of experience with at least one major core banking platform such as Temenos T24 or Transact, Oracle Flexcube, Finastra Fusion, Finacle, or similar enterprise banking platforms
* 8+ years of experience supporting payments, general ledger, deposits, loans, customer, account, fees, limits, and regulatory reporting domains in production banking environments
* Experience leading a major core banking consolidation, migration, upgrade, or cloud-hosted transformation in a multi-client environment
* Experience converting legacy core banking capabilities into modern API and data product architectures
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience

**What Would Be Great To Have**
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience
  
  
**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
  
  
**Note To Agencies**
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
  
  
**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Program Manager (Water Supply)
description:
PROGRAM MANAGER

Planet Water Foundation (PWF) is an NGO devoted to providing access to safe drinking water to impoverished communities.

Through the installation of our community-based water filtration systems, handwashing infrastructure, and the implementation of hygiene education programs, we direct our attention to two critical areas: supporting schools, children, and local communities in the Asia-Pacific and Latin America regions, as well as the provision of safe drinking water in the aftermath of natural disasters worldwide. Since 2009, Planet Water has deployed more than 2,500 projects that provide clean water access to more than five million people across 34 countries.

For more information visit: www.planet-water.org

PWF is looking for applicants to fill the position of Program Manager.

The Program Manager will will have the following primary responsibilities:

* Project Deployments: Manage the construction and installation of water filtration systems in schools and community settings.
* Training & Support: Acquire installation, operating, and maintenance knowledge of PWF’s water filtration systems and provide training and support to recipient beneficiaries.
* Sustainability: Monitor the ongoing condition of projects after deployment and define and facilitate appropriate corrective actions to assure sustainability.
* Programs: Support the organization's in-country program / project activities.

Essential requirements for this position are as follows:

* University graduate with at least 5 years of related working experience.
* Aptitude and desire to direct and be involved in mechanical and construction related work.
* Ability and desire to work and travel to project locations across India (approximately 50%) with occasional international travel.
* Complete fluency in both English as a mandatory requirement.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and analytical skills.
* Computer literate including proficiency with Microsoft Office programs – Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

title: Analyst-Payroll Transition-Pune
description:
**Job Purpose**

The Payroll Transition Specialist is responsible for managing the end-to-end transition of payroll services from a client organization to the payroll outsourcing provider. The role ensures seamless knowledge transfer, process migration, system setup, risk mitigation, compliance adherence, and successful stabilization of payroll operations within agreed timelines and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Transition Management**

Lead payroll transition projects for new outsourced clients.

Develop and execute detailed transition plans, timelines, and project milestones.

Coordinate onboarding activities with clients

Conduct transition governance meetings and provide regular status updates to stakeholders.

**Process Discovery & Documentation**

Document current payroll processes, policies, workflows, and controls.

Identify process gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process maps, and knowledge repositories.

Validate payroll calendars, pay elements, statutory requirements, and reporting needs.

**Knowledge Transfer & Training**

Facilitate knowledge transfer sessions with client SPOCs.

Ensure complete process understanding.

Support training and readiness assessments for payroll delivery.

Develop transition and operational documentation for future reference.

**System & Data Migration**

Coordinate payroll data collection, validation, and migration activities.

Support parallel payroll runs, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and reconciliation activities.

Ensure data security and confidentiality throughout the transition process.

title: SAP TM-Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Advisory – SAP TM Functional Manager:**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid & proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Consulting Competencies:**
**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution

**Solution Design**

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project and program management using methodologies such as SAP Activate, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
* Leadership of diverse teams (10-30+ members) including onshore, nearshore, and offshore resources across functional and technical disciplines
* Quality assurance practices including test strategy development, UAT coordination, cutover planning, and post-go-live support
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Degree in Engineering or MBA in Supply Chain Area.
* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.
* Having experience of working in integration area of SAP TM and other areas.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in SAP TM.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

The
**3P Manager (Personal Care)**

will own the end-to-end operational execution of the manufacturing value chain—moving seamlessly from New Product Development (NPD) implementation to sustained market availability.

This role is highly cross-functional. The ideal candidate isn't just a coordinator; he is  a matrix leader who treats 3P/ Own plants as an extension of Ghar Soaps own ecosystem, deeply understands how changes in the business environment.

 This role is responsible for ensuring that Raw Materials (RM), Packaging Materials (PM), and Finished Goods (FG) are delivered
**On-Time In-Full (OTIF)**

while strictly managing the
**Cost of Conversion (COC)**

, inventory health, AQL & defect free products  and Third-Party (3P) manufacturing performance of new products as well as existing products.

**· Key Stakeholders:**

NPD, Planning & WH, Procurement, Quality, and 3P Manufacturers

**· Category Focus:**

Personal Care (Soaps, Face wash, Body wash, Creams, Gels, lotions etc.)

**Core Responsibilities**

**1. NPD Commercialization & Launch Execution:**

· Partner closely with the NPD team to transition formulations and packaging concepts from lab-scale to commercial 3P manufacturing lines.

· Own the supply chain readiness timeline for all new launches, ensuring RM/PM pipelines are primed to meet first-production deadlines without market entry delays.

· Closure of costing – P2P / COC to deliver desired margins .

· Coordinate trial runs at 3P sites with Quality and Production teams to establish baseline production standards.

**2. End-to-End Availability (OTIF) & Materials Management**

· Ensure 100% availability of RM, PM, and FG across the network to satisfy fluctuating demand signals.

· Collaborate with the Central Planning team to convert demand forecasts into actionable production and material requirement schedules.

· Proactively identify supply bottlenecks (e.g., long-lead active ingredients, custom packaging laminates) and implement mitigation strategies.

**3. Cost Control & Conversion Frameworks (COC)**

· Manage and optimize the
**Cost of Conversion (COC)**

across all manufacturing locations, tracking the precise mix of variable costs, fixed overheads, wastages and co-packer margins.

· Identify and execute cost-saving initiatives within the value chain (e.g., freight optimization, batch size scaling, throughput improvements).

· Negotiate service levels and operational cost structures with 3P partners alongside the Procurement team.

**4. 3P Manufacturing & Project Management**

· Oversee day-to-day operations at Third-Party (3P) contract manufacturing sites, holding them accountable to agreed capacities and timelines.

· Lead operational excellence and capacity expansion projects at 3P/Own locations to support brand scaling.

· Monitor compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and safety guidelines at external facilities.

**5. Inventory & Value Chain Health**


**at 3P locations**

· Optimize inventory levels across the network (RM, PM, and FG) to maximize working capital efficiency while preventing stockouts

· Minimize aging and slow-moving stock by setting up robust tracking systems for material shelf-life and expiration dates (critical for active personal care ingredients).

· Develop and maintain clear, structured inventory frameworks (such as standardized bin systems and location identifiers) at storage sites to ensure flawless traceability.

**Profile Requirements:**

**· Experience:**

6–10 years of robust supply chain, operations, or category management experience within the
**FMCG / Personal Care / Cosmetics**

sector.Must have handled atleast a cluster of 5 or more CMO for a minimum of 3years

**· Technical Domain Knowledge:**

Deep familiarity with personal care manufacturing processes (emulsions, hot/cold compounding, high-speed filling lines for tubes/bottles/jars) and primary packaging barrier properties.

**· Competencies:**

Strong project management, analytical problem-solving, and a clear understanding of manufacturing cost structures (Variable/Fixed/Margins).Negotiation skills. People skills

**· Interpersonal Skills:**

A collaborative, direct communicator capable of alignment across cross-functional units (NPD, Quality, Procurement) and external vendors.

title: Chief Traction, Distribution, SCADA & MIMIC Panel Integration Expert-K1- Pune
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
We are seeking applications for the position of Chief Traction Distribution, SCADA and MIMIC Panel Integration Expert for
**Phase-I Extension and Phase-II Projects of Pune Metro Rail Project (PMRP)**
The project involves the engagement of a General Consultant (GC) for providing comprehensive consultancy services for the implementation of the Pune Metro Rail Project – Phase-I Extension and Phase-II. The scope broadly covers project management, design and engineering review, construction supervision, contract management, quality assurance, safety, testing and commissioning, and overall monitoring of the works.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* Traction Power System
* Review and supervise the design and implementation of the Metro traction power supply system.
* Review traction substation (TSS), auxiliary/receiving substations and associated equipment.
* Review technical specifications, SLDs, protection schemes and equipment layouts.
* Ensure proper interface between traction power, OHE/third rail and other electrical systems.
* Monitor installation, testing and commissioning of traction equipment.
* Electrical Distribution System
* Review HT/LT distribution arrangements for stations, depots and other project facilities.
* Review RMU, HT panels, transformers, LT panels, DG/UPS interfaces and associated protection systems.
* Verify load calculations, power distribution diagrams and equipment ratings.
* Ensure reliable and coordinated power supply to stations and operational systems.
* SCADA System
* Review the design and architecture of the Electrical/Traction SCADA system.
* Review RTU/PLC, communication network, servers, workstations and data acquisition systems.
* Verify monitoring and control of traction and auxiliary electrical equipment.
* Review SCADA I/O lists, point schedules, control philosophy and alarm/event management.
* Ensure integration with OCC and station control systems.
* MIMIC Panel Integration
* Review the design and functionality of MIMIC panels at OCC/SCADA control locations.
* Ensure correct representation of electrical network topology and equipment status.
* Verify indications for breakers, isolators, feeders, transformers and other critical equipment.
* Ensure proper interface between MIMIC panels, SCADA and field equipment.
* Witness functional and integrated testing of MIMIC panels.
* Design & Technical Document Review
* Review:

+ SLDs and schematics
+ Protection coordination studies
+ Equipment specifications
+ Cable schedules
+ Interface drawings
+ SCADA architecture
+ I/O lists
+ Control philosophy
+ MIMIC panel drawings
+ Communication/network diagrams

* Review contractor technical submissions, calculations, method statements and shop drawings.
* Interface Coordination

**Coordinate With**

* Rolling Stock
* OHE/Third Rail
* Civil & Structural
* Station E&M
* Signalling
* Telecom
* AFC
* Fire & Life Safety
* Depot systems
* OCC/Operations
* SCADA and communication teams

Particular attention should be given to
**traction power–OHE/third rail, electrical distribution–station systems, SCADA–field equipment and SCADA–OCC interfaces**
.
  
  

* Construction Supervision
* Inspect installation of traction and distribution equipment.
* Monitor contractor compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
* Review site installation quality and identify non-conformities.
* Attend technical inspections and resolve site engineering issues.
* Monitor progress of critical electrical and SCADA works.
* Testing & Commissioning
* Witness FAT, SAT, pre-commissioning and commissioning of traction and distribution equipment.
* Review protection relay testing and functional tests.
* Witness SCADA point-to-point testing.
* Verify commands, indications, alarms, interlocks and equipment status.
* Witness SCADA–MIMIC–field equipment integrated testing.
* Support Integrated Testing & Commissioning (ITC) before revenue operation.
* Safety & Protection
* Ensure electrical systems comply with approved safety requirements and applicable standards.
* Review protection coordination and interlocking arrangements.
* Verify emergency tripping and isolation facilities.
* Ensure safe operating procedures for traction and distribution systems.
* Contractor & Progress Management
* Monitor contractor performance and programme.
* Participate in technical and progress meetings.
* Review RFIs, technical deviations and proposed modifications.
* Assist PMC/client in resolving critical technical issues.
* Monitor procurement and delivery of critical traction/SCADA equipment.
* Handover & Documentation
* Review As-Built Drawings.
* Review testing and commissioning records.
* Verify SCADA database and final I/O documentation.
* Review O&M manuals, maintenance schedules and spare-parts lists.
* Verify training of operations and maintenance personnel.
* Support final inspection, taking-over and Defect Liability Period activities.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Graduate in Electrical - B.tech 20+years in rail related majar infrastructure project / railway/ Metro.
* Chief Traction, Distribution, SCADA & MIMIC Panel Integration Expert shall be responsible for leading the technical review, supervision, interface coordination, testing and commissioning of traction power, electrical distribution, SCADA and MIMIC panel systems for the Metro Rail Project. The expert shall review designs, SLDs, protection schemes, technical specifications, SCADA architecture, I/O lists, MIMIC panel drawings and interface requirements.
* supervise installation and testing; ensure integration with OHE/third rail, rolling stock, signalling, telecom, station E&M and OCC systems.
* resolve technical issues; witness FAT/SAT and integrated testing; and support commissioning, handover and O&M activities.

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure.It’s not a job - it’s a career!

On-site

title: PMT - Product Validation Lead
description:
**Our Purpose**

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
PMT - Product Validation Lead
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
Payments Network Technology is seeking a Product Management Technical professional to lead product validation and payment-domain outcomes. The role connects customer and business needs with engineering delivery, test coverage, and release acceptance.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the vision, working-backwards narrative, and measurable outcomes for assigned capabilities.
* Translate customer, operational, and business needs into prioritized features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Make and communicate trade-off recommendations across scope, depth, timelines, risk, and technical investment.
* Coordinate requirements and dependencies with engineering, architecture, testing, operations, and customer-facing teams.
* Review demonstrations and validation evidence against acceptance criteria before release.
* Maintain clear product documentation and use production or validation metrics as feedback into the backlog.
* Identify feature-level delivery or customer risks and drive prioritization and resolution.
* Define validation strategy for authorization, clearing, tokenization, ISO 8583, and ISO 20022 payment flows.
* Support defect triage and confirm that resolved behavior meets payment-processing requirements.
* Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams.

**Essential Skills**

* Experience in technical product management, product ownership, business analysis, or payment-product validation.
* Knowledge of payment transaction flows and message standards such as ISO 8583 and ISO 20022.
* Ability to work with engineers and architects on APIs, data models, non-functional requirements, and operational behavior.
* Data-driven decision-making and strong product documentation skills.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**All About You**

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle.
* Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams.
* Experience applying AI-driven product validation to improve efficiency, expand coverage, and identify defects earlier in the development lifecycle.
* Payments or financial-services domain knowledge is preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Regional Project Development Manager for Reciprocating Compressors
description:

This role is part of our dynamic regional service Modernization and Upgrades team in Asia Pacific.
  
  
Within the Asia Pacific region, we are supporting customers from the Oil & Gas, chemical and industrial sectors. You will be working closely with the regional Client Manager/mechanical & controls RPDM and be responsible for the technical solution as well as the techno-commercial proposal for developed compressor upgrade solutions.
  
  
This highly networked role requires the ability to work under pressure and meet ambitious deadlines, along with strong people management.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Actively and methodically explore the market to generate new leads and opportunities.
* Qualify opportunities for compressor upgrades, working with client managers to develop prospects and secure orders.
* Collaborate with the Controls Project Development Managers, CM, Service Centers to bring value propositions and navigate complex environments.

* Provide technical product training for regional teams, representatives, agents, and clients as required.
* Meet M&U targets and earning objectives, ensuring a clean handover to execution team.

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical or equivalent experience in Engineering with demonstrated ability in rotating machinery in the energy industries, with extensive knowledge in rotating machinery (compressors).

With more than 98,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.

title: Vice President, Product Development, Switching as a Service
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Vice President, Product Development, Switching as a Service
  
  
Overview and Context
  
  
As part of the Network Products business unit, the Next Generation Network Team is at the heart of Mastercard’s transformation, driving innovation and modernization to ensure the network remains resilient, flexible, and competitive in a rapidly evolving payments landscape.
  
  
This team is responsible for building Mastercard’s next-generation unified switch and access capabilities, designed to handle all payment and related data flows across transaction types and payment schemes.
  
  
Within Next Gen Network, the Network Expansion team is driving Product Development for a new product named “Switching as a Service” (SwaaS), which opens a new business model in which Mastercard leverages its next-generation platform to switch domestic payment schemes according to their rules, interchange, and settlement, hosted and operated by Mastercard.
  
  
Network Products has signed its first large and strategic SwaaS contract and needs to grow its Product Development team to manage its design, build, and run activities.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
This VP role will lead a team having Product Development accountability for the Core Switching and Data-related services of the SwaaS. The role will ensure delivery of this scope according to the contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions.
  
  
Given the large scope and complexity of SwaaS, this individual will partner closely with a large network of actors, such as: other SwaaS Product Development team members managing other parts of the SwaaS, Avanti project management structure, representative from Product and Engineering of each contributing program, Regional lead driving the on-soil relationship with the SwaaS customer and providing product management and GTM role, Customer delivery, Global Customer Care, Security, Network, etc.
  
  
The individual will also have direct relationship with representatives from the SwaaS customer team to ensure full alignment between their expectations and our solutioning while protecting Mastercard’s interest and goals. This SwaaS project spread across multiple time zones.
  
  
The role demands a strong product mindset, drive, structure, organization, technical acumen across the scope, and will require a high degree of collaboration across technical, customer-facing, and other stakeholder teams to bring the first SwaaS implementation to home.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the Product Development team in charge of the Core Switching and Data-related capabilities of the SwaaS product from intake through elaboration, execution, build, and run.
* Within the SwaaS governance, provide regular & detailed reporting, stay ahead in risk management, and ensure that the resources allocated to SwaaS execution are rightly used in partnership with PMO’s and Finance.
* Own delivery of the allocated scope and coordinate with Product Management and Engineering teams to meet contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions.
* Ensure the integrity and consistency of SwaaS delivery across vision, capabilities, scalability, performance, speed-to-market, readiness for growth, and reusability.
* Build and maintain detailed functional and technical understanding of the delivered platform, including requirements, use cases, architecture, dependencies, interfaces, data flows, runtime operations, support strategies, and maintenance needs.
* Drive stakeholder alignment across the SwaaS ecosystem, including Product, Engineering, Franchise, Global Customer Delivery, Privacy, and other contributing teams.
* Lead by example with a hands-on approach, demonstrate product management excellence, and share best practices.
* Apply logic, reasoning, and sound decision-making to develop solutions with all teams. Clarify concepts and build a shared understanding of what will ultimately be delivered.
* Define capabilities that enhance the Next Gen platform, respect the platform strategy and principles, and ensure platform integrity.
* Support other SwaaS Product team members to ensure collective success. Replicate knowledge, share workload across initiatives, provide mutual backup, and help the team scale, learn, and expand its scope.
* Establish product development discipline in the team, including clear methods, structure, content standards, reliable execution, and high-quality on-time contributions.
* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performance team while fostering a culture of execution, accountability, and innovation.
* Identify opportunities for leveraging AI to improve speed, efficiency and quality.

**All About You**

* Fluent in English
* 10+ years of product development or product management experience in complex, geographically distributed environments
* Experience managing and developing teams. People leader.
* Executive-level stakeholder management and influence in a matrixed organization
* Expected to bring a strong execution mindset, sound judgment, and practical problem-solving skills
* Strong technical foundation required to understand complex platform capabilities, dependencies, and delivery risks
* Prior experience in payments and/or fintech is required; experience with card processing systems, including authorization, clearing, and settlement, is preferred
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional alignment across product and engineering teams, including dependency management
* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities
* Strong problem solver who can navigate complexity, unblock teams, and identify alternative paths to deliver the outcomes
* Strong experience with complex technical products and customer integration planning is a plus
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and workstream management skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate problem statements, frame options and trade-off, and engage internal and external stakeholders clearly.
* Customer-facing experience is preferred
* Ability to work with ambiguity and manage complex projects in fast-paced environments
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and with minimal day-to-day supervision
* Ability to build effective relationships with senior leaders, internal teams, and external clients
* Flexibility to work with multiple time zones

Location: Pune only

The ideal candidate possesses deep hands-on expertise in
**SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebates, settlements, and accruals—complemented by strong domain knowledge in
**Sales & Distribution (SD)**
and
**Pricing**
. In this role, you will lead enhancement deliveries, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support to ensure seamless business operations and Order-to-Cash (O2C) integration.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enhancements, Projects & Business Analysis
* Enhancement Delivery: Lead and deliver enhancements in CCM processes, including designing new contract types, complex settlement logic, and business-specific rebate models.
* Requirement Gathering: Engage with business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement settings, and seamless integration points with financial modules.
* Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with ABAP/technical teams during custom development, code walk-throughs, unit testing, and deployment.
* Testing & Deployment: Drive System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, ensuring defect-free releases into production environments.
* Process Optimization: Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization across CCM and pricing frameworks.
* Application Support & Maintenance (L2/L3)
* Production Support: Provide high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM processes, ensuring strict SLA adherence and minimal operational disruption.
* Issue Resolution: Diagnose and resolve complex incidents related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing inconsistencies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring issues and implement preventive, sustainable fixes.
* ITSM Ticket Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets efficiently within enterprise ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and troubleshoot period-end settlement runs and financial postings.
* Cross-Module Integration & Governance
* SD/FI Alignment: Collaborate effectively with SD and FI/CO teams to resolve cross-functional issues and ensure accurate O2C financial integration.
* Pricing Accuracy: Leverage deep SD and Pricing expertise to maintain calculation schema integrity and pricing determination rules.
* Change Governance: Strictly adhere to transport management, release governance, and change management procedures (CAB approvals) for all system changes.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain accurate functional design documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions for peer teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Technical & Functional Expertise
  
  

* SAP CCM: 4+ years of focused experience configuring and supporting S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (Customer/Vendor Rebates, Chargebacks, Accruals, and Settlements).
* SAP SD & Pricing: Strong expertise in SD core processes (O2C), pricing procedures, condition technique, access sequences, and condition types.
* SAP FI Integration: Working knowledge of G/L accounting, account determination, split settlements, and revenue recognition impacts.
* RICEF Development: Proven track record in creating detailed functional designs for custom reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.
* ITSM & Tools: Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Solution Manager, ChaRM, or similar change control frameworks.

Experience & Education
  
  

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP consulting experience across both Application Maintenance (Support) and Enhancement/Implementation projects.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* S/4HANA Exposure: Hands-on experience operating in S/4HANA environments is mandatory.
* Certifications (Preferred): SAP Certified Application Associate – S/4HANA Sales or SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management.

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with strong root cause analysis and troubleshooting abilities.
* Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills for engaging with both business key users and technical developers.
* Leadership: Ability to independently manage tasks, mentor junior support team members, and drive delivery timelines.
* Stakeholder Management: Experienced in facilitating workshops, prioritizing backlog items, and managing business user expectations during critical issue resolution.
