title: Release and Program Manager
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
  
  
Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
  
  
**Your Role**
We are currently seeking a Release and Program Manager to join our PLM PMO team in PTC office in Pune.
  
  
In this role, you will support engineering cross-functional teams to help manage their maintenance release activities throughout the software development lifecycle. You will work directly with integrated scrum teams to coordinate and track program milestones and deliverables, effectively mitigate schedule and scope risks, within agile framework leading releases towards successful outcomes.
  
  
You will be part of a PMO team of talented and enthusiastic release and program managers who lead with a servant leader mindset.
  
  
You will interact with a multitude of roles across the organization on a day to day basis. You will be the “go to” person for processes associated with planning, monitoring, control, configuration and change management for your initiatives/releases.
  
  
**Your Impact**
This role is critical to ensure timely and efficient release execution per defined plan, as well as effective communication within and across the integrated scrum teams, PMs and TPMs. A big part of the role will be related to supporting the teams through facilitation of the meetings, following up on the actions, providing the data to enable data driven decision making.
  
  
**Your Team**
This role reports into the PLM PMO organization and will be working closely with the R&D and PM leaders both within the PLM organization, as well as other segments.
  
  
**Your Day-to-Day**

* Work with Engineering, QA & Tech Support teams on delivering maintenance releases.
* Plan, schedule, and control the build, test, and deployment of releases
* Enable efficient release process / governance
* Identify, communicate and manage risks
* Measure release cadence and effectiveness using common metrics; own release dashboards;
* Plan and lead release status review meetings with senior management; establish efficient governance to communicate status updates, risks and escalations
* Collaborate with other program and release managers to define and improve organizational standards for maintenance release

**Qualification, Preferred Experience And Must-Have Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Mathematics, other related fields, or equivalent experience.
* 5 - 8 years of experience in software development organizations, with minimum of 4 years in a program or project management role.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
* Good understanding and working knowledge of Agile Scrum software product development methodology.
* Comfort with utilization of AI
* Self-starter who can earn trust and can influence and motivate without authority
* Ability to work independently
* Proactive in identifying and solving problems, looks beyond the obvious and can find the root of the problem
* Ability to build and cultivate strong cross-functional relationships
* High level of organization and attention to detail
* Data savvy; Able to interpret data and use the knowledge for introducing optimization at different levels
* Fluent with MS PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Project management tools (Jira/Confluence, Qlik, Smartsheet, MS Project)

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
  
  
If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
  
  
We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

**Job Description**
Job Title: Project Manager / Business Analyst, Enterprise Systems

**Role Summary:**
We are seeking a proactive Project Manager / Business Analyst to support the Enterprise Systems team in coordinating multiple administration and development projects across our core business systems, including HubSpot, Salesforce, MuleSoft, NetSuite, and Tableau. This role blends hands-on project coordination with business-analysis responsibilities, driving delivery of initiatives that improve Customer's Lead-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Plan-to-Fulfill value streams while translating business needs into well-defined requirements. * Create and curate requirement tickets, ensuring they are clear, prioritized, and ready for development and admin teams to execute.

* Support initiatives improving the Lead-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Plan-to-Fulfill value streams.

* Provide regular status updates, surface risks early, and communicate progress to technical teams and business stakeholders.

* Demonstrated experience managing sprints and agile delivery within Jira and Confluence.
* Business-analysis experience, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and authoring detailed requirement tickets with clear acceptance criteria.
* Experience coordinating multiple remote teams and concurrent projects.
* Working familiarity with enterprise business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, MuleSoft, HubSpot, and/or Tableau.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* A self-starter mindset with the initiative to drive work forward independently.
* ERP experience is highly desired (e.g., NetSuite or comparable platforms), along with CRM experience (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or comparable platforms).
* Experience supporting Lead-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, or Plan-to-Fulfill process improvements.
* Familiarity with integration and reporting toolchains in an enterprise environment.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Certified Scrum Master, CBAP, or equivalent).
* Act as the technical expert, ensuring quick turnaround in identifying application issues and providing timely solutions.
* Actively lead projects and contribute to unit level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers.
* Comply with all coding standards and performance measures, as per customer/organizations guidelines.
* Develop detailed plans and accurate estimates for completion of build, system testing and implementation phases of project.
* Lead the team in understanding "AS-IS" situation and design and validate the "To-Be" design

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. We are seeking an experienced SAP Manager - FI Accounts Receivable (AR) to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of global receivables processes within SAP S/4HANA environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Order-to-Cash (OTC) and Accounts Receivable processes, with hands-on experience in banking integrations, collections, dispute management, and receivables transformation initiatives.

* Lead SAP FI-AR solution design, implementation, and support across global business units.
* Manage and optimize AR processes including customer invoicing, cash application, collections, dispute resolution, dunning, and account reconciliation.
* Drive and support:

+ Bank Communication Management (BCM) Integration
+ Interest Calculation Configuration and Processing
+ AR Correspondence Management
+ Customer Account Statements
+ Lockbox Processing and Cash Application
+ HighRadius Integration for Collections and Dispute Management

* Collaborate with finance, treasury, banking, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and compliant solutions.
* Lead transformation initiatives, process automation, and continuous improvement programs.
* Manage project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional teams.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Department :**
Construction Management & Project Management Consultancy (CMC/PMC)

**Reporting To :**
Project Manager – CMC / CMC Head

**Job Purpose**

To assist in the planning, monitoring, coordination, and execution of construction projects on behalf of the Client/PMC. The role involves monitoring project progress, quality, safety, contractor performance, documentation, and compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, and approved schedules.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Planning & Scheduling**

1. Assist in preparation and monitoring of project schedules for Civil, Architectural, Structural, Electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, Fire Fighting, and allied works.
2. Track project progress against approved schedules and highlight delays, risks, and bottlenecks.
3. Coordinate with contractors and consultants to ensure adherence to project timelines.
4. Support preparation of recovery plans and corrective actions for delayed activities.

**B. Contract & Execution Monitoring**

1. Study contract documents, tender conditions, specifications, drawings, and agreement clauses.
2. Monitor execution activities to ensure compliance with approved contract documents.
3. Verify that contractor activities are executed as per approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and project requirements.
4. Assist in monitoring contractor performance and compliance with contractual obligations.

**C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control**

1. Monitor quality of construction activities and workmanship on site.
2. Ensure implementation of approved Quality Assurance and Quality Control procedures.
3. Verify compliance of materials and workmanship with approved specifications.
4. Assist in identifying quality deviations and follow up on corrective actions.
5. Prepare and monitor Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and ensure closure of observations.
6. Participate in inspections, testing, and quality audits as required.

**D. Safety Monitoring**

1. Monitor implementation of approved safety procedures and site safety requirements.
2. Coordinate with contractors and safety personnel to ensure safe working practices.
3. Report unsafe conditions and follow up on corrective measures.
4. Support implementation of statutory safety requirements and company safety standards.
5. Promote safety awareness among site personnel and contractors.

**E. Technical Coordination & Material Monitoring**

1. Review contractor methodologies, method statements, and execution procedures.
2. Monitor implementation of approved methodologies during construction.
3. Follow up for submission of material samples, shop drawings, technical submittals, and method statements.
4. Coordinate review and approval of submissions with consultants and project stakeholders.
5. Monitor procurement schedules and material delivery timelines.
6. Ensure only approved materials are used at site.

**F. Cost Monitoring & Commercial Support**

1. Monitor project progress against approved budgets and cost plans.
2. Support preparation of project cost reports and progress assessments.
3. Assist in updating billing forecasts based on actual site progress.
4. Coordinate with project teams for quantity verification and progress certification.
5. Support evaluation of variations, additional works, and change requests.

**G. Project Documentation & Administration**

1. Arrange and participate in project review meetings, coordination meetings, and site progress meetings.
2. Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
3. Submit project reports to clients, contractors, consultants, and Head Office as required.
4. Review Requests for Information (RFIs) and coordinate timely responses.
5. Prepare official correspondence, site instructions, meeting minutes, and project records.
6. Maintain registers, logs, approvals, and project documentation.
7. Assist in monitoring and controlling project change management processes.

**H. Project Completion & Handover**

1. Assist in project close-out activities, testing, and commissioning.
2. Monitor snag identification, tracking, and closure.
3. Coordinate collection of as-built drawings, manuals, certificates, warranties, and project records.
4. Support final inspections and handover activities.
5. Ensure successful completion and handover of projects to the satisfaction of the client.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Civil Engineering.
* Additional certifications in Construction Management, Quality Management, or Project Management will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 3–8 years of experience in construction supervision, PMC, project coordination, quality monitoring, or site management.
* Experience in industrial, commercial, healthcare, institutional, residential, or infrastructure projects preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office Suite, and AutoCAD.
* Working knowledge of MS Project and project scheduling software preferred.
* Ability to interpret drawings, specifications, BOQs, and contract documents.
* Understanding of construction methodologies, quality control procedures, and safety requirements.
* Knowledge of project reporting, documentation, and change management processes.
* Familiarity with statutory approvals and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and quality-focused approach.
* Ability to work effectively with contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Proactive attitude and willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Adherence to project schedules and milestone achievement.
* Quality compliance and reduction in NCRs.
* Safety compliance and closure of safety observations.
* Timely review and approval of technical submissions.
* Accuracy and timeliness of project reporting.
* Effective documentation and record management.
* Timely closure of RFIs, snag points, and change requests.

Successful project handover and client satisfaction

title: ML Operations Lead
description:
# Job Title: ML Operations Lead
  
  

* Experience:\*\* 18–25 Years overall
* Relevant Experience:\*\* 8+ years in ML, MLOps, or Data Science Engineering, including team leadership
* Location:\*\* Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune
* Work Mode:\*\* 5 Days Work from Office
* Working Hours:\*\* 9 AM – 6 PM IST(870)
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate Joiners to Serving Notice Period Candidates(only upto 30days)

## Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ML Operations Lead to lead a team responsible for operating and maintaining traditional Machine Learning models in production. The role focuses on ensuring model accuracy, reliability, stability, auditability, and continuous performance through effective monitoring, drift detection, retraining, validation, deployment, and rollback practices.
  
  
The successful candidate will manage a team of two ML Operations Engineers in India and collaborate with international stakeholders, Data Engineering teams, and business teams to ensure timely and reliable model operations.
  
  

* Note:\*\* This is a classical MLOps role focused on traditional predictive ML models, not LLM/GenAI operations.

## Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop the ML Operations team, establishing operational standards, priorities, and best practices.
* Manage the deployment, monitoring, retraining, validation, and maintenance of traditional ML models in production.
* Establish model validation gates, including backtesting and champion-challenger approaches, before promoting models to production.
* Define and manage rollback procedures to restore previous stable model versions when required.
* Monitor data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model performance degradation across the model portfolio.
* Define retraining triggers, thresholds, and processes to maintain model accuracy and reliability.
* Maintain model registries, version history, training data lineage, baseline metrics, and last-known-good model records.
* Track model performance using relevant metrics such as AUC, precision, recall, and other business-aligned KPIs.
* Monitor model bias and fairness, ensuring appropriate controls and human oversight for sensitive decision-making use cases.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to manage data quality, data freshness, data contracts, and upstream data changes.
* Implement business-requested model changes within agreed timelines while maintaining operational and validation standards.
* Coordinate with international stakeholders on deployment schedules, production incidents, change management, and operational standards.
* Report model health, deployment success rates, retraining outcomes, and overall portfolio performance.
* Support predictive ML use cases such as customer churn prediction, fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.

##
**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong experience in \*\*MLOps and production ML operations\*\*.
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating traditional Machine Learning models in production.
* Strong understanding of \*\*customer churn prediction models\*\* and related predictive analytics use cases.
* Expertise in model deployment, model monitoring, drift detection, and model retraining.
* Experience implementing ML CI/CD pipelines, model registries, and model lineage.
* Practical experience with data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model decay management.
* Experience with model validation, backtesting, and champion-challenger methodologies.
* Knowledge of model performance metrics, including AUC, precision, recall, and precision-recall evaluation.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring engineers, and managing operational priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including cross-border collaboration.
* Ability to translate business requirements into operational priorities and deliver model changes within agreed timelines.
* Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline.

## Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience in telecommunications (telco) or large-scale data environments.
* Exposure to fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting models.
* Experience with cloud-based Machine Learning platforms.
* Postgraduate qualification in Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience with model governance, auditability, responsible AI, bias monitoring, and model-risk management.

## Leadership Expectations
  
  

* Ability to lead a lean ML Operations team and establish scalable operating practices.
* Strong operational judgment and ownership of production model health.
* Effective coordination with business, data, and platform stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

## Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Minimum 2 years of stability in an organization.
* Immediate joiners and candidates currently serving notice are preferred.
* Candidates based in Pune are preferred.
* Willingness to work from the office five days a week in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune.
* Excellent communication skills are essential due to regular stakeholder and client interaction.

## Interview Process
  
  

* 2 Technical Rounds
* 1 Client Round
* HR Round

C2W is a one-stop solution provider for supply chain management, manufacturing, quality control, and product development requirements in China and SE Asia.

We are currently seeking an experienced DFM / Project Engineer to join our Pune team. This is a full-time (40 hours/week), onsite position for candidates with a proven background in DFM, SolidWorks, and manufacturing.

**Before applying, read this posting in full.**
This role requires attending an
**in-person interview and a hands-on DFM test at our Pune office (approx 60-75 mins),**
there is no remote or take-home option. If you are not willing and able to do this, please do not apply. You will only waste your time and ours.

Please note:

* This is an in-person role based in Pune, India.
* No relocation assistance is provided. You must already be based in Pune. Applications from other cities will not be considered.
* No remote, no hybrid, no students. We don’t have work-from-home policies.
* Only experienced professionals will be considered.
* This is an urgent hire. We are prioritizing candidates who can join immediately or within 30 days or less.
* Candidates with a notice period of more than 30 days will not be considered. If you cannot start within 30 days, do not apply; no exceptions will be made. Do not waste our time.
* Our selection process is fully in person: a face-to-face interview and a hands-on DFM test completed on-site at our Pune office. There is no remote or take-home test — you must be able and willing to attend in person.
* Do not send connection requests or direct messages on LinkedIn. We will reach out to candidates who are a fit; unsolicited messages will be ignored.
* A work portfolio is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Include examples of DFM analyses, SolidWorks models, technical drawings, or relevant engineering work you have completed

**Position Summary**

You will be responsible for managing the transition of products from design to mass production, ensuring designs are optimized for manufacturability across a wide variety of processes including injection molding, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, die casting, and assembly.

You will work closely with our industrial design and engineering teams across India, China, and Southeast Asia, and occasionally support communication with international clients and vendors.

**Selection Process**

* Shortlisted candidates will be invited to our Pune office for a face-to-face interview.
* As part of the process, you will complete a practical DFM test on-site at our office, reviewing drawings, recommending manufacturability improvements, and presenting your findings. The test is done in person; there is no take-home or remote option.
* Please be prepared to attend in person and demonstrate your skills live. Candidates unwilling or unable to come on-site will not be progressed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform detailed DFM analysis and recommend improvements for manufacturability, cost-efficiency, and scalability.
* Create and revise 3D CAD models and 2D drawings using SolidWorks, with appropriate use of GD&T and tolerance stack-ups.
* Generate production-ready technical documentation (BOMs, engineering drawings, assembly specs, etc.).
* Coordinate with internal teams and external suppliers for prototyping, tooling, and production execution.
* Evaluate supplier feedback on design feasibility, tooling challenges, and cost breakdowns.
* Support factory interactions including calls, visits, and documentation updates as needed.
* Maintain clear revision history and version control across all technical documentation.
* Monitor project timelines and proactively flag risks, misalignments, or bottlenecks.
* Assist quality control and production teams with testing plans and failure analysis.
* Remain open and available for international travel across our offices, this is not guaranteed but may be requested.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on, post-graduation proven experience in product engineering, manufacturing, or DFM-focused roles.
* Expert-level proficiency in SolidWorks (modeling, drafting, assemblies, GD&T).
* Proven knowledge of DFM principles for various processes: injection molding, CNC, die casting, sheet metal, and assembly.
* Experience preparing detailed production documentation and working with manufacturers or suppliers.
* Strong mechanical fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills, fluent English required both written and spoken.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with secondary CAD/visualization tools (e.g., Fusion 360, KeyShot, AutoCAD).
* Experience working with international clients or cross-functional remote teams.
* Knowledge of product compliance and testing standards (ROHS, CE, etc.).
* Exposure to ERP/project tracking tools.

**Important Application Notice**

We value genuine, thoughtful applications. Submissions generated by AI tools will be detected and rejected. We are looking for real humans with real experience, not generic buzzword filled CVs.

You’d be surprised how often this happens, please don’t waste your time or ours.

The Finance Applications team is part of the Core Applications unit within DNV’s Global Shared Services IT. The team focuses on establishing, maintaining, and supporting a full overview of finance applications to ensure stable end-to-end operations across the globe.
  
  
With Oracle eBusiness Suite at its core, additional products to complement the key processes such as purchasing, banking, credit collection, and invoicing, are also part of the finance suite.
  
  
A well-functioning and up-to-date finance system acts as a key engine to support our organization’s commercial and financial commitments, with integrations to our business production and reporting tools.
  
  
Oracle Finance Techno – Functional Analyst – Fixed Assets & PTP is part of Core Finance team within Finance Applications unit.
  
  
As with all Finance Applications teams, most of the team members based in the Global Shared Service Centers in Pune (India) / Gdynia (Poland).
  
  
The team works as one unit regardless of location, and work is prioritized based on customer needs and skills, not location.
  
  
The Core Finance team covers solutions related to Accounts receivable, Accounts Payable, Procurement, Fixed Assets & Basware cloud, with the main product supported being Oracle eBusiness suite, and requires close input with other Finance Applications streams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for ensuring Finance Applications solutions are maintained in line with the global template approach, as well as supporting country specific requirements where relevant.
* Proactively working with other team members and FA teams to ensure customer issues are resolved quickly, and with a high level of quality.
* Able to discuss and align solutions with Solution Architects and Global Process Owners before developing solutions.
* Able to engage with key stakeholders to discuss the current solutions which the team support from an overview perspective.
* Responsible for delivering requirements which are developed, documented, tested, and implemented according to agreed standards and best practice.
* Able to follow the agreed best practice approach around development, and ensuring documentation is of a high quality and maintained.
* Able to engage with customers and stakeholders at all levels within the organization.

What we offer
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance.
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave).
* Medical benefits (Insurance and Annual Health Check-up).
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance).
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme).
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement).

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. **About You**
Required Skills and Experience (inclusive):
  
  

* A strong understanding of Oracle eBusiness Suite.

* Experience with following Oracle eBS modules: Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Projects & General Ledger.
* Global experience in corporate and local (tax) FA depreciation rules.

title: Delivery Lead for GCC (Banking Domain )
description:
**Escalader Strategic Solutions**

is head hunting for its client for
**“ Delivery Lead for Banking Domain ”**

The Company is an IT GCC company.

This is a Hybrid Opportunity to be based at Pune .

**Job Title: Delivery Lead for Banking Domain**

**Location:**
Pune (hybrid; at least 3 days a week in office)

**Working hours**
: Partial overlap with US business hours (typically IST evenings) to work with client stakeholders

**Experience:**
15+ years in IT services, with the last 5 years spent leading delivery for a bank

**Reports to**
: Delivery Director / Account Delivery Head – Banking

**Team size**
: 50–150 people

**Employment type**
: Full-time, permanent

**About the role**
The Delivery Lead owns day-to-day delivery, client satisfaction and account health for one strategic banking client, run from our Pune delivery centre. You will be the bank's main delivery contact and accountable for every commitment the team makes. You will lead a team across development, testing and support. You will also find ways to grow the account and keep delivery compliant with the bank's security and regulatory requirements.

**Key responsibilities**

**Delivery management**

• Own end-to-end delivery of all projects for the bank.

• Run delivery governance: daily and weekly status reviews, monthly steering committees and QBR inputs.

• Prepare and present weekly status reports to the customer, covering progress on deliverables, milestones, risks, issues and next steps.

• Publish monthly delivery reports covering SLA and KPI performance, deliverables completed, quality metrics, resource status and improvement actions.

• Track SLAs, KPIs, milestones and risks. Step in early on red or amber projects and lead recovery.

• Drive automation, AI-assisted engineering and productivity improvements.

**Client relationship**

• Work with US-based stakeholders during overlapping hours for status calls, planning sessions and escalations.

• Serve as the main delivery contact for the bank's stakeholders, from IT managers to heads of technology.

• Build trust through predictable delivery, clear reporting and proactive communication.

• Manage escalations to closure and keep CSAT at or above target. Account financials and growth

• Manage account revenue, margin, utilisation, pyramid and monthly billing accuracy.

• Support forecasting, change requests and SOW renewals.

• Identify new scope and work with account management and pre-sales on proposals. People leadership

• Lead and mentor project managers, scrum masters and technical leads.

• Plan resourcing, hiring and onboarding with HR and the resource management team.

• Build a motivated team with clear goals, regular feedback and strong retention. Risk, security and compliance

• Ensure delivery meets the bank's and regulators' requirements.

• Maintain information security, data privacy and audit readiness.

• Manage contract compliance and delivery risk.

**Required qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

• 15+ years in IT services, with the last 5 years spent leading delivery for a banking client.

• Experience leading teams of 50+ and managing an account or programme.

• Hands-on experience delivering for clients in the US.

• Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum, SAFe, DevOps and Waterfall.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure.

• Working knowledge of APIs and microservices, data and analytics, and test automation.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

**Banking domain expertise**

• Experience in Trade Settlement, Wealth Management, Accounting and Asset Servicing.

• Understanding of US market practices such as T+1 settlement, DTCC processes, and payments (ACH, Fedwire, SWIFT).

• Exposure to TCS BaNCS would be helpful. Familiarity with other platforms common in US banking, such as FIS, Fiserv, Broadridge or SS&C, is a plus.

**Preferred qualifications**

• PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM/SAFe or ITIL certification.

• Experience with transitions or core banking modernisation programmes.

• Experience with Core Java and React is a plus.

• Prior experience working from Pune or another major Indian delivery hub.

title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
**Engineering Operations Lead**

**Location:**
Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) |
**Team:**
Engineering |
**Reporting to:**
CTO

**OVERVIEW**

APEXX is an
**independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.**
Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem:
**acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.**
Our
**routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.**
We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by
**MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital**
and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including
**Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an
**Engineering Operations Lead**
to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

**Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:**
  take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:**
  establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:**
  connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:**
  oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:**
  troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

**Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:**
  establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:**
  develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:**
  coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:**
  track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:**
  strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:**
  translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:**
  identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

**AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:**
  develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:**
  explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:**
  strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:**
  reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:**
  evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Strong experience in
  **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role**
  within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving
  **Jira**
  , including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of
  **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with
  **engineering performance metrics**
  , including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with
  **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting**
  to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with
  **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with
  **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**
  , constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience working within a
  **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management**
  function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with
  **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing
  **AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows.**
* Experience with
  **engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management.**
* Experience in a
  **FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment**
  , ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

**HOW WE HIRE**

**Three conversations:**

* a talent screen,
* a conversation with the hiring manager, and
* a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion.

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* **Competitive compensation:**
  that recognises your skills, experience and impact.
* **Generous time off:**
  annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:**
  up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy.
* **Comprehensive health insurance:**
  for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:**
  for when it's needed most.
* **Enhanced family leave:**
  enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.
* **Learning & growth:**
  opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to
**200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.**
We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

title: Senior Specialist, Product Development
description:

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

Senior Specialist, Product Development

Mastercard Prepaid Management Services global digital presence with over 55+ websites and 10+ mobile application. We are looking for senior specialist to be responsible for maintaining the current portfolio of customer facing channels - Mobile apps, My Account, Commercial platforms. The role holder will be responsible for managing the lifecycle of product features, enhancements and work collaboratively with the relevant regional product, account management, marketing, engineering, Bizops teams, Compliance and Legal to oversee the successful delivery of the changes as well as the launch of new digital platforms and capabilities.
  
  
**The Role**

* Managing the growth of Mastercard’s Prepaid Management Services (MPMS) websites: Including product capabilities, Web, CMS and mobile app updates and constant innovation to drive business success online.
* Attending scrum ceremonies and working closely with internal web and mobile development teams, to improve the user experience and always put the customer first.
* Delivering digital platforms for MPMS and clients, including the launch of new marketing, servicing sites and mobile application.
* Implement digital best practice, improve existing customer experience and drive financial growth with a focus on platform consolidation.
* Use data driven insights to reduce customer friction across our portfolio of websites and mobile apps.
* Provide regular analytical reporting and recommendations based on data.
* Partnering with and supporting regional team (Marketing, Product and Sales in particular) to advise on best practice digital execution and instigate change for the better.

**About You**

* The role requires someone with a strong all-round approach to digital; ranging from content management, launching of new features/functionality in production and a strong desire to innovate and learn from the ecommerce industry.
* Identifies issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirements and works with internal teams and customer service to identify, classify, and prioritize feature-level customer issues.
* A team player that wishes to support an innovative and fun global team by aligning to strategy, understanding the goals of the team and always working towards success.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills including the ability to work with and influence people across the organisation
* Reviews product demo against acceptance criteria for the feature set
* Supports and participates in post-launch reviews and ensures feedback is reincorporated into the feature
* Enables self-service support and/or works to reduce overhead
* Owns and manages product documentation ensuring features and associated documentation are clear.
* Experience in the SAFe/Agile software development lifecycle methodology
* A background in financial services is desirable; knowledge/experience in actively managing websites or mobile apps is a must.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Manager Product Software Engineering
description:
**Manager, Product Software Engineering**
**Job Description**
**Manager, Product Software Engineering**
is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced AI-first systems while leading a team of engineers to build scalable, high-performance applications.
  
  
The
**role owns end-to-end delivery of intelligent platforms**
—including architecture, development, and production operations—while ensuring predictable delivery, quality, and team productivity.
  
  
This role
**operates in a 70-30 capacity (hands-on technical leadership and team management),**
**combining expertise in AI/GenAI tools**
with the ability to guide, mentor, and drive execution across a team.
  
  
In addition to hands-on system design, this
**role provides technical direction, people leadership, and delivery management,**
enabling teams to build secure, compliant, and high-impact AI-driven solutions.
  
  
The role may also
**guide cross‑team delivery by coordinating complex dependencies, driving architectural decisions,**
and ensuring predictable, high‑impact outcomes within an Agile, experimentation‑driven development environment
  
  
The role
**partners closely with product management, domain experts, and cross‑functional stakeholders**
to translate complex business and regulatory needs into
**scalable, secure, and compliant technical solutions**
, while reviewing and evolving system designs and technical documentation to ensure quality, maintainability, and alignment with organizational standards.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end technical and delivery execution of intelligent platforms, ensuring alignment with timelines, quality standards, and business outcomes including system architecture, development, deployment, and continuous improvement in production environments
* Lead the design and delivery of AI-first, cloud-native solutions, ensuring high quality, scalability, reliability, and strong customer impact across mission‑critical systems
* Drive the resolution of complex technical and AI-specific challenges, performing deep system analysis and implementing resilient, long-term solutions
* Partner closely with product management, domain experts, and stakeholders to translate complex business and regulatory needs into secure, compliant, and explainable AI solutions.
* Mentor, coach, and manage engineers through structured feedback, goal setting, and performance management, fostering a high-performing engineering team
* Apply strong business acumen to ensure technology decisions align with strategic goals, driving innovation while balancing quality, speed, and operational excellence.
* Ensure on-time delivery of features and releases, balancing speed, quality, and technical debt management
* Define and drive AI architecture standards, frameworks, and best practices covering GenAI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflow etc.

**Team Leadership & Delivery Management**

* Lead and manage a team of engineers, ensuring high performance, accountability, and continuous growth
* Own sprint delivery, capacity planning, and execution predictability across the team
* Conduct performance reviews, career development discussions, and mentoring
* Drive hiring, onboarding, and skill development initiatives

**Technical Skills:**

* Core Tech stack:

+ Expertise in .NET Technologies, C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, OOP, and Python (optional/ good to have) for Web and GenAI solutions.
+ Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices using ASP.NET Core.
+ MUST HAVE - Hands-on with MS SQL Server, VS Code, Visual Studio 2022, Azure DevOps, and Agile delivery.

* Front End Skills

+ MUST HAVE - Develop dynamic, responsive UI components using ReactJS (19).
+ MUST HAVE - Write clean, modular TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap,
+ GOOD TO HAVE - Ensure cross-browser compatibility, responsiveness, and optimized UI performance.

* AI SDLC:

+ MUST HAVE - Proficient with GitHub Copilot (IDE/CLI/PR review) for code generation, testing, and standards compliance.
+ MUST HAVE - Proficient in building Agentic Skills / Copilot agents for automated PR triage and secure coding enforcement, Token Optimization.
+ MUST HAVE - Proficient in implementing features using SDD (spec-kit, Open spec) or equivalent frameworks

* Design Architecture and Quality:

+ Strong experience with Agile/Scrum, TDD, and unit testing.
+ Application of design patterns and design principles to solve software design challenges.
+ Develop web applications with excellent usability and user experience.
+ GOOD TO HAVE - Experience with RabbitMQ or Kafka for event-driven architectures
+ Optimize backend performance and ensure high availability.

* Cloud and DevOps:

+ MUST HAVE - Deploy applications on Azure OR AWS
+ MUST HAVE - Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins
+ MUST HAVE - Work with Docker and AWS Elastic container (EC2) for containerization and orchestration, S3 Bucket
+ MUST HAVE - Azure PaaS experience: Azure AD, App Services, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Blob Storage.

* GenAI & Orchestration (Good to have):

+ Good understanding of modern GenAI and Agentic AI technologies, including AI orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, and enterprise RAG architecture. Experience building reliable AI solutions through structured tool integration, validation mechanisms, and advanced retrieval techniques that improve accuracy, scalability, and governance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience in software development.
* Proven experience leading small to mid-sized engineering teams
* Experience in managing delivery in Agile/Scrum environments
* 5+ years’ experience in demonstrating ability to balance hands-on development with people management responsibilities
* 12 to 15 years of programming experience in Microsoft technologies
* 4+ years’ experience developing Single Page Applications using ReactJS (Must have)
* 8+ years’ experience building high-traffic, public-facing web applications
* 5+ years’ Experience using Azure PaaS/SaaS based technologies, designing H/A multi-region solutions
* 8+ years’ Proficiency with GitHub or equivalent tool for version control, code reviews, and integration with CI/CD pipelines
* Successful track record delivering high quality products on time while working in Agile Teams and following Agile methodologies
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively influence peers
* Experience designing and implementing stateful and stateless services in scalable, cloud-based systems
* Exposure to Cosmos or AWS DynamoDB (Good to have)
* Experience in Tax and Accounting field (Good to have)

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

title: Global REFM Governance & Performance Senior Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you: innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground-breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.
  
  
**About You**
In this role, you will deliver recurring governance processes, prepare data-driven performance insights, manage action plans, and help identify and implement risk countermeasures, savings, cost avoidance, operational excellence, and process improvements. You will also support supplier migrations, contract lifecycle activities, and continuous improvement while partnering with REFM Global Process Owners, global and regional stakeholders, suppliers, Procurement, Finance, and other teams. It starts with YOU.
  
  
The Supplier Governance Analyst drives supplier governance, KPI performance, and financial tracking for Global Business Services Real Estate and Facilities Management (GBS REFM).
  
  
**Job Responsibilities Include**
Supplier Governance & Performance Management
  
  

* Drive recurring supplier governance routines, including monthly reviews, quarterly business reviews, KPI scorecards, action logs, issue escalation, and performance tracking.
* Monitor supplier services through disciplined, data-driven performance management across service delivery, financial performance, and savings.
* Prepare performance insights and executive-ready summaries for governance forums and stakeholder decisions.
* Manage action plans, follow-ups, issue resolution, and performance improvement commitments.

Financial, Contract & Risk Management
  
  

* Work with contract obligations, service levels, financial baselines, savings glidepaths, budgets, and forecasts.
* Support fee-at-risk, service-credit, savings, and cost-avoidance calculations and tracking.
* Analyze complex contract, operational, and financial data and validate information used for reporting.
* Identify risks and support the development and implementation of practical countermeasures.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify and support operational excellence, process improvement, savings, and cost-avoidance opportunities.
* Support supplier migrations, contract lifecycle activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain trackers, governance artifacts, performance summaries, and supporting documentation.
* Apply a progress-over-perfection mindset while maintaining accountability, quality, and momentum.

Stakeholder & Supplier Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with REFM Global Process Owners and global and regional stakeholders to support disciplined supplier service delivery.
* Coordinate effectively with suppliers, Procurement, Finance, and other internal and external stakeholders.
* Communicate complex performance, financial, contract, and operational information clearly across diverse stakeholder levels.
* Operate effectively in a global, matrixed environment and across time zones, including flexible working hours when required.

Analytics & Reporting
  
  

* Use Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and related tools for data validation, trackers, analysis, performance summaries, and executive-ready reporting.
* Translate complex data into clear insights, risks, actions, and decision points.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, consistent, and suitable for governance discussions.

To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Facilities Management, Engineering, Procurement, or a related field is preferred.
* 6–10 years of experience in supplier governance, facilities management, real estate operations, outsourced services, or contract performance management.
* Direct experience managing supplier performance routines such as monthly reviews, QBRs, KPI scorecards, action logs, issue escalation, and performance tracking.
* Experience working with contract obligations, service levels, financial baselines, savings glidepath tracking, budget and forecast support, and fee-at-risk or service-credit calculations.
* Strong analytical capability using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and related tools, including data validation, trackers, performance summaries, and executive-ready reporting.
* Experience coordinating diverse stakeholders and suppliers in a matrixed global environment.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required and work across time zones, including flexible hours in a global role.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* IFMA Certified Facility Manager (CFM), Facility Management Professional (FMP), or equivalent certification.
* Working capability in Spanish.

Leadership Behaviors & Core Capabilities
  
  

* Demonstrates Care, Own, Act.
* Collaboration and accountability.
* Bias for action and progress over perfection.
* Supplier governance and performance management.
* Financial, contract, and risk analysis.
* Executive communication and stakeholder influence.
* Operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Additional Role Information
  
  
This job description provides an overview of the role’s responsibilities. Detailed processes are managed through the role card, governance playbook, service catalogs, RACIs, standard operating procedures, and annual objectives.
  
  
Led by Purpose. Driven by You.

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.

We actively seek to build a workforce that reflects the experiences of our consumers. When you bring your original thinking to Kimberly-Clark, you fuel the continued success of our enterprise. title: Team Lead - Engineering
description:
**About Tripstack -**
Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining. Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform - giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non-partner, low-cost and full-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost-effective API. Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily. Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection. For more information, visit: www.tripstack.com ,www.etraveligroup.com
  
  
**Role Overview :**
As a Technical Lead on the Content team, you will architect software that ensures people can find the best flight combinations, as well as making Tripstack's software solid and scalable. A successful candidate will thrive in and help lead fast-paced environments that leverage agile planning techniques, encourage and reward creative design and intelligent risk taking, and find innovative ways to leverage cutting-edge technology. You will lead a high-performing team to ensure our systems are scalable and low-latency. You will drive the technical roadmap, mentor senior engineers, and balance innovative feature development with technical debt management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure high-quality delivery by owning the development from ideation, planning, design, implementation, and quality assurance to post-production monitoring.
* Ensure the team's technical decisions are consistently correct, and revisit them when the context changes.
* Unblock the team on technical ambiguity by resolving it quickly and directly.
* Strategize and support the team in unblocking itself using existing company resources and cross team collaboration.
* Author and approve code and designs that rarely require architectural rework after release.
* Ensure the team's solutions follow code guidelines and apply secure and defensive coding practices as a default.
* Build scalable, low-latency, fault-tolerant systems empirically proven through load and stress testing.
* Flag known tradeoffs before they become incidents.
* Track, plan, and resolve tech debt consciously so that it doesn’t pile up.
* Ensure the team's releases are monitored, documented, and supportable.
* Act as scrum master for the team.
* Improve the SDLC and project workflow for the team and group.
* Create an inclusive environment where every engineer can contribute and be heard.
* Promote team building and a durable team culture.
* Encourage responsible AI adoption within the team.
* Set clear expectations for how AI-assisted work is reviewed before it merges.
* You translate broader business objectives into clear engineering tasks while shielding the team from unnecessary external noise.
* Remove blockers using approved AI tooling.

**Requirements -**

* 8 to 12 years of experience in software development using C#, .Net core, javascript, and typescript.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading an agile development team.
* Strong experience in leading a mid-sized team (7-10) which includes developers and QA Engineers.
* Strong experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, XML, JSON, and SOAP.
* Strong architectural & system design skills.
* Experience in GCP/AWS is a plus.
* Strong experience with code review tools like SonarQube, etc.
* Hands-on experience in driving ambiguous problem areas in existing or new software initiatives.
* Proven experience in solving complex architecture and business problems with solutions that are extensible, simple, and optimal.
* Ability to think in terms of integrating systems and networks as well as programs.
* Strong Experience influencing software engineering best practices within your team, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
* Experience taking a leading role in building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers with other engineers working under your guidance.
* Experience mentoring software engineers to improve their skills, and making them more effective software engineers.
* Experience in communicating with engineering leadership to understand requirements describing software product features, technical designs, and product strategy.
* Experience in system development skills in C#.
* Experience upskilling senior engineers in AI-assisted coding.
* Proficiency in using AI tools like Claude to improve efficiency of SDLC.

**What Success Looks Like -**

* The team regularly meets the delivery commitments on quality.
* Technical ambiguity does not stall the team; decisions are made and communicated quickly.
* Post-release architectural rework, rollbacks or incidents are rare.
* Engineers on the team describe it as a place where they express themselves and produce their best work.

**Other:**

* Work Mode : Hybrid
* Work Timings: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM.
* Second level of On call support for production systems that are owned by team

**What it takes to succeed here -**
Ambition and dedication to make a difference and change the way people travel; Where we always play to each other's strength in a high performing team reaching for our common goal. We hold ourselves to the highest expectations, and move with a sense of urgency and hold ourselves accountable and win by staying true to what we believe in.
  
  
**What we offer -**
We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!
  
  
**Diversity disclaimer -**
At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

title: Ops Support Senior Supervisor
description:

The overall objective of this role is to ensure the seamless delivery of operations support services in alignment with Citi operations support infrastructure and processes.

Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.

Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.

title: Manager - Cloud Container Services
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Manager, Cloud Container Services is responsible for the operational leadership, governance, reliability, and lifecycle management of the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes Service (CAKS) platform. The role leads a team of Kubernetes platform engineers and operations specialists responsible for delivering a secure, scalable, highly available, and automated container platform that enables application teams to deploy and operate workloads efficiently across the enterprise.
  
  
This position serves as the operational owner of the centralized AKS platform, driving platform adoption, service reliability, operational excellence, security compliance, and executive reporting. The role is accountable for providing leadership with actionable insights on platform performance, adoption, operational risks, capacity utilization, cost optimization, and service health. The role aligns closely with the enterprise Cloud Foundation strategy and centralized, multi-tenant AKS operating model.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Platform Operations & Service Ownership
  
  

* Own and manage the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes (CAKS) platform.
* Ensure platform availability, stability, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes.
* Establish operational standards, support models, runbooks, and platform governance controls.
* Drive Kubernetes platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and end-of-life planning.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements.

Kubernetes Platform Management
  
  

* Oversee centralized multi-tenant AKS environments supporting mission-critical and non-mission-critical workloads.
* Manage cluster operations, node pool lifecycle, networking, and platform integrations.
* Ensure secure workload onboarding and platform standardization across business units.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement scalable and reusable Kubernetes platform capabilities.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives, automation, and self-service capabilities.

Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Define and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Lead major incident management and root cause analysis activities.
* Drive reliability engineering practices and resilience improvements.
* Implement automation-first operational processes leveraging GitHub and Infrastructure as Code.
* Ensure disaster recovery and business continuity readiness for critical Kubernetes workloads.
* Reduce operational overhead through standardization and automated remediation.

Executive Reporting & Operational Metrics
  
  

* Develop executive dashboards and leadership reporting focused on:

+ Platform Availability & Uptime
+ Cluster Health Metrics
+ MTTR & Incident Trends
+ SLA/SLO Compliance
+ Kubernetes Resource Utilization
+ Capacity Planning & Forecasting
+ Node Pool Utilization
+ Security & Compliance Posture
+ Platform Adoption Metrics
+ Cost Optimization & FinOps Insights
+ Support Backlog & Service Request Metrics

* Present operational reviews, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership

**Security & Governance**

* Maintain enterprise Kubernetes governance standards.
* Oversee RBAC, Azure AD integration, Managed Identities, and secrets management.
* Ensure enforcement of Azure Policy, security guardrails, and compliance controls.
* Partner with Cybersecurity teams to ensure secure platform operations.
* Lead audit and regulatory compliance activities related to container platforms

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary operational contact for application teams consuming AKS services.
* Build relationships with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, and Engineering teams.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and strategic partners to optimize platform capabilities.
* Drive customer experience and service improvement initiatives across the Kubernetes ecosystem.

People Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Kubernetes platform operations team.
* Establish operational goals and performance expectations.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and technical capability growth.
* Promote a culture of automation, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
Education & Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, container engineering or platform engineering with 15+ years of total work experience, including Azure and/or AWS environments.
* 5+ years of people management experience managing Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or Operations Teams.
* Proven experience managing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms, specifically:

+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
+ Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD.
+ DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, Hub and Spoke Architecture,
+ RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault etc..

* Strong experience leading ITIL service management functions, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Experience building and presenting executive operational dashboards and service reviews.
* Proven track record of driving platform reliability, operational transformation, and automation initiatives.
* Experience managing globally distributed teams and complex enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and Cloud Kubernetes Services.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, container orchestration, and cloud-native technologies.
* Expertise in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) administration and operations.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms.
* Strong knowledge of container technologies including Docker and container registries.
* Experience with GitOps practices using ArgoCD and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Bicep).
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, including Hub-Spoke architecture, Private Link, Azure Firewall, ingress, and service networking.
* Experience implementing Kubernetes security controls, RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Policy, and Secrets Management.
* Expertise in observability, monitoring, logging, and performance management using enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Planning
* Vendor and Managed Service Provider Governance.

Key Success Metrics
  
  

* Enterprise CAKS platform consistently achieves availability, performance, and security objectives.
* Increased adoption of centralized AKS services across business units.
* High levels of automation, self-service, and operational maturity.
* Reduced operational overhead and improved platform reliability.
* Leadership receives timely, actionable operational insights and recommendations.
* High-performing teams delivering secure, scalable, and resilient Kubernetes platform services.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
