As part of the global Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE), you will play a pivotal role in supporting our category managers and demand managers worldwide. Your expertise will streamline RfX operations, strengthen supplier communication, and drive process improvements.
  
  
Our global procurement organization enables our projects and business functions by maximizing value and minimizing risks through the smart, cost effective, and sustainable procurement of goods and services. We ensure a resilient and competitive supplier ecosystem, supporting our transition towards best-in-class procurement practices and a more efficient, effective, and future proof organization.
  
  
Furthermore, procurement plays an important role in Vanderlande’s transformation from an Engineer to Order (ETO) to a Configure to Order (CTO) business model—enhancing customer value through increased standardization, scalability, and competitiveness.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Global RfX Specialist, you will support all RfX related activities, ensuring the timely and smooth execution of proposals and quotations. You will coordinate submission timelines, assist in evaluating supplier responses, and collaborate closely with cross functional business functions. You will follow established RfX processes while contributing to the continuous improvement of procurement practices across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What you bring**

* Support category managers and demand managers worldwide in executing RfX processes (including spot buys and light tenders), including drafting RfX documents and assisting with initial proposal and quotation analysis.
* Coordinate and communicate submission timelines with suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal stakeholders.
* Consolidate supplier responses into clear, structured formats to support evaluations and decision making.
* Execute all RfX activities in compliance with procurement policies, legal regulations, and ethical sourcing standards.
* Identify opportunities for improving RfX processes and support the implementation of best practices across the Procurement CoE.

**What do we ask from you?**
To be successful in this role, you should have
  
  

* 4-7 years of proven progressive experience in procurement processes and sourcing strategies, ideally with hands on involvement in RfX activities such as drafting documents, evaluating proposals, and supporting supplier selection.
* Experience in project-based procurement environments (e.g., engineering, automation, intralogistics, material handling, or system integration), with the ability to work effectively when requirements evolve or clarity is limited.
* Strong ability to analyze supplier responses, identify key performance indicators, and support strategic procurement decisions.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail to manage multiple RfX tasks simultaneously while maintaining accurate documentation.
* Demonstrated capability to identify and support process improvements, ideally within RfX or procurement operations.
* Stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to work effectively with cross functional global teams such as engineering, project management, category management, finance, and planning.
* Comfort working in ambiguous, low SOP environments, bringing structure, clarity, and proactive follow up when information is incomplete.
* Exposure to global, multicultural environments, with the ability to work across regions, cultures, and time zones.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills to interact effectively with suppliers and internal stakeholders worldwide.

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors.
  
  
At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Website**
www.vanderlande.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
* 22 paid leave days
* 8 sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.

**How We Work**
We work by three values Every day better, we care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.

title: Tech Resilience - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients strengthen technology resilience and recovery capabilities across complex enterprise environments. As a Senior Consultant, you will support clients in identifying resilience risks, designing recovery strategies, and implementing solutions that improve preparedness for cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and technology failures. You will work across infrastructure, cloud, backup, and recovery domains to help organizations improve operational continuity and recovery readiness.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Conduct technology resilience risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities, technical risks, and single points of failure across enterprise environments
* Design and implement cyber resilience, disaster recovery, incident response, and business continuity solutions aligned to client requirements
* Design, build, and maintain isolated recovery environments and support recovery of critical workloads, including applications, databases, and directory services
* Assess infrastructure, application, network, storage, and cloud environments to improve resilience architecture, backup integrity, and recovery readiness
* Lead recovery testing, simulation exercises, runbook development, and client preparedness activities across resilience programs

**The team**
Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help clients defend against sophisticated threats by transforming security operations, leveraging technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence for continuous monitoring and rapid incident response. They manage dynamic attack surfaces and support business continuity through services such as operational resilience, crisis and incident response, and security operations center transformation.
  
  
Resilience as a Practice focuses on preparing organizations to anticipate, withstand, and recover from disruptions—including cyberattacks, natural disasters, and operational failures—by embedding resilience into processes, technology, and culture. Deloitte’s Resilience Team combines technical, operational, and strategic expertise to deliver integrated solutions for business continuity, disaster recovery, and risk management, ensuring organizations meet regulatory demands and maintain stakeholder trust during crises.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Based on client / project needs**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6-10 years of experience with infrastructure architecture, application architecture, or both across on-premises and cloud environments
* Experience with backup, recovery, or data protection tools such as Cohesity, Veeam, Zerto, Commvault, or Dell PowerProtect Data Manager
* Experience designing, implementing, or managing cloud solutions across at least two major cloud service providers
* Experience gathering technical requirements, performing gap analysis, developing technical specifications, and supporting large-scale solution architecture
* Experience with network segmentation, virtual local area networks (VLANs), firewall policy management, or isolated recovery environments
* Knowledge of National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800.53, International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, or governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) tools
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with cyber resilience, technology resilience, business continuity, or disaster recovery programs
* Experience with immutable storage, backup validation, and recovery testing processes

* Certifications such as Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), ISO 22301, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - Mergers & Acquisition – IT – Senior Consultant**
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. **Position Summary**

Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
We guide M&A initiatives for companies to help expand and accelerate revenue and cost synergies, reduce transaction risk, and retain key talent, even as they make structural changes to their business, operating model, or capital model. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
  
  

* 1. Develop client deliverables and documentation:
* Identify and select the most relevant set of tools/techniques to meet client requirements such as business case development, financial modeling, and analysis, etc.
* Analyze and interpret project data, draw conclusions, and develop recommendations based on the result of the specific outputs.
* Use analytics to build strategic insights for the client.
* Define project standards, methodologies, and execute process improvement initiatives.
* 2. Engage in client interaction:
* Conduct client interviews to verify and validate assumptions, hypothesis, and analysis.
* Participate in workshops and training sessions.
* Synthesize and present insights and recommendations.
* Develop and maintain working relationships with client counterparts.
* 3. Participate in engagement management including:
* Own and manage specific work threads.
* Develop plans for components of engagements.
* Coordinate activities between different work threads.
* Identify and help manage changes in scope.
* Manage and mentor junior resources.

We are part of one of the world’s leading consulting firms for Advisory Services. We combine experience, scale, and capabilities to help clients address their most complex business problems. Our mandate is to enable our clients’ ability to grow, optimize, and fundamentally change the nature of their business and competitive position. We do this via M&A, divestiture, and restructuring services from beginning to end. Our Offering enables pre-deal and post-deal integration, divestiture, and major restructuring/cost transformation activities to achieve/exceed deal value, synergy targets, or strategic cost objectives.
  
  
M&A IT Senior Consultants are expected to advise clients, serve as subject matter experts, execute projects, and have strong outcome orientation. The candidate should have experience in delivering Technology/IT consulting projects. M&A experience is desired but not mandatory. An ideal candidate should have the following experience and skill set:
  
  

* Guide clients on key concepts and strategies for M&A engagements, including but not limited to Due diligence, Day 1/Day 2 planning, business continuity planning, synergy identification / capture, one time or stranded cost analyses, testing and system cutovers.

+ Understanding of corporate IT landscape and IT strategy development
+ Planning and executing IT integration, separation and transformation projects in M&A deals
+ Projects involving design, development, testing and data migration of enterprise systems such as ERP (SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics etc.), CRM, Big Data, HRIS etc. including integration of enterprise applications.
+ Providing subject matter expertise across critical components of IT landscape:

- Applications (experience across SDLC)
- Enterprise Architecture
- Infrastructure (Servers, Storage, Network, End User Computing, Service Desk)
- Data Center Strategy (Optimization, Redesign, Consolidation, Co-location)
- Data Migration (strategy and planning)

- IT Operating Model
- IT Financials in M&A and Transformation Scenarios (IT OpEx/CapEx Cost Modeling, Synergies)
- IT Transition Service Agreements (TSA)

* Advise clients on industry-leading solutions that enable complex transformations across different technology areas such as Applications Rationalization, Cloud Strategy, Infrastructure Virtualization, Data Management etc.

**Qualifications**

* MBA is mandatory. Engineering undergrads are preferred but not mandatory

MBA is mandatory. Engineering undergrad is preferred but not mandatory

title: Sr. Analyst, Implementation
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.
* Share AI innovations, document their impact, and drive adoption across I2 and I3 peers.

**12-Month Success Signals**
A successful Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) at the end of 12 months will have:
  
  

* Led multiple enterprise or multi-product implementations to successful Go Live with measurably shorter cycle times and low escalation rates, demonstrating ownership at a higher complexity tier than I2.
* Delivered at least two NPI readiness contributions — documented implementation playbooks, training materials, or bug reports — that were formally adopted by the Go Live or Product teams.
* Authored or significantly improved at least two Go Live practice standards or playbooks, with measurable adoption and quality impact across the team.
* Mentored at least two I2 Analysts with demonstrable improvement in their implementation quality metrics or time-to-competency.
* Built and deployed at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., a Glean agent, automation script, or prompt framework) that generated measurable time savings or quality improvements at a team level — not just personally.
* Supported at least one pre-sales engagement in partnership with the Sales or Account Management team, contributing to a customer expansion or new business outcome.

AI Expectations
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first company. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) is expected to operate as an AI Bar Raiser — not just embedding AI into their own work, but actively raising AI capability across the Go Live team.
  
  
**Specific Expectations Include**

* Design and build reusable AI tools — including Glean AI agents, automated documentation workflows, and AI-assisted risk detection models — that are shared and adopted across the team.
* Use AI to analyze implementation portfolio data at scale, identifying patterns in at-risk implementations, NPI friction points, or recurring ERP configuration issues, and translating insights into proactive action.
* Deploy AI to accelerate NPI documentation, training material generation, and business requirements capture — dramatically compressing the time from product release to team readiness.
* Use AI to support customer communication at scale — generating implementation status summaries, tailored onboarding guidance, and escalation documentation with speed and precision.
* Coach I2 Analysts on applied AI usage, sharing effective practices and helping peers move from casual familiarity to embedded, outcome-driven AI workflows.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, in full compliance with Avalara's data governance and AI ethics policies.

Candidates must demonstrate specific, quantified examples of AI usage that improved team-level outcomes — not just personal efficiency. Senior Analysts who cannot clearly articulate their AI impact across a team or function do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard for this level.
  
  
What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required**

description:
**Job Description**

This role is critical to Oceaneering’s delivery and growth strategy, acting as a single point of contact for assigned business units, influencing functional strategy, mentoring engineers and SMEs, and driving continuous improvement in engineering quality, processes, and customer value.
* We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement, enabling effective collaboration with global stakeholders while maintaining flexibility for focused technical leadership and strategic contribution across projects and functions.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, as required, to support multi-disciplinary project oversight, customer and business unit interactions, and enterprise-level technical initiatives.

**Responsibilities**
**Needs to perform following activities:**

* Lead a team of Engineering Analysts subsea SURF engineers on dynamic analysis of flexible flowlines .
* Lead multiple projects at the same time, including large and complex multi-disciplinary projects.
* Direct teams of SURF engineers to enable them handle dynamic analysis projects effectively .
* Review work carried out by SURF engineers .
* Approve deliveries made by the team.
* Ensure compliance to established engineering processes.
* Define functional processes and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as account manager for one or more business units for subsea SURF projects.
* Communicate with business units to understand design and analysis requirements.
* Define scope of work, plan jobs, allocate resources, and share regular progress updates.
* Monitor performance against relevant KPIs and identify growth opportunities.
* Participate in governance meetings with business units.
* Approve engineering process documents and team timesheets.
* Prepare and conduct technical trainings.
* Maintain performance records and support performance management activities.
* Develop competency matrices and identify training needs.
* Provide engineering guidance to other disciplines.
* Keep abreast of industry trends and issues.
* Evaluate resource needs and provide recommendations.
* Work towards organizational objectives and ensure team members accomplish performance goals.
* Comply with HR, HSE, and organizational policies and procedures.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Safety**
Ensure that the Safety policies and procedures are understood and adhered to so far as is reasonably practicable in order to ensure a safe working environment.
  
  
**Other**

* Carry out work in accordance with the Company Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality Systems.
* Perform assigned tasks with due diligence regarding the Integrated Management Systems of the Company.
* Eliminate waste, promote environmentally friendly practices, and contribute to continuous environmental improvement.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
This position may be required to lead a team of Engineers / Engineering Analysts.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience:**

* Post Graduation (Master's degree) in Mechanical/Civil/Ocean/ Naval Architecture/ Subsea (or related) Engineering with minimum 8 years of relevant industry experience, OR
* Graduation (Bachelor's degree) in Mechanical/Ocean/ Naval Architecture/ Subsea (or related) Engineering with minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Other Characteristics**

* Expert level knowledge of FEA and SURF Local and Global Analysis using relevant CAE software (e.g., OrcaFlex, UFlex, ANSYS, RISA, Sesam).
* Strong knowledge of multiple applicable industry codes and standards (ASME, DNV, API, AISC, etc.).
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Communication skills.
* Teamwork and interpersonal skills.
* Analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Organizing and planning skills.
* Team building, coaching and mentoring skills.
* Leadership abilities.

**About Us**
Oceaneering is a global provider of engineered services and products, primarily to the offshore energy industry. We develop products and services for use throughout the lifecycle of an offshore oilfield, from drilling to decommissioning. We operate the world's premier fleet of work class ROVs. Additionally, we are a leader in offshore oilfield maintenance services, umbilicals, subsea hardware, and tooling. We also use applied technology expertise to serve the defense, material handling, aerospace, science, and renewable energy industries.
  
  
**Overview**
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
Since year 2003, Oceaneering’s India Center has been an integral part of operations for Oceaneering’s robust product and service offerings across the globe. This center caters to diverse business needs, from oil and gas field infrastructure, subsea robotics to automated material handling & logistics.
  
  
Our multidisciplinary team offers a wide spectrum of solutions, encompassing Subsea Engineering, Robotics, Automation, Control Systems, Software Development, Asset Integrity Management, Inspection, ROV operations, Field Network Management, Graphics Design & Animation, and more.
  
  
In addition to these technical functions, Oceaneering India Center plays host to several crucial business functions, including Finance, Supply Chain Management (SCM), Information Technology (IT), Human Resources (HR), and Health, Safety & Environment (HSE).
  
  
Our world class infrastructure in India includes modern offices, industry-leading tools and software, equipped labs, and beautiful campuses aligned with the future way of work. Oceaneering in India as well as globally has a great work culture that is flexible, transparent, and collaborative with great team synergy.
  
  
At Oceaneering India Center, we take pride in “Solving the Unsolvable” by leveraging the diverse expertise within our team. Join us in shaping the future of technology and engineering solutions on a global scale.

As a
**Team Lead – Medium Voltage**
you will be responsible to lead a team of application/electrical engineers engaged in the engineering of Medium Voltage (MV) Motor Control Center (MCCs), Switchgear and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), customizing as per customer requirement utilizing the AutoCAD tools, while providing engineering support to the manufacturing plants of RA. This role reports to the Engineering Manager and is part of Global Engineering & Business Services group in India, catering to regional Rockwell Automation offices across the globe. It's a hybrid work environment working in 12:00pm to 9:00 pm shift located in Pune/Noida - India.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor and develop a team of MV application/electrical engineers – allocating and prioritizing work, managing workload and ensuring on-time delivery, high quality engineering and customer satisfaction
* Manage day-to-day execution of CTO/ETO projects within defined timelines, ensuring high quality engineering while leveraging standard and reusable engineering practices
* Serve as the technical escalation point and subject-matter expert for MV products (MV MCCs, MV Switchgear, MV Drives), providing robust technical solutions, addressing queries and resolving technical deficiencies
* Work closely with internal and external customers, and collaborate with global stakeholders across regions and time zones, to review requirements and deliver customized technical solutions that comply with electrical standards and Rockwell Automation's engineering practices
* Coordinate overall system integration activities, maintaining accurate documentation and fostering effective collaboration across teams and functions
* Drive capability development, continuous improvement and knowledge-sharing within the team – coaching engineers, building technical depth and supporting other initiatives
* Monitor team performance, quality metrics, resource utilization and project KPIs, reporting progress and risks to the Execution Manager
* Ensure strict adherence to international engineering standards (NEC, UL, CSA, IEC) by consistently applying them throughout order execution activities

**The Essentials – You Will Have**

* Bachelor's in Electrical / Electronics
* Relevant Experience of more than 8-10 years in Hardware Designing for Medium Voltage MCC / Switchgear, Electrical knowledge and Automation Engineering
* Minimum 3 years of experience in leading and managing an engineering team
* Exposure of working in a global setup – collaborating with global stakeholders, customers and cross-functional teams across regions and time zones
* Strong domain expertise in Medium Voltage Drives, PLC & MCC System Designing
* Expertise of AutoCAD-Electrical software
* Thorough knowledge of DOL & S/D Starters, VFDs, Soft-Starters, Intelligent Motor Control, Safety Product's System Designing
* Knowledge of Electrical Components Selection, Busbar Calculation, Heat and Load Calculation
* In depth knowledge of International Standards used for Design and Manufacturing

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**

* Field Installation & Commissioning experience on MV VFDs, MV Switchgear, PCC's, MCC's, PLC's & Instruments is preferrable
* Gone through complete project life cycle from design phase to commissioning
* Proven people-leadership skills – team building, mentoring, performance management and workload planning
* Good Command on SAP Documentation and Part Management
* Industry and application Knowledge, training skills, and familiar with Lean Six Sigma and EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) Principles.
* Experience with Creo software
* Experience on Panel Testing, I/O Testing and FAT
* Experience of managing or coordinating deliverables across a global / distributed engineering team is preferrable

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

**Equal Opportunity & Inclusion**
At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

title: System Software Manager - Power Profiling and Infrastructure
description:
NVIDIA is a global leader in accelerated computing, powering breakthroughs in AI, graphics, autonomous vehicles, and scientific simulation.
  
  
Inside NVIDIA, the Software Power Profiling team is the power measurement authority for our most strategic platforms — RTX Spark, DGX Spark, discrete GPU desktop and notebook, and data center. The team measures power and performance-per-watt, qualifies power targets, co-engineers battery life with OEMs, runs nightly regression farms across the device fleet, and builds the profiling infrastructure — frameworks, analytics dashboards, and automated regression farms — that the rest of NVIDIA relies on to understand and optimize power.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Lead, grow, and mentor a cross-site team of power and infrastructure engineers across Pune and Bangalore — setting individual and team roadmaps, development plans, and clear ownership across all mandates.
* Drive the team's power profiling authority across the full product lifecycle: pre-silicon power engagement, power target qualification, regression monitoring, battery-life validation, and external software release qualification — including nightly development-branch and release-branch power and perf/watt monitoring across discrete GPU and data-center platforms.
* Own the physical lab — run a temperature-controlled, instrumented measurement lab across two sites, covering DUT fleet management, board procurement, intake and logistics, board instrumentation and rework, DAQ and power-path integrity, rack build-out, and cross-geo capacity planning.
* Shape measurability from pre-silicon through production — engage pre-silicon to challenge power modelling assumptions and establish measurement confidence levels; drive instrumented boards, rail maps, on-board sensors, and DAQ adapter design; specify, track, and escalate measurement prerequisites (telemetry, software build, validation, and agreed power targets with guard band policy), holding the requirement and escalating when it slips.
* Close power gaps and own release readiness — quantify and attribute power gaps to rail, IP, feature, and residency; drive debug and optimization alongside software and hardware power owners through experiments and recovery confirmation; deliver the power verdict that feeds program go/no-go decisions, backed by qualification data on every external software drop.
* Lead cross-company power engagement — converge measurement methodology and tooling with OEMs and software power owners; co-engineer shared battery-life targets, conduct joint root-cause analysis where measurements diverge, and maintain a common bug-and-analysis stream.
* Own the team's infrastructure portfolio and energy compliance — drive the in-house power profiling framework, power analytics dashboard, and automated power regression farm as production-grade shared assets; deliver energy-regulation compliance evidence (idle, standby, and off-mode power) required to clear product release gates.

What we need to see
  
  

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 8+ years of overall industry experience.
* 5+ years of engineering management experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex software and infrastructure at velocity across distributed teams.
* Deep background in power systems, computer architecture, and SoC/platform power — with hands-on experience in power measurement, analysis, or power-stack debugging.
* Experience running or closely supporting a hardware measurement lab — instrumentation, device fleet, and the logistics that keep it productive.
* Demonstrated ability to engage across the full program lifecycle — from pre-silicon power modeling through bring-up, qualification, and post-commercialization sustaining.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to operate across engineering teams, program management, partner labs, OEM customers, and executive stakeholders.
* Commitment to measurement quality and the defensibility of data that drives product decisions.

Ways to stand out from the crowd
  
  

* Hands-on power profiling experience — DAQ-based external rail capture, on-board sensor validation, or telemetry-driven regression root cause.
* Intimate knowledge of Windows on Arm or client SoC platforms — battery-life scenario methodology, Modern Standby measurement, or energy-efficiency regulatory compliance.
* Experience leading silicon bring-up power profiling — firmware sensor validation, first-power baselines, and bring-up-phase engagement with hardware teams.
* Track record of building or leading power regression infrastructure or automated test/analysis pipelines at scale.
* Experience with AI/agentic workflow development applied to lab automation, failure triage, or report generation.
* Prior cross-company lab convergence work — aligning methodology, build synchronization, and shared tooling between two or more power or validation labs.

title: Project Coordinator – Digital Literacy (Urban)
description:
Position : Project Coordinator – Digital Literacy (Urban)

Location : Pune

Reports to : State Head

Tenure : 1 Year

HelpAge India is a secular, not-for-profit organisation in India, registered under the Societies’ Registration Act of 1860. Set up in 1978, the organisation works for
*‘the cause and care of disadvantaged older persons to improve their quality of life’*
. It runs healthcare, agecare, livelihood, disaster response and awareness initiatives throughout the country & advocates strongly for the elder cause. It became the first and only Indian organization to be honoured with the ‘UN Population Award 2020’ for its exemplary work in the field of ageing and population issues, and earlier in 2014, has been the recipient of
*‘Vayoshreshtha Samman’*
by Government of India, as an institution working for senior citizens. We have been awarded highest CRISIL VO 1A grading for excellence in operations and high credibility. We have been recognized as a Great Place to Work.

**Role Overview**

The Project Coordinator will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing the Digital & Financial Empowerment Programme for senior citizens across the state. The position requires close engagement with senior citizen associations, community volunteers, community stakeholders, and project teams to ensure effective program delivery, achievement of targets, and timely reporting.

**Programme Implementation & Coordination**

* **Coordinate and oversee programme implementation across designated districts and**
  urban locations.
* Develop and maintain a database of Senior Citizen Associations (SCAs), Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), clubs, elder groups, and urban slum communities.
* Ensure adherence to project timelines, guidelines, and quality standards.
* Monitor programme activities and provide regular updates to the State Program Manager, State Head, and Programme Lead.

**Training & Capacity Building**

* Organize and facilitate monthly digital, financial, and legal literacy workshops for senior citizens.
* Conduct awareness sessions on digital safety, cyber fraud prevention, online services, financial inclusion, and legal rights.
* Train and mentor youth volunteers to support programme implementation.
* Build local resource networks to strengthen outreach and programme impact.

**Monitoring, Reporting & Documentation**

* Ensure achievement of monthly and quarterly programme targets.
* Collect, verify, and maintain programme data for monitoring and evaluation.
* Prepare and submit progress reports, MIS reports, success stories, photographs, videos, and case studies.
* Track participant feedback and recommend improvements to enhance programme effectiveness.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with SCAs, RWAs, elder groups, banks, financial institutions, legal authorities, and community stakeholders.
* Support stakeholder consultations, programme reviews, and planning meetings.
* Represent the programme at local events, networking forums, and observances such as World Elder Abuse Awareness Day (WEAAD) and International Day of Older Persons (IDOP).

**Administrative Support**

* Coordinate logistics for workshops, training programmes, and outreach activities.
* Maintain records of programme activities, attendance, and volunteer engagement.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and project requirements.

Requirements
  
  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Sociology, Development Studies, Education, Management, or a related field.

* 1 to 3 years of experience in programme coordination, community development, outreach, training, or related social sector projects.
* Experience working with senior citizens, digital literacy, financial inclusion, or community-based programmes will be preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Programme planning and project management
* Training and facilitation skills
* Stakeholder engagement and partnership building
* Monitoring, evaluation, and reporting
* Strong communication and presentation skills, proficency in local language is a must
* MIS and data management
* Problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Volunteer and team management
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and digital tools

*Disclaimer: The Job Description above is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.*

title: AVP - Delivery Manager
description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.
  
  
**About M&G**
Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
  
  

* To work collaboratively with colleagues and take personal accountability to maintain and enhance controls you are responsible for to support improvement of the overall control environment, customers outcomes and a reduction in M&G plc's operational risk.
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned squad(s) or workstreams, from demand and initiation through planning, execution, release and closure, with clear accountability for delivery confidence, delivery health and outcome achievement.
* Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, success measures, priorities, scope boundaries and acceptance expectations.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans, release forecasts and milestones; communicate confidence, assumptions, options and trade-offs in business language, including the impact of delivery choices on cost, capacity, scope, risk and timelines.
* Manage Scrum events including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective; ensure each sprint has a clear goal, realistic commitment and actionable improvement outcomes.
* Coach teams in Scrum and Lean practices as appropriate, while protecting team self-organisation and avoiding command-and-control task allocation.
* Ensure backlogs and work items meet the agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and that Jira data provides reliable traceability and delivery insight.
* Actively manage RAID, cross-team dependencies, decisions, blockers, resource constraints and third-party commitments; escalate early with clear impact and recovery options.
* Orchestrate delivery across squads, platforms and workstreams by managing decision flow, cross-squad dependencies, sequencing constraints and delivery assurance activities.
* Use evidence and metrics such as predictability, throughput, cycle time, ageing work, escaped defects, release outcomes and team improvement trends to guide decisions.
* Track delivery against intended benefits, measurable value, business outcomes and agreed success criteria, ensuring progress is visible beyond activity completion.
* Coordinate release readiness across testing, architecture, security, risk, change, service management and application support, including operational handover, runbooks, monitoring, support contacts and known issues.
* Maintain transparent stakeholder communication through concise status reporting, governance updates, demonstrations and decision forums, ensuring no surprises; own delivery input into senior governance forums, steering updates, escalation discussions and leadership reporting where required.
* Promote quality, resilience, security, regulatory compliance and control adherence throughout the delivery lifecycle, including ownership of change-control readiness, audit evidence and regulatory delivery obligations where applicable.
* Facilitate/participate in Scrum of Scrums or equivalent dependency forums where required and contribute to delivery standards, templates, communities of practice and continuous improvement, with focus on portfolio/workstream alignment, delivery risk visibility and consistent delivery assurance practices.
* Create an inclusive, psychologically safe and accountable team environment where constructive challenge, learning and feedback are encouraged.
* Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and delivery colleagues and share reusable practices across the delivery community.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: DE-NCLC-M365 Migration and Modernization Manager-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**DE NCLC Manager – Technology Consulting**
EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant Manager with strong subject matter expertise in SharePoint, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex modernization. The role will lead teams delivering large Microsoft 365 migration and modernization programs for clients across regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a client-focused technology leader who can shape and deliver Microsoft 365 transformation engagements. The role combines solution leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement and team development, with a preference for candidates who have led large-scale migration or modernization programs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Microsoft 365 migration and modernization projects across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, workflows and forms.
* Provide technical leadership for SharePoint Online, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations, Nintex and Power Platform.
* Define the delivery approach, estimates, migration waves, resourcing, governance and quality controls.
* Lead assessments, identify risks and dependencies, and develop practical migration roadmaps.
* Guide migration factory setup, pilots, wave execution, cutover and transition.
* Oversee Nintex workflow and form modernization using Nintex Automation Cloud or Power Platform.
* Review solution designs, migration plans, remediation approaches and deployment documents.
* Lead delivery teams, remove blockers, monitor progress and maintain quality.
* Manage client, security, Microsoft and vendor stakeholders, decisions and dependencies.
* Support proposals, demonstrations, estimates, staffing plans and executive presentations.
* Promote reusable methods, automation and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with security, quality, organizational and commercial requirements.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 9-12 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong SME-level knowledge of SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server, SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft 365 architecture.
* Proven experience planning and delivering large Microsoft 365 migration programs involving SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
* Experience with migration assessment, remediation, migration factory operations, wave planning, velocity management, cutover and hypercare.
* Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
* Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
* Relevant Microsoft, Nintex, project management or agile certifications.

**Soft Skills**

* Ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing teams across locations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.
* Sound decision-making and problem-solving in complex situations.
* Ability to manage scope, schedules, risks, quality and competing priorities.
* Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to review technical deliverables, challenge assumptions and guide consultants and engineers.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a professional services or consulting organization.
* Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
* Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.
* Experience developing estimates, delivery plans, governance and stakeholder communications.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Led large-scale Microsoft 365 migration or modernization projects from discovery through transition.
* Managed multidisciplinary teams covering migration, development, workflow modernization, testing and change activities.
* Contributed to proposals, solutioning, capability development and client relationship growth.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Process Engineer
description:
**About the Company**

**PharmNXT Biotech**
is an innovation-driven biotechnology company, specializing in end-to-end bioprocess solutions for the biopharmaceutical industry. Through our state-of-the-art
**PharmNXTEkuse**
manufacturing facility, we design and manufacture single-use bioprocess systems, containment solutions, and advanced hardware technologies for biologics manufacturing. Guided by our vision of
**"Make in India for the World,"**
we deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions that support the production of life-saving therapies for customers across the globe.

You can learn more about us here:
https://www.pharmnxtbiotech.com
.

**About the Role**

The Senior Process Engineer is a hands-on technical role that spans design, product development, customer engagement and project ownership for bioprocess equipments.

**Qualifications**

* 5 - 10 years of Experience in Design & Process in Single Use Technology
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology, Bioprocess Technology, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent field

**Required Skills**

* **Single-Use Technology & Manufacturing**
* Experience in Single use Manufacturing, Manifold assembly, Single Use Bags
* Experience in Single use System Qualifications

* **Bioprocess & Process Systems**
* Strong knowledge of bioprocess engineering and upstream/downstream process systems.
* Hands-on experience with fermentation, media/buffer preparation, chromatography, TFF, filtration and Filling systems.

* **Engineering Documentation & Equipment Design**
* Proficiency in preparation and review of engineering documents such as PFDs, P&IDs, datasheets, layouts, and process calculations.
* Knowledge of equipment sizing and selection and process system integration

**Responsibilities**

**Project Management & Execution**

* Lead and execute projects across the complete project life cycle, including planning, process engineering, detailed design review, procurement coordination, execution, testing, delivery, commissioning, and project closeout, ensuring achievement of KPI targets, timelines, budget, quality, and customer requirements.
* Take complete technical ownership of medium to large-scale bioprocess projects from enquiry stage through final handover, ensuring accurate scope definition, optimized process solutions, and effective risk management.
* Monitor project schedules, milestones, technical risks, change controls, and project costs, and proactively implement corrective actions to maintain overall project performance and profitability.
* Ensure systems are designed, manufactured, tested, documented, and delivered in accordance with contractual specifications, quality standards, regulatory expectations, project schedules, and commercial commitments.

**Bioprocess Engineering & Technical Expertise**

* Analyse customer processes and process requirements for engineered systems used in upstream and downstream bioprocess applications including fermentation, media/buffer preparation, harvest systems, chromatography, tangential flow filtration, depth filtration, viral inactivation, CIP/SIP systems, and other related bioprocess technologies to develop optimized and integrated process solutions.
* Review and finalize equipment sizing, utility requirements, process calculations, and system integration philosophy to ensure reliable and efficient system performance.

**Engineering Design & Technical Documentation**

* Prepare, review, approve, and manage all project-related engineering and technical documents including PFDs, P&IDs, layouts, process calculations, equipment datasheets, specifications, design qualifications, protocols, validation documents, SOPs, and technical reports.
* Review process designs and engineering deliverables to ensure compliance with customer URS, GMP guidelines, applicable industry standards, and internal engineering practices.
* Lead and support FAT, SAT, commissioning, IOQ, troubleshooting, performance trials, and customer acceptance activities at vendor and customer sites whenever required.

**Customer & Stakeholder & Team Management**

* Travel to customer sites for project execution, commissioning support, technical discussions, process troubleshooting, optimization activities, and customer coordination.
* Coordinate effectively with customers, vendors, consultants, and cross-functional internal departments including design, automation, electrical, manufacturing, procurement, QA/QC, validation, and service teams for successful project execution.
* Lead technical discussions with customers and consultants during project execution, design reviews, troubleshooting, and change management activities.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring process engineers and project team members, ensuring adherence to engineering standards, best practices, and project procedures.

**Pre-Sales & Business Development**

* Support business development and pre-sales activities by preparing technical proposals, compliance statements, process concepts, equipment sizing, technical presentations, cost optimization inputs, and participating in customer technical clarification meetings.

**Project Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare and present periodic project reviews, technical updates, MOMs, progress reports, risk assessments, and project closure documentation to management and customers.

* **Quality, Safety & Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, safety practices, GMP requirements, and applicable regulatory and engineering standards throughout project execution.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to engineering practices, documentation standards, project execution methodologies, and process optimization.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About The Role**
**About Soar and how we build :**
Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation.
  
We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here.
  
How we work :
  
Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either.
  
Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current.
  
We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end.
  
Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers.
  
Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run.
  
What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed.
  
**Role Summary:**
We rely heavily on AI to build, test, and improve software. We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager who can lead a team of engineers working with AI agents, keep delivery focused, and ensure every release meets a high quality bar. You will combine people leadership with practical technical oversight and help your team become more effective every week.
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the team’s delivery from requirements through production, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and accountability.
* Coach engineers to use AI agents effectively for implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation; contribute directly when needed.
* Help the team break complex work into reviewable tasks, provide relevant context to agents, and validate results against product requirements.
* Review designs and critical code changes, challenge unsupported AI assumptions, and ensure changes remain understandable and maintainable.
* Embed automated tests, peer review, CI checks, security checks, and end-to-end validation into delivery; keep human review accountable for release decisions.
* Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps to resolve blockers, prepare releases, and address production issues and recurring defects.
* Run regular one-to-ones, give actionable feedback, support career growth, and manage workloads sustainably.
* Improve team practices using evidence from delivery lead time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage costs.

**Requirements**
**Requirements:**

* Typically 7+ years in software engineering and 2+ years leading engineers or managing a team; equivalent demonstrated impact is welcome.
* Strong hands-on experience building production applications, with sound knowledge of APIs, databases, testing, CI/CD, and cloud systems.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents to deliver production software and helping other engineers adopt them effectively.
* Ability to review and debug AI-generated code, identify missing edge cases, and select appropriate automated and human validation.
* Strong planning, communication, and coaching skills, with a record of creating clarity and delivering through a team.

**Nice to have :**
Experience building reusable agent workflows, integrating engineering tools through APIs or MCP, or delivering software in fintech or another regulated environment.
  
**What success looks like :**
The team ships tested features predictably, resolves issues quickly, and demonstrates improving quality and productivity. Engineers use AI effectively while understanding and owning the systems they deliver.

title: Careline Lead, Asia & METSA
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
ABOUT ICE CREAM: Life Tastes Better with Ice Cream Once separated from Unilever, the The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC) will become the world’s largest global Ice Cream Company, with over 100 years’ experience delivering a diverse range of indulgent, yet responsible, craft food experiences. We have 35 brands, including 3 one billion Euro brands (Magnum, Wall’s, Ben & Jerry’s), a strong presence in over 60 countries, generating annual revenue of €8 billion. All brands are driven to transform moments into memories through indulgent yet responsibly made and marketed products. We have a well-developed strategy to deliver growth and value creation which is clear on where to play and how to win. We turn the ordinary into the extraordinary by designing unique and innovative Ice Cream experiences that make life taste better, creating joyful experiences. In our Ice Cream business, we’re crafting the future through innovation and imaginative minds, creating unique products. We spark moments of happiness for people and within the communities where we operate. We are committed to developing and nurturing talent. You will have ample options for career growth and exploration. Your career development will be a priority for us, and we are dedicated to supporting your growth journey within the new company. ABOUT GBS: Global Business Solutions:   Global Business Solutions (GBS) is TMICC’s trusted transformation partner, delivering innovative and integrated solutions from design to delivery. We develop future-fit capability, expertise and technologically advanced solutions to unlock speed, simplicity and operational agility across TMICCs operations. This is your chance for a ‘once in a lifetime’ career experience, playing a part in the creation of a fully independent, new Ice Cream company and a greenfield GBS organization supporting Europe Supply Chain Finance Processes. Employees within GBS partner with multiple teams in countries across Europe ranging from Factories, Distribution Centers, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Services, Procurement. You will become part of the delivery service engine behind TMICC’s hero brands and will have the opportunity to implement new solutions and processes alongside an innovative tech stack that is been delivered as part of the separation from Unilever program. What you'll be responsible for Act as the primary point of contact between GBS Careline teams (Captive and/or 3PSP) and markets within the region (BU). Act as an additional layer of supervision of work performed by 3rd party vendor for daily services. Serve as the escalation point for operational risks, delays, or service failures, and coordinate crisis management, ensuring timely resolution and transparent communication. Ensure Careline operations consistently follow TMICC global standards, processes, tools, timelines, communications, validating consistent implementation across the region. Monitor and govern region-level Careline operations performance using dashboards and reports, ensuring service delivery meets agreed SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards. Identify trends, risks, and root causes of underperformance, drive corrective actions, and promote continuous improvement across the region. Support markets during transitions, onboarding, and operating model changes, ensuring awareness, readiness, and alignment between the operations and local market requirements. Hold accountability for region-level budget governance, including vendor cost tracking, volume forecasting alignment, and identification of cost optimization opportunities. Manage stakeholder relationships across internal teams (Marketing, Legal, Supply Chain, Quality) and external partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables at the regional level. We're looking for someone who Practical experience in Consumer or Customer Engagement operations, with understanding of customer care processes, performance KPIs, and quality standards. Exposure to governance, coordination, or oversight roles within GBS, shared services, BPO, or complex multi market environment Team Manager experience in supervising team members (direct or 3rd party BPO). Ability to work across multiple countries or markets, supporting alignment with global standards, processes, and timelines. Experience supporting or coordinating transitions, operating model changes, or transformations, with a strong understanding of readiness, governance, and escalation. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to review performance dashboards, identify trends and risks, and drive follow up actions through stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, combined with a high ownership mindset and confidence to challenge and escalate where required. What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location
  
  
**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Controls Engineering Manager
description:
At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We’re one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals & Mining, Warehousing & Distribution, and CPG/Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.
  
  
We’re adding to our team and growing across our markets! We are seeking a
**Controls Engineering Manager**
who will support multiple projects and lead a growing team of engineers & technical resources with strong dotted lines to sales & project management. This is an excellent hands-on opportunity to provide technical solutions and play a vital role growing a line of business with high visibility and tremendous growth potential.

* Work with Executive Management, Sales, and Marketing to develop a business growth plan to drive growth.

* Work cooperatively with engineering, design, production, and field service staff.
* Responsible for aspects of project budget and schedule requirements.
* Be responsible for driving the profit & loss (P&L) of the team on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.
* Specify and configure various hardware components such as, instrumentation, PLCs, communication systems and industrial control panels.
* Design and configure PLC/SCADA networks.
* Generate test procedures and forms.
* Meet with key clients to ensure that we are meeting or exceeding their expectations and to participate in driving our growth with them.
* Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

**You have:**

* BE in Controls and Instrumentation Engineering or equivalent educational background.
* 8+ years in industrial automation / controls integration industry.
* 3+ years managing and leading a team.
* Knowledge of standard engineering practices and procedures.
* Ability to develop PLC and HMI programs within one or more languages (Schneider Electric, AVEVA, Rockwell, etc.)
* Experience with process controls instrumentation.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.
* A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.
