title: Lead AI Engagement Specialist
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.
  
  
The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Lead AI Engagement Specialist**
owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.
  
  
This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.
  
  
**Where this role sits**
**Reports to:**
Head of the AI Centre of Excellence
  
  
**Alignment:**
Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover
  
  
**Works with:**
AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required
  
  
**Owns:**
The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.
  
  
**Accountable for:**
Realised, measured business value — not deployment count
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**
This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.
  
  
**Strongly Preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain knowledge.

**First 12 months**

* Portfolio conversation — a transformation or product initiative you owned end to end, including the value actually realised versus the value forecast.

title: Technical Manager – Traction Power Supply Systems – Rail Electrification (m/f/d)
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a phenomenal addition to our vibrant international team.
  
  
**We are looking for a Technical Manager – Traction Power Supply Systems – Rail Electrification (m/f/d)**
**You’ll make a difference by:**

* Delivering the end-to-end traction power supply system/subsystem within the specified time, cost, and quality requirements.
* Preparing preliminary and detailed electrical engineering drawings, including overview diagrams, single-line diagrams, layouts, BOQs, etc.
* Conducting technical reviews and submitting designs for AC and DC traction power supply substations, auxiliary power supply systems, and emergency power supply systems (UPS and DC distribution systems) for traction power supply.
* Conducting technical reviews and submitting technical specifications for electrical subsystems (HV/MV/LV equipment, including transformers, cables, etc.) within substations.
* Coordinating technical and non-technical interfaces with collaborators such as project managers, suppliers, and other subsystems (e.g., signaling, civil, etc.) to ensure the integration of all electrical systems within substations.
* Managing, planning, organizing, and controlling engineering work packages for traction substation design.
* Controlling and reporting on projects or sub-projects to stakeholders.
* Participating in contract management and project compliance processes for traction power supply systems.
* Identifying and leading opportunities and risks within the project or sub-projects.
* Providing technical support during the manufacturing, testing, installation, and commissioning phases.
* Leading technical deliverables with sales departments and project management during both the bid phase and the project realization phase.
* Coordinating with functional managers in line-organization for vital support and provisioning.
* Managing technical clarifications with domestic and international sub-suppliers.
* Visiting domestic and international suppliers and project locations to witness equipment testing and attend stakeholder meetings.
* Participating in technical liaison meetings with customers, suppliers, and Siemens’ internal departments globally.

**You’ll win us over by:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering or a similar field, ideally in power distribution, electrical control systems, or traction power substation design.
* Knowledge of high- and medium-voltage technology, with a good understanding of system design, manufacturing processes, installation, training, and testing and commissioning activities in electrical substations.
* Knowledge of auxiliary and emergency power supply systems.
* Knowledge of earthing and bonding systems for electrical substations.
* Knowledge of measurement, control, and supervisory systems.
* Knowledge of relevant European and international standards (IEC, IEEE, EN).
* Knowledge of engineering processes.
* Knowledge of engineering and technical management for electrical systems.
* Experience in project realization, preferably in an international project environment.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience in the railway sector, especially in railway electrification power supply systems.
* Experience in the design and planning of electrical AC/DC substations.
* Intercultural experience and strong English language skills.
* German language skills (reading, writing, and speaking) will be an advantage.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
This role is based in Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.
  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

title: Lead Technical Program Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Lead Technical Program Manager
  
  
An AI‑First Technical Program Manager who organizes and accelerates delivery across agent‑amplified pods, using the written specification as the single source of truth and DORA/Core4 metrics as the primary delivery signal. Operates as a connective role in a shared pool — reaching into every pod to keep the program's coordination, risk, and dependency view current without orchestrating day‑to‑day — while preserving every SOX/PCI control gate. Manifest definitions, release integration, scope, and dependencies are tracked with data so all outputs are production‑ready at launch.
  
  
Organizes and accelerates related technology projects across multiple pods, aligning dependent organizations; identifies and removes blockers and always finds the path forward.
  
  
Charts the pod‑to‑pod relay (which pod builds each Epic stage), aggregates cross‑Big‑Rock risks and dependencies into a single view, and drives execution through the monthly Epic cycle anchored to the user guides.
  
  
Serves as the source of truth for status; generates the Monthly Technical Review (MTR), RAID Log, and DORA rollup directly from the session record using M365 Copilot, so the ledger stays current without hand‑keeping.
  
  
Measurably improves, streamlines, and eliminates excess process and ceremony — naming the reader of every artifact before it is kept and retiring legacy ceremonies deliberately.
  
  
Keeps abreast of the evolving AI‑engineering landscape; understands the practical read of what AI can and cannot do — that AI amplifies engineering judgment and leaves that judgment with the human — and asks the right questions to evaluate scalability, latency, security, performance, and data integrity.
  
  
Works with ambiguity and limited guidance, comfortable with the indeterminism of agent‑driven delivery, kept honest by the monthly user guides and real‑customer feedback.
  
  
Transforms raw thoughts into clear, concise communication and can communicate with confidence 3+ levels up; fluent in prompt patterns and agent‑session discipline to produce review‑ready output on the first pass.
  
  
Understands the needs of engineers and BizOps/SRE teams, including the verification tax and the build‑and‑review, follow‑the‑sun pairing that manages it.
  
  
Reviews metrics and proactively seeks improved data and mechanisms for visibility, keeping the program aligned to objectives while preserving all control gates — AIFE removes coordination overhead, not controls.
  
  
Plays an active role in mentoring, recruiting, and growing agent fluency and the Expert‑Generalist skill ladder across pods.
  
  
Experiences
  
  
Anticipate bottlenecks and factor in contingency for unplanned delays, including transition risk from Scrum to the pod model.
  
  
Define success metrics where they are missing, defaulting to the four DORA/Core4 metrics: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Failed Deployment Recovery Time.
  
  
Recognize discordant views and resolve them through constructive dialog; act as the program's anti‑confirmation‑bias check.
  
  
Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations to improve concurrent delivery, including tests‑first/spec‑driven parallelism and same‑session documentation currency.
  
  
Streamline or eliminate excess process wherever the same efforts or issues repeat year‑over‑year.
  
  
Expert with scrum delivery and its evolution into the AIFE monthly Epic and pod‑relay operating model, including the shift from story points to spec‑projected slices.
  
  
AI‑First Tooling & Skills
  
  
M365 Copilot fluency: Excel (RAID Log, dependency matrix, DORA dashboards), Word (MTR generation, handoff notes), Loop/OneNote (async session logs).
  
  
Spec‑as‑ledger discipline: treat the specification as reviewed engineering work; let agents project epic/feature/story records on demand rather than hand‑slicing or pointing.
  
  
Relay and shared‑pool operating model: chart pod relays, manage follow‑the‑sun handoffs, and steer by feedback at Epic boundaries.
  
  
Agent accountability and audit‑safety: ensure a named human directs and reviews every agent output, with session logs and control‑role sign‑offs keeping who‑built/who‑approved auditable.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Senior Technical Program Manager

The AI Platform Engineering team is responsible for enabling the enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence by building, operating, and evolving shared AI platforms, services, governance capabilities, and operational practices. Our mission is to provide scalable, secure, reliable, and compliant AI infrastructure that empowers teams across Mastercard to accelerate the development and deployment of AI-powered solutions.

Rather than focusing on a single product or application, you will drive programs that span platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, developer enablement, governance, operational excellence, and enterprise adoption.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, AI Platform Engineering, you will be responsible for leading large-scale technology initiatives from concept through implementation and operationalization. You will coordinate work across multiple engineering and business organizations, ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into executable plans and delivered successfully.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with sufficient technical depth to engage effectively with engineers, architects, and technology leaders. * Develop executive-ready communications, dashboards, status updates, presentations, and program reviews.
* Lead planning sessions, steering committees, roadmap reviews, operational reviews, and stakeholder meetings.
* Establish governance, reporting, and operational mechanisms that improve transparency, predictability, and execution effectiveness.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve delivery processes, operating models, planning practices, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ensure programs meet organizational standards for security, compliance, risk management, operational readiness, and business continuity.
* Utilize metrics and data-driven insights to assess program health, communicate outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support strategic planning, portfolio management, roadmap development, prioritization, and organizational scaling initiatives.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and customer focus.

**All About You:**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Experience leading large-scale technical programs involving multiple engineering teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives within software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, data, or technology organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage integrated plans, coordinate dependencies, mitigate risks, and drive successful delivery outcomes.
* Experience communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience managing competing priorities and delivering results in fast-paced, evolving environments.
* Ability to influence across organizations without direct authority.
* Experience working with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation and reporting.
* Experience working within highly collaborative, cross-functional technology organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting cloud platforms, developer platforms, AI/ML platforms, data platforms, infrastructure platforms, or enterprise software systems.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, system architecture, cloud computing, and modern technology delivery practices.
* Experience supporting platform adoption, developer enablement, operational excellence, and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Experience establishing delivery governance, operational reviews, portfolio management, or enterprise planning practices.
* Experience working within regulated environments requiring strong security, governance, compliance, and risk management controls.
* PMP, PgMP, Scrum, SAFe, or comparable program management certifications.
* Experience supporting large-scale platform modernization or digital transformation initiatives.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Associate Director_3367
description:
**About The Job**

 The AI Factory Lead India will head the AI Factory's India team members in India: AI Engagement Managers who shape and steer OE engagements, Forward Deployed Engineers who build and ship the underlying solutions, and AI Platform Engineers who build and operate the shared AI platform every solution runs on. Together they turn OE and Group pain points into deliverable, funded AI projects through a defined lifecycle from Idea to Handover, backed by a growing library of reusable AI building blocks that turn one OE's solution into the next OE's head start. The AI Factory Lead India will also bridge the end\-to\-end delivery, setting priorities across concurrent engagements, growing and coaching AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers, and acting as the senior escalation point with AI Factory, Allianz Technology leadership, Heads of ITs', and Account Managers. The role balances demand shaping and delivery execution with platform health, and represents the India team within Allianz Technology's global AI Factory leadership.
   

  

**What You Do**

* Act as the senior escalation point and relationship owner with OE leadership, Heads of IT, and Account Managers, unblocking engagements Engagement Managers cannot resolve alone.
* Own the India team's overall demand pipeline; prioritize opportunities, allocate Engagement Managers, and balance qualification, delivery, and run\-support work across concurrent engagements.
* Represent the AI Factory in governance forums, portfolio reviews, and budget and resourcing conversations with senior stakeholders, up to CTO and Board level where required.
* Ensure the AI Platform Engineers' roadmap (runtime, governance, FinOps, observability) reflects needs surfaced by live engagements.
* Champion reuse: ensure Forward Deployed Engineers contribute new patterns back to the central building\-block catalogue and Engagement Managers factor reuse into scoping.
* Own the build\-to\-run handover model \- including support models, SLAs/OLAs, runbooks, and MLOps/monitoring \- and maintain oversight of security, compliance, and responsible\-AI standards across all Factory deliverables.
* Track Factory\-wide KPIs (time\-to\-value, reuse rate, delivery predictability, platform cost and reliability) and drive continuous improvement.


**What You Bring**
* Proven experience leading multi\-disciplinary technical teams (delivery/engagement, engineering, and platform functions) in large, matrix organizations, ideally in insurance or another regulated environment; knowledge of Allianz Group and Allianz Technology is a plus.
* People management track record: hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development across senior technical and delivery roles.
* Senior enough for OE leadership and Head of IT conversations, technical enough to challenge scope and platform decisions honestly.
* Strong stakeholder, business\-framing, and roadmap\-shaping skills, with the ability to prepare clear decision materials for executive audiences.
* Experience running a delivery portfolio: demand shaping, prioritization, resourcing, budget ownership, and risk management across concurrent engagements.
* An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable taking ownership and driving topics forward in a build\-up environment without waiting for perfect structure.
* A degree in business, management, technology, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.


 Not Expected To Hands\-on Build Or Hold Formal Certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) \- Working Knowledge Of The Following Is Needed To Guide Trade\-offs, Hold Credible Technical Conversations With The Team, And Challenge Or Support Architectural And Platform Decisions

* The modern AI/data stack \- vector databases, embedding stores, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and LLM/agent framework integration.
* AI governance and responsible\-AI principles, including model governance, data lineage, and auditability.
* Solution lifecycle management and reuse practices (MVS, AI Building Blocks) across sandbox, standardization, and retirement stages.


**What We Offer**

title: Demand Planning and Supply Chain Lead
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Procurement Management** 



* Take over manufacturer/vendor coordination after NPD finalizes the product, costing, and first product details.
* Release purchase orders and maintain accurate PO trackers.
* Coordinate with vendors for production timelines, dispatch timelines, quantities, and delivery commitments.
* Manage repeat orders and future PO processing based on inventory requirements.
* Coordinate on MOQ, delivery timelines, payment terms, and commercial terms where required.
* Track vendor\-wise lead times, production capacity, and delivery adherence.
* Escalate vendor delays, short supply, quality issues, cost changes, or documentation gaps on time.
* Work with Finance for payment planning and working capital alignment.



**2\. Inventory Planning** 



* Maintain SKU\-wise and platform\-wise inventory plans across brands and channels.
* Track current stock, in\-transit stock, platform stock, 3PL stock, blocked stock, and available stock.
* Monitor inventory days at SKU, brand, platform, and company level.
* Maintain target inventory days around 60 days, adjusted by SKU type, lead time, MOQ, sales velocity, and campaign plans.
* Track 7\-day, 15\-day, and 30\-day average sales velocity for important SKUs.
* Predict expected stockout dates and raise reorder alerts before risk becomes urgent.
* Prepare reorder plans based on sales velocity, lead time, safety stock, vendor timelines, and platform inward timelines.
* Identify excess stock, slow\-moving stock, dead stock, and inventory above 60/90 days.
* Prepare purchase priority lists based on sales, margin, stockout risk, campaign importance, and cash flow.



**3\. Fulfilment \& Platform Delivery** 



* Plan timely pickup of stock from manufacturers/vendors.
* Coordinate with transporters, 3PLs, platform teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure stock reaches the correct warehouse, 3PL, or platform on time.
* Manage Amazon, Flipkart, Quick Commerce, D2C, MT, GT, and other platform replenishment requirements.
* Own appointment booking and appointment follow\-ups for platform deliveries.
* Track dispatch date, delivery date, GRN/inward date, and live stock date.
* Ensure stock is not only dispatched but also inwarded and available for sale.
* Track delayed appointments, rejected shipments, short deliveries, damaged deliveries, and pending GRNs.
* Coordinate inter\-warehouse stock transfers where required.



**4\. NPD to Supply Chain Handover** 




 The Supply Chain Lead must ensure that every new product handover includes: 
 


* Final vendor/manufacturer details, final approved costing, MOQ, lead time, payment terms, and production timeline.
* Final product specifications, packaging specifications, product dimensions, weight, barcode/MRP, and batch details.
* Shelf life and expiry details wherever applicable.
* QC checklist, first PO recommendation, expected launch date, initial inventory requirement, and platform\-wise launch stock plan.
* No PO should be released unless the NPD handover is complete.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should not be only a procurement person or only a dispatch coordinator. This person should understand the full supply chain cycle and be able to connect vendor timelines, inventory days, platform stock, appointments, cash flow, and sales impact. 
 



**The person should think like a planner, execute like an operator, and follow up like an owner.**

* Good understanding of Credit Risk, financial instruments, and exposure management.

 This role is the backbone of execution.

 This is not a desk role. It requires presence, decisiveness, and the ability to stay composed while managing complexity, scale, and pressure.

* Own end\-to\-end operational planning for all wedding events
* Create detailed event\-wise execution timelines and run\-of\-show documents
* Ensure smooth setup, transitions, and breakdowns across events
* Anticipate operational risks and plan contingencies in advance



**2\. Vendor \& Partner Management** 



* Coordinate with all vendors: decor, production, lighting, sound, hospitality, logistics, security, artists, and venues
* Share clear timelines, layouts, and expectations with each vendor
* Monitor vendor performance and adherence to timelines and scope
* Handle on\-ground negotiations, issue resolution, and last\-minute adjustments



**3\. Team \& Manpower Management** 



* Plan and deploy on\-ground teams effectively
* Assign clear roles and responsibilities to coordinators and staff
* Ensure team discipline, punctuality, and alignment
* Act as the central command point during events



**4\. Budget \& Resource Control** 



* Ensure execution stays aligned with approved budgets
* Track scope changes and flag cost implications early
* Minimise wastage through smart planning and reuse
* Coordinate with planning and accounts teams on reconciliations



**5\. Client \& Internal Coordination** 



* Work closely with Client Service, Planning, and Design teams
* Ensure client\-approved plans are executed accurately
* Shield clients from operational stress during events
* Communicate calmly and clearly during high\-pressure moments



**6\. On\-Ground Crisis Management** 



* Handle unexpected issues decisively (weather, delays, vendor failures, guest\-related challenges)
* Make quick, practical decisions without escalating panic
* Maintain control and clarity in chaotic situations







  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 4\-6 years of experience in wedding operations, large\-scale events, or hospitality operations
* Strong understanding of Indian weddings and multi\-day event formats
* Proven ability to manage large teams and multiple vendors
* Excellent logistical and organisational skills
* Comfort working long hours during event periods



**Good to Have** 



* Experience with destination weddings
* Exposure to luxury or high\-end events
* Understanding of production, staging, and technical setups
* Ability to read layouts, drawings, and spatial plans







  





**Skills \& Traits We Value** 



* Calm under pressure
* Decisive and solution\-oriented
* Highly organised
* Strong leadership presence
* Clear communicator
* Physically and mentally resilient







  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 



* Events run on time with minimal visible stress
* Vendors perform efficiently and responsibly
* Clients experience smooth, confident execution
* Issues are resolved before they escalate
* Planning and design intent is protected on ground







  





**Working Style \& Culture Fit** 



* This is a high\-ownership role
* Requires authority, accountability, and maturity
* Not reactive firefighting; structured operations are expected
* You will be trusted to make decisions independently







  





**Compensation** 



* Competitive fixed salary based on experience
* Performance\-linked incentives per project
* Growth opportunity into Head of Operations roles

title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13)
description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and flexibility to change directions quickly while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Experience with the process of creating, maintaining and reviewing operations process \& end user training documentation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, Bomgar/BeyondTrust privileged access, Unix LDAP, and RSA Authentication Manager (or comparable tools).
* Experience working in highly regulated industries (Finance, Healthcare, Government), particularly enterprise\-level security in a financial institution.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOX, PCI, FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, or NIST cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST 800\-63 and logical access control expectations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or relevant IAM\-focused certifications.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.

Job Title
   

  

 Sr. Structural Project Engineer
   

  

**Job Description**
**Structural Engineer \| Pune \| Full\-time**
 The Structural Engineer is expected to independently manage steelwork design, detailing, estimation, and coordination activities for airport projects, while contributing to process improvements and technical standards. The position requires strong technical expertise in steel structures, a proactive approach to problem\-solving, and a commitment to quality, safety, and project objectives. You will act as a subject matter expert in steelwork solutions, ensuring compliance with codes and customer requirements, and supporting project execution with strong technical and organizational skills.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead and oversee the design, detailing, coordination, and approval of structural steelwork solutions for medium\-to\-large airport, parcel, and industrial projects.
* Act as the primary technical authority for steelwork engineering, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, contractual obligations, project objectives, and company standards.
* Review contractual requirements and technical specifications during sales, bidding, and engineering phases to ensure compliant and cost\-effective steelwork solutions.
* Support bidding and proposal activities through steel tonnage estimation, budgeting, supplier evaluations, structural analysis, connection design, and Tekla model development.
* Manage and coordinate steelwork activities with internal teams, clients, suppliers, fabricators, consultants, and external engineering partners.
* Provide technical guidance and support to site installation teams to ensure steelwork execution complies with applicable codes, standards, project specifications, and site conditions for both greenfield and brownfield projects.
* Prepare and review design calculations, engineering deliverables, drawings, models, technical documentation, and project submissions.
* Perform technical reviews, risk assessments, and quality checks of critical structural elements to ensure engineering excellence and project compliance.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement optimization opportunities throughout the design, fabrication, and installation phases to improve cost, quality, constructability, and schedule performance.
* Develop practical and innovative solutions for design modifications and engineering challenges while minimizing project cost and schedule impacts.
* Support supplier engagement activities, including quotation reviews, technical evaluations, and negotiations related to steelwork scope.
* Assess claims, variation orders, and engineering changes, providing recommendations based on technical and commercial impacts.
* Mentor and support junior engineers by sharing technical knowledge, providing guidance, and promoting engineering best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by enhancing steelwork processes, standards, methodologies, and quality practices across projects.
* Ensure compliance with international design codes, industry standards, quality management requirements, and company procedures.
* Adhere to occupational health, safety, security, environmental, and quality requirements in all project activities.

* Structured, organized, and methodical approach to engineering and project delivery.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and contributing actively within a team environment.

* Fluent in written and spoken English.

Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment

**US Brokerage\- Team Leader Job Description**

 The Team Lead is a full‑time position responsible for providing operational leadership, administrative support and technical coaching to associates to ensure the accurate and timely identification, processing and update of shipment information. The role applies sound judgment and independent initiative to identify issues, analyze problems, and implement appropriate solutions in a fast‑paced operational environment. The Team Lead monitors process efficiency, ensures optimal utilization of resources and supports the effective implementation of process, policy and procedural updates to maintain service integrity and operational excellence

* Maintains current knowledge of system functionality, service features and process updates through training and knowledge‑sharing with the team.

**Skills \& Qualification Requirements**

* Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and respond professionally to inquiries.

 Permanent

 Since our founding in 2014, we have grown into a global leader with over 140 exceptional professionals, operating across the Americas, EMEA, APAC, and with our headquarters in London.  Project Delivery

 Delivery Assurance \& Data Quality

 Commercial Awareness
   

  




* Monitor project financial performance and support effective budget control.

* Support proposal development and business development activities where required.


**Additional Information**

 Skills and Experience
   

  





 Essential

* Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

 Personal Attributes

* Comfortable working across multiple projects and priorities.
* Confidence in challenging incomplete or inaccurate information.
* Strong communicator with a collaborative working style.
* Able to identify issues early and drive actions through to completion.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast\-paced client environment.



 Key Performance Indicators
   

  




* Timely and high\-quality delivery of assigned projects.
* Accuracy and completeness of project and program data.
* Effective management of risks, issues, actions, and dependencies.
* Consistent adherence to delivery processes and governance standards.

title: Senior GIS Migration Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long\-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.
   

  

 TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader.
   

  

 We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Data Migration Lead will oversee and execute the migration of geospatial data from legacy systems such as GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri's Utility Network (UN). This role requires expertise in Esri technologies, Utility Network configuration, and data transformation tools like FME. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in utilities (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and experience managing complex data migration projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end data migration projects from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri Utility Network.
* Analyze legacy data models and design migration strategies to align with Esri Utility Network schema and best practices.
* Configure and implement Esri Utility Network models, including network rules, topologies, and asset configurations.
* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) workflows using FME and Python (ArcPy).
* Perform data quality assessments and validations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness during migration.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define migration objectives, and ensure alignment with business needs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data compatibility, schema mapping, and network topology during migration.
* Optimize migration processes for performance and scalability, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity.
* Document migration workflows, methodologies, and lessons learned for future reference.
* Provide training and support to teams on Esri Utility Network and post\-migration processes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 8\-12 years of experience in GIS, with at least 4\-6 years in data migration projects.
* Strong expertise in Esri technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and Utility Network.
* Hands\-on experience with data migration from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri platforms.
* Proficiency in FME (Feature Manipulation Engine) for data transformation and automation.
* Advanced Python scripting skills (ArcPy) for geoprocessing and data migration tasks.
* In\-depth knowledge of utility network models (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and their operational workflows.
* Experience with spatial databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills to manage cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Esri Utility Network configuration, including network rules, subnetwork management, and tracing.
* Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies and tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of GE Smallworld data structures and migration challenges.
* Experience with large\-scale enterprise GIS implementations and integrations.
* Certification in Esri technologies or FME is a plus.


 EEO Statement

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
   

  

 The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.
   

  

 TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

* Strong customer service and communications skills, both oral and written in order to relate information in a direct and succinct method

title: Manager Engineering
description:
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud\-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
   

  

 Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co\-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
   

  

 Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
   

  

**Summary**
 The Manager, Engineering reports to the Director, Engineering and leads a team of software engineers who build and sustain the products Armor’s customers depend on. This is a hands\-on leadership position: the manager writes production code, opens and reviews pull requests, and ships alongside the engineers they lead. The role exercises independent judgment and discretion in setting technical direction, making architecture decisions, prioritizing defects and feature work, directing incident response, and developing engineering talent. Armor is looking for a technical leader with a track record of building and shipping high\-quality software with AI\-assisted development tools, and with the engineering judgment to raise the bar on architecture, delivery speed, and engineering ownership. This is a full\-time in\-office role based in Pune, India; on\-site presence five days a week is required.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)**
* Lead and manage a high\-performing AI\-native software engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, and hands\-on guidance while building a culture of engineering ownership.
* Contribute directly to architecture, design, code reviews, and implementation of complex software, working in the repository alongside the team rather than reviewing from a distance.
* Own day\-to\-day delivery for the assigned product areas, including feature work, defect triage, regression prevention, and customer escalations, and keep the Director, Engineering current on status and risk.
* Drive end\-to\-end engineering execution with minimal reliance on product management, translating business objectives into working software.
* Execute release management discipline set by the Director, Engineering, including change windows, rollback criteria, and release readiness for the team’s work.
* Put AI\-assisted development tools into daily engineering practice, measure the effect on delivery speed and quality, and hold the team to production\-grade standards for AI\-generated code.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, developer tools, and cloud technologies, balancing rapid experimentation against production\-grade engineering discipline.
* Hire and build the team, including defining the technical hiring bar, running interview loops, and onboarding new engineers.
* Manage relationships with third\-party technology vendors by evaluating platform usage, monitoring cost and performance, assessing alternatives, and providing technical recommendations that support renewals, negotiations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams, ensuring clear communication, knowledge sharing, and alignment across distributed engineering teams.
* Manage team performance through regular one\-on\-one meetings, goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and career development planning.
* Serve as the escalation point for production incidents and customer\-impacting issues, coordinating rapid response, running post\-incident reviews, and feeding the findings back into engineering practice.


**Required Skills**
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production software that customers depend on. Show us the work; we do not screen on years on a resume.
* Experience leading or managing software engineers, including performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Hands\-on production experience delivering software with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Strong frontend and backend development skills using technologies such as React, TypeScript, C\#, Node.js, Python, or Go, with demonstrated ability to contribute directly to code, architecture, and technical problem\-solving.
* Excellent software architecture skills, with the ability to set architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and promote practices that improve security, quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Production experience with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform, including deploying and operating applications in cloud environments.
* Proven ability to combine hands\-on development with leadership responsibilities without sacrificing either.
* Strong defect management and quality engineering instincts, including the ability to distinguish a regression from a customer\-found defect from a product gap, and to treat each one differently.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable application delivery.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Strong experience with relational, non\-relational, and AI\-enabled data platforms, including SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases, data modeling, performance tuning, and scalable data architectures for AI applications.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role, providing both technical advice and strategic direction to help customers reach their goals.
* Git proficiency including branching strategies, code review workflows, and CI/CD pipeline integration.
* Understanding of AI/LLM security risks including prompt injection, data leakage, and model limitations.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy and security implications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams and time zones.
* Preferred: bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
* Preferred: experience with virtualization, infrastructure, and data protection technologies such as VMware vSphere, Proxmox, NSX\-T, FortiMonitor, Zerto, and Rubrik.
* Preferred: cybersecurity background covering XDR, MDR, SIEM, SOC tooling, endpoint detection and response, threat detection, incident response, and security monitoring.


**WHY ARMOR**
 Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.
   

  

**ARMOR CORE VALUES**
* Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges.
* Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency \+ honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances.
* Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection.
* Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes.
* Follow\-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. The work environment can be either in an office setting or remotely from anywhere.

description:

 This hybrid role for an experienced product consultant focuses on designing enhancing and supporting manufacturing execution and billing solutions using C sharp Angular JS SQL scripting and Critical Manufacturing MES. The consultant will work in day shifts with no travel required engaging closely with stakeholders to optimize invoice adjustment and customer billing processes while ensuring operational efficiency and business value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end to end product consulting activities for manufacturing execution solutions by leveraging C sharp Angular JS and SQL scripting to deliver robust and scalable applications that optimize production performance and transactional accuracy.
* Drive detailed requirement discovery sessions with business stakeholders in customer billing and invoice adjustment domains to translate complex operational needs into clear product features and technical specifications within Critical Manufacturing MES.
* Design and configure MES workflows and data models that integrate seamlessly with authorization billing and invoice adjustment processes to improve accuracy turnaround time and compliance across large scale manufacturing environments.
* Develop high quality software components using C sharp and Angular JS that support intuitive user interfaces and reliable backend services enabling efficient management of customer billing events and adjustment authorizations.
* Create optimized SQL scripts and database procedures that ensure data integrity performance and traceability for transactions related to customer invoices adjustments and billing authorizations within enterprise systems.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional teams including business analysts architects and operations specialists to prioritize product backlog items that deliver measurable impact on revenue assurance and manufacturing efficiency.
* Provide expert guidance on the use of Critical Manufacturing MES capabilities such as production modeling data collection and integration interfaces to enhance visibility across the authorise customer billing and invoice adjustment lifecycle.
* Conduct rigorous testing validation and defect resolution activities for MES and billing related solutions ensuring that product enhancements meet quality standards regulatory requirements and organizational performance targets.
* Mentor junior consultants and technical team members in best practices for product configuration coding standards and solution troubleshooting to build a strong delivery culture and sustain operational excellence.
* Prepare detailed functional and technical documentation for MES configurations application components and SQL scripts so that support teams can maintain and evolve solutions with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Engage in continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing system usage metrics billing accuracy trends and production performance indicators to propose product changes that enhance customer satisfaction and societal value through efficient manufacturing.
* Support stakeholders during go live and post implementation phases by resolving complex incidents performing root cause analysis and recommending preventive actions that stabilize billing and manufacturing execution processes.
* Coordinate with security and compliance teams to ensure that MES and billing solutions adhere to organizational policies data protection standards and audit requirements while maintaining usability and process efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Bring nine to twelve years of progressive experience in product consulting or solution implementation with a focus on complex manufacturing and billing environments supported by large scale enterprise systems.
* Demonstrate strong hands on proficiency in C sharp including object oriented design patterns integration techniques and performance tuning practices relevant for production grade applications.
* Exhibit advanced capability in Angular JS for building responsive secure and maintainable front end interfaces that enable efficient execution of manufacturing and billing tasks by diverse user groups.
* Apply deep knowledge of SQL scripting and relational database concepts to design queries procedures and optimization strategies that support high volume transaction processing and analytical reporting.
* Show proven experience working with Critical Manufacturing MES including configuration integration and customization to align production workflows with customer billing and invoice adjustment requirements.
* Display solid understanding of authorize customer billing and invoice adjustment domain processes including validation controls exception handling and reconciliation practices across enterprise operations.
* Operate effectively in hybrid work settings demonstrating strong communication collaboration and documentation skills that ensure smooth coordination across onsite and remote stakeholders.

title: Planner Operations
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Planner is responsible for managing internal manufacturing of components and final assemblies leveraging ERP system and using extended planning horizons such that manufacturing can occur as scheduled; resource and capacity issues become visible with sufficient lead\-time to define and manage on\-time completion of work orders. This position will be responsible for interfacing with intercompany business units for order acknowledgements, sales contract review, delivery status etc.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Manage intercompany sales orders (NSO): Order Management process steps from order entry through to delivery shipment of product to customer
* Manage sales order on\-time delivery and communicate of order changes/delays to concern stake holders
* Develop priorities and communicate support functions while taking an active role in problem resolution as required.
* Review and release work orders per the system demand, manage the system recommended messages, as well as maintain work order dates that adhere to the metrics of the organization.
* Expedite work orders through production process as required. Execute production dispatch activities. Generate ERP Dispatch Reports and manage shop scheduling and optimization.
* Manage all WIP and resolution of WIP aging issues. Analyze and implement corrective actions for all Job Closure variances outside the required tolerance.
* Development of weekly and monthly shipment plan and co\-ordination of shipment activities
* Comply with all NOV Company, departmental and HSE procedures and policies.


**Facility Responsibilities**
* Lead daily production meetings with relevant stakeholders.
* Attend Weekly/Monthly status calls with customers
* Review material shortages and work with Buyer to resolve shortages between CPO material plans and actual manufacturing needs.
* Commit all items and release Work Orders for in\-house production and OSP per MRP.
* Monitor work\-in\-process and status work orders and maintain estimated completion dates in the system
* Manage ERP exceptions and system generated messages.
* Maintain and manage list of Orders that have risk to on time delivery.
* Reason out and understand order / shipment issues, and resolve.
* Timely and clear communication and follow through from issue identification to closure.
* Communicate clearly with the customer, warehouse, team members, Customers, logistics partners and across Order Management
* Conduct open order review meeting with team members
* Escalate issues and potential resolutions to Management as appropriate.
* Timely coordination with engineering, manufacturing, purchase, quality and management
* Perform work such that a perpetual state of audit readiness is maintained.
* Participate in internal audits as required.


**Metric Accountabilities**
* On\-Time Delivery
* Customer Satisfaction


**Education \& Experience Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or MBA preferred with emphasis in business administration, project management or engineering
* Minimum 7 years’ experience in planning function
* Excellent communications skills with all stakeholders, including the customer, sales, warehouse, transportation, order management, and purchasing teams
* Experience with using MRP systems, such as Oracle, including generating reports from ERP systems.
* Experience solving complex problems, has problem solving skills Proficient in use of Microsoft Office suite of products.
* English speaking and writing needs to at a proficient level.
* Needs to be able to work independently
* Strong time management and analytical skills.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Demonstrates strong ownership of responsibilities and accountability for achieving project milestones, ensuring on\-time delivery.
* Communicates clearly and proactively, fostering teamwork, cross\-functional collaboration, and transparency to achieve shared objectives.
* Approaches problems systematically, leveraging data and insights to make sound, evidence\-based decisions.
* Efficiently plans and prioritizes tasks, managing multiple projects and resources to meet deadlines and quality standards.
* Anticipates stakeholder needs, maintains strong customer relationships, and ensures timely and accurate information flow to support satisfaction and trust.
* Responds effectively to changing priorities, project dynamics, and business environments with flexibility and a positive attitude.

* Skilled in Material Requirement Planning (MRP) and ERP systems (E.g Oracle)

title: IT Audit - Global Markets, Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
 The Business Aligned IT Auditor, Assistant Vice President, will be responsible for working on audit engagements that focus on business risk and related application technology for specific business divisions and/or functions. Team members work to understand business risks and related IT general controls, including interface controls, logical access controls, change management, backup and recovery, and application controls (e.g systematic validations, interfaces). The main objective of an audit is to provide management with independent, objective assurance regarding the design and operating effectiveness of the system of internal controls to mitigate both business and IT\-related risks. The audit follows a collaborative approach, with business and IT audit team members jointly conducting the majority of internal and client\-facing planning, control assessment, testing, and reporting activities.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, stakeholders rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role, you will strive for cutting\-edge solutions that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 As an Integrated Auditor, Assistant Vice President you will
   

  

* Serve as the lead for technology focused audit areas, but also work on operational audits
* Plan and/ or execute audits according to a risk based methodology in line with division and industry standards.
* Supervise and direct the execution of risk and control assessments, along with effective and efficient testing of key controls.
* Review documentation of audit work and conclusion of audit tests results and overall effectiveness of controls.
* Draft audit reports in accordance with division standards to clearly communicate key risks and core audit issues.
* Work in partnership with business area management to communicate expectations and manage any project issues that may arise throughout the audit.
* Escalate audit issues to senior management and interact with business line and senior managers to develop and negotiate solutions.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of audits and assigned functions, including utilization of technology, products, organizational activities, and systems.
* Establish and maintain strong and effective client relationships within the business and supporting IT organizations and assist management in the understanding and adaptation of internal control principles.
* Contribute to change initiatives by participation in system and business process change initiatives with strategic corporate significance by providing input on operational and technological risk issues.
* Invest in your development by expanding, maintaining and applying current knowledge of audit industry best practices, regulatory expectations, and subject matter.
* Support the development and training of more junior staff assigned to projects, including reviewing their workpapers


**What We Value**
 These skills will help you succeed in this role
   

  

* Strong team leadership skills which include creating an environment of trust, soliciting diverse views from team members and supervising, coaching and developing staff.
* High degree of professionalism.
* Able to manage complexity, multi\-task and work independently in non\-routine situations.
* Effective communication skills (both written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
* Proven ability to research, interpret and apply regulatory requirements.
* Interest in developing as a leader within Corporate Audit.
* Ability to comprehend both technology and operational risks.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science and/or Business Administration.
* CISA, CPA, CIA or other applicable certification preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience with assessment and testing of technology and operational controls, including 2\+ years leading and supervising audit engagements.
* Experience in either public accounting or financial services internal audit preferred.
